items.translation: 先在文字頁面輸入或貼上歌詞，再回來加上和弦。

items.key: Tap a word to put a chord on it.
items.source: Tap a word to put a chord on it.
items.translation: 點選文字即可加上和弦。

items.key: Chords go in brackets just before their word: [G]Amazing [C]grace. {start_of_chorus} and {end_of_chorus} mark a chorus.
items.source: Chords go in brackets just before their word: [G]Amazing [C]grace. {start_of_chorus} and {end_of_chorus} mark a chorus.
items.translation: 將和弦放在對應歌詞前的方括號內：[G]Amazing [C]grace。{start_of_chorus} 和 {end_of_chorus} 用來標示副歌。

items.key: The chart and the recording you added go from this iPhone.
items.source: The chart and the recording you added go from this iPhone.
items.translation: 譜面和你加入的錄音將從這部 iPhone 移除。

items.key: Edit it to add the words and chords.
items.source: Edit it to add the words and chords.
items.translation: 編輯譜面，加入歌詞與和弦。

items.key: Your charts and recordings stay on this iPhone.
items.source: Your charts and recordings stay on this iPhone.
items.translation: 你的譜面與錄音都會留在這部 iPhone 上。
移調夾夾第 %lld 品最容易

items.key: Your recording plays in the new key too.
items.source: Your recording plays in the new key too.
items.translation: 你的錄音也會以新的調性播放。

items.key: A ChordPro file, or a text file with the chords over the words.
items.source: A ChordPro file, or a text file with the chords over the words.
items.translation: ChordPro 檔案，或將和弦寫在歌詞上方的文字檔案。

items.key: Type the words, then tap a word to put a chord on it.
items.source: Type the words, then tap a word to put a chord on it.
items.translation: 輸入歌詞，再點選文字加上和弦。

items.key: Timbre listens to an audio file of yours, finds the beat and drafts the chords bar by bar.
items.source: Timbre listens to an audio file of yours, finds the beat and drafts the chords bar by bar.
items.translation: Timbre 會聆聽你的音訊檔案，找出節拍，並逐小節草擬和弦。

items.key: Add only charts and recordings you have the right to use. They stay on this iPhone; Timbre never uploads or shares them.
items.source: Add only charts and recordings you have the right to use. They stay on this iPhone; Timbre never uploads or shares them.
items.translation: 請只加入你有權使用的譜面與錄音。它們會留在這部 iPhone 上；Timbre 絕不會上傳或分享。

items.key: The free plan keeps %lld songs. Timbre Pro keeps as many as you like.
items.source: The free plan keeps %lld songs. Timbre Pro keeps as many as you like.
items.translation: 免費方案可保留 %lld 首歌曲，Timbre Pro 則不限數量。

items.key: Copied from a chord sheet you own, in ChordPro or with chords over the words.
items.source: Copied from a chord sheet you own, in ChordPro or with chords over the words.
items.translation: 從你擁有的和弦譜複製，使用 ChordPro 格式或將和弦標在歌詞上方。

items.key: Copied from a chord sheet you own.
items.source: Copied from a chord sheet you own.
items.translation: 從你擁有的和弦譜複製。

items.key: Timbre couldn't find a beat and chords in this recording. Try one with the band or a strummed instrument playing in time.
items.source: Timbre couldn't find a beat and chords in this recording. Try one with the band or a strummed instrument playing in time.
items.translation: Timbre 無法在這段錄音中找出節拍與和弦。請試試有樂團伴奏，或有樂器穩定掃弦的錄音。
錄音會留在這部 iPhone 上。

items.key: A draft from what Timbre heard. Play along and fix any chord that sounds wrong in the editor.
items.source: A draft from what Timbre heard. Play along and fix any chord that sounds wrong in the editor.
items.translation: 這是 Timbre 聆聽後產生的草稿。請跟著演奏，並在編輯器中修正聽起來不對的和弦。

items.key: Your songs can't be saved on this device right now.
items.source: Your songs can't be saved on this device right now.
items.translation: 目前無法在此裝置上儲存你的歌曲。

items.key: That file has no chart in it.
items.source: That file has no chart in it.

items.key: There's no text on the clipboard.
items.source: There's no text on the clipboard.

items.key: That file is too big to be a chord chart.
items.source: That file is too big to be a chord chart.
items.translation: 檔案太大，無法作為和弦譜。

items.key: That file isn't a text chord chart.
items.source: That file isn't a text chord chart.
items.translation: 這個檔案不是文字和弦譜。

items.key: Timbre can't play that file. Use an audio file of your own that isn't copy-protected.
items.source: Timbre can't play that file. Use an audio file of your own that isn't copy-protected.
items.translation: Timbre 無法播放這個檔案。請使用你自己擁有、且未受複製保護的音訊檔案。

items.key: This removes saved sessions, streaks and voice progress from this device.
items.source: This removes saved sessions, streaks and voice progress from this device.
items.translation: 這會從此裝置移除已儲存的練習、連續紀錄和嗓音進度。

items.key: Every lesson and song, every tuning and tool.
items.source: Every lesson and song, every tuning and tool.
items.translation: 所有課堂與歌曲、所有調弦與工具。

items.key: Tune by feel pulses at the beat between the string and its note, slower as they meet, still at the lock.
items.source: Tune by feel pulses at the beat between the string and its note, slower as they meet, still at the lock.
items.translation: 觸覺調音會依琴弦與目標音的拍頻產生脈動；兩者越接近，脈動越慢，音準鎖定時便停止。

items.key: Capo and transposition change the names you see, never the pitch Timbre measures.
items.source: Capo and transposition change the names you see, never the pitch Timbre measures.
items.translation: 移調夾與移調只會改變顯示的音名，不會改變 Timbre 測量的音高。

items.key: Enter a value from 415 to 466 Hz.
items.source: Enter a value from 415 to 466 Hz.
items.translation: 請輸入 415 至 466 Hz 之間的數值。

items.context: "Expert", not "Pro": the level is a Timbre Pro feature, so "Pro" read as the plan, not the precision.

items.key: Simple tuner shows the tuner on its own. Calm mode leaves out XP, levels, quests and streaks; your stars and badges stay.
items.source: Simple tuner shows the tuner on its own. Calm mode leaves out XP, levels, quests and streaks; your stars and badges stay.
items.translation: 簡易調音器只顯示調音功能。平靜模式會隱藏 XP、等級、任務與連續紀錄；你的星星和徽章仍會保留。

items.key: One gentle nudge a day, at a time you choose.
items.source: One gentle nudge a day, at a time you choose.
items.translation: 每天在你選擇的時間，輕輕提醒一次。

items.context: Note names follow the language until the player picks a system (German reads B natural as H).

items.key: Microphone audio is analysed on this device. Recordings are never saved or uploaded.
items.source: Microphone audio is analysed on this device. Recordings are never saved or uploaded.
items.translation: 麥克風音訊會在此裝置上分析，絕不儲存或上傳錄音。

items.key: Which features get used, never audio or anything linked to you.
items.source: Which features get used, never audio or anything linked to you.
items.translation: 僅分享功能使用情況，絕不包含音訊或可識別你的資訊。

items.key: Strict confidence asks for a clearer note before showing a reading. Larger windows read lower notes with a little more delay.
items.source: Strict confidence asks for a clearer note before showing a reading. Larger windows read lower notes with a little more delay.
items.translation: 嚴格信心門檻需要更清晰的音符才會顯示讀值。較大的分析視窗能讀取更低的音，但延遲會稍長。

items.key: The song exercise uses a phrase from Beethoven's public-domain Ode to Joy.
items.source: The song exercise uses a phrase from Beethoven's public-domain Ode to Joy.
items.translation: 歌曲練習使用貝多芬公有領域作品《歡樂頌》的一段樂句。

items.key: Instruments without a credit are modelled and rendered from code for Timbre.
items.source: Instruments without a credit are modelled and rendered from code for Timbre.
items.translation: 未標示出處的樂器皆為 Timbre 以程式碼建模並算繪。

items.key: %@ · rigged, relit and rendered for Timbre
items.source: %@ · rigged, relit and rendered for Timbre
items.translation: %@ · 為 Timbre 綁定骨架、重新打光並算繪

items.key: Recorded instruments, shared under CC0 by their makers.
items.source: Recorded instruments, shared under CC0 by their makers.
items.translation: 由製作者以 CC0 授權分享的樂器錄音。

items.source: Instrument artwork was supplied for this app. Space Grotesk, Inter and IBM Plex Mono are bundled under the SIL Open Font License. License notices are included with the app.
items.translation: 本 App 的樂器美術由專人提供。Space Grotesk、Inter 和 IBM Plex Mono 依 SIL Open Font License 隨附，授權聲明包含在 App 中。
由 Shahrad Azeri Sharghi 開發

items.source: Session dates, selected instruments and measured practice summaries are stored locally. They help you return to an instrument and review your practice. Clearing this app's storage in Android Settings removes local history and preferences.
items.translation: 練習日期、選取的樂器和測量所得的練習摘要會儲存在本機，方便你再次練習同一種樂器並回顧練習。在 Android 設定中清除此 App 的儲存空間，會移除本機紀錄與偏好設定。

items.source: Microphone sound is analysed on your device to estimate pitch. Audio is not saved or uploaded. Microphone access stops when you leave an active tuning or practice screen. You can revoke access in Android Settings.
items.translation: 麥克風聲音會在你的裝置上分析，以估計音高。音訊不會儲存或上傳。離開正在使用的調音或練習畫面後，麥克風存取就會停止。你可以在 Android 設定中撤銷權限。

items.source: The full instrument collection, singing practice and Studio are available through one permanent purchase, with no recurring charge. Google Play handles payment and purchase restoration. Open Purchase and restore in Settings to restore your access. If you already own an older subscription, its management remains available through Google Play.
items.translation: 一次永久購買即可使用完整樂器收藏、歌唱練習與工作室，無須定期付費。Google Play 會處理付款與購買項目回復。若要回復存取權，請在設定中開啟購買與回復。若你已擁有舊版訂閱，仍可透過 Google Play 管理。
完整隱私權政策與支援

items.source: Review access is active on this device.
items.translation: 此裝置已啟用審查存取權。

items.source: Enter the code provided in Google Play's reviewer instructions.
items.translation: 輸入 Google Play 審查人員說明中提供的代碼。

items.source: Instrument tuning, voice practice and rhythm tools.
items.translation: 樂器調音、嗓音練習與節奏工具。

items.source: Pitch readings depend on your microphone, room noise and instrument. Wait for a stable reading and tune gently. Singing feedback measures pitch and steadiness; it is not a medical assessment or a measurement of breath support.
items.translation: 音高讀值會受麥克風、環境噪音與樂器影響。請等讀值穩定，再輕輕調音。歌唱回饋會測量音高與穩定度，不是醫療評估，也不代表氣息支撐的測量。

items.source: The free instruments remain available. Restore purchases if you expected access on this account.
items.translation: 免費樂器仍可使用。若你預期此帳號應有存取權，請回復購買項目。

items.source: Restore purchases to check this Google account.
items.translation: 回復購買項目以檢查此 Google 帳號。

items.source: Ad privacy choices could not load. Please try again.
items.translation: 無法載入廣告隱私權選項，請再試一次。

items.source: Listening… Hold a steady note near the microphone.
items.translation: 聆聽中…請在麥克風附近保持穩定的音。

items.source: Your session could not be saved.
Microphone access is needed to hear your instrument. Tap Allow to tune. Without it you can still browse instruments and set up tunings.
items.translation: 需要麥克風權限才能聽見你的樂器。點選允許即可調音。未允許時，你仍可瀏覽樂器與設定調弦。

items.source: No signal. Play or sing a note and hold it.
items.translation: 沒有訊號。請演奏或唱出一個音，並保持住。
第 %1$d 個音符，共 %2$d 個

items.source: The microphone measures pitch in real time. Your audio stays on this device and is never recorded or uploaded.
items.translation: 麥克風會即時測量音高。音訊會留在此裝置上，絕不錄製或上傳。

items.source: Check that your oud and strings are made for Turkish tuning. Do not raise an Arabic string set to these notes.
items.translation: 請確認你的烏德琴與琴弦適用於土耳其式調弦。不要將阿拉伯式琴弦調高至這些音。

items.source: Paused. The microphone is off and your last reading is kept.
items.translation: 已暫停。麥克風已關閉，並保留上次讀值。

items.source: Listen to the reference, then play your note.
items.translation: 先聆聽參考音，再演奏你的音符。

items.source: Microphone access is off. Enable it in Android Settings to tune. You can still browse instruments and set up tunings.
items.translation: 麥克風權限已關閉。請在 Android 設定中啟用以進行調音。你仍可瀏覽樂器與設定調弦。

items.source: We could not load a tuning preset.
Listening is stopped. You can tune again whenever you are ready.
items.translation: 聆聽已停止。準備好時，隨時可以再次調音。

items.source: Almost there. Hold steady to confirm.
items.translation: 快到了。保持穩定以確認。

items.source: The instrument, target notes and reference tones change together.
items.translation: 樂器、目標音符與參考音會一起改變。

items.source: Can't hear it clearly — move closer or reduce noise
items.translation: 聽不清楚，請靠近一點或減少噪音

items.source: One purchase unlocks all instruments and tunings, singing practice and Studio. No subscription.
items.translation: 一次購買即可解鎖所有樂器與調弦、歌唱練習與工作室，無須訂閱。

items.source: Ads are removed after the full unlock.
items.translation: 完整解鎖後即會移除廣告。

items.source: The full collection and alternate tunings.
Interactive practice and your complete toolkit.
items.translation: 互動練習與完整工具組。

items.source: Purchases are not available on this device or Google account.
items.translation: 此裝置或 Google 帳號無法購買。

items.source: Google Play confirmation is taking longer than expected. Restore purchases to check again.
items.translation: Google Play 確認所需的時間比預期更久。請回復購買項目以重新檢查。

items.source: We could not confirm your purchase yet. Restore purchases to check again.
items.translation: 尚無法確認你的購買項目。請回復購買項目以重新檢查。

items.source: Finish your current session to view purchases.
items.translation: 請先完成目前的練習，再查看購買項目。

items.source: You already own the full unlock on this Google account. Restore purchases if access has not appeared.
items.translation: 此 Google 帳號已擁有完整解鎖。若尚未取得存取權，請回復購買項目。

items.source: The permanent unlock is unavailable from Google Play. Refresh to check its availability.
items.translation: Google Play 目前未提供永久解鎖。請重新整理以查看是否可購買。

items.source: Open Google Play, then Payments & subscriptions, to manage your existing subscription.
items.translation: 開啟 Google Play，再前往付款與訂閱，以管理現有訂閱。

items.source: Check Google Play and try again.
items.translation: 請檢查 Google Play 後再試。

items.source: This purchase is not available on this Google account.
items.translation: 此 Google 帳號無法購買此項目。

items.source: Google Play declined the payment. Check your payment method in Google Play.
items.translation: Google Play 拒絕付款。請在 Google Play 中檢查付款方式。

items.source: Payment is pending. Access starts when Google Play confirms it.
items.translation: 付款處理中。Google Play 確認後即可開始使用。

items.source: Google Play could not complete this purchase. Check Google Play before trying again.
items.translation: Google Play 無法完成這筆購買。請先檢查 Google Play，再重新嘗試。

items.source: Purchase received. Checking your access with Google Play.
items.translation: 已收到購買項目，正在向 Google Play 確認存取權。

items.source: Google Play took too long to respond. Restore purchases to check your access before trying again.
items.translation: Google Play 回應時間過長。重試前，請先回復購買項目以檢查存取權。

items.source: Google Play is unavailable. Check your connection and try again.
items.translation: Google Play 無法使用。請檢查連線後再試。

items.source: This screen does not erase your saved progress.
items.translation: 此畫面不會清除已儲存的進度。

items.source: A crash report was saved on this device for support.
items.translation: 已在此裝置儲存當機報告，供支援人員參考。

items.source: Using your previously confirmed purchase. Google Play will be checked again when you reconnect.
items.translation: 正在使用先前已確認的購買項目。重新連線後，將再次向 Google Play 檢查。

items.source: Google Play is processing your payment. All features become available when it is confirmed. Please do not purchase again.
items.translation: Google Play 正在處理付款。確認後即可使用所有功能，請勿重複購買。

items.source: Google Play refunded this purchase. The free instruments remain available.
items.translation: Google Play 已退還這筆購買款項，免費樂器仍可使用。

items.source: Your existing purchase still includes all features. Google Play manages its renewal and cancellation.
items.translation: 你現有的購買項目仍包含所有功能。續訂與取消由 Google Play 管理。

items.source: The instrument collection could not be loaded.
All instruments, singing practice and Studio are unlocked. Advertising is off.
items.translation: 所有樂器、歌唱練習與工作室均已解鎖，廣告已關閉。

items.source: One purchase opens every instrument, singing practice and Studio and removes ads.
items.translation: 一次購買即可使用所有樂器、歌唱練習與工作室，並移除廣告。

items.source: Guitar, four-string bass and ukulele stay free. Ads appear after completed tuning sessions.
items.translation: 吉他、四弦貝斯與烏克麗麗維持免費。廣告會在完成調音後顯示。

items.source: Connecting to Google Play for your local price.
items.translation: 正在連線至 Google Play 取得當地價格。

items.source: One payment. No subscription. Google Play shows the price before you pay.
items.translation: 一次付款，無須訂閱。Google Play 會在付款前顯示價格。

items.source: Google Play has not provided a purchase price. You can still restore an existing purchase.
items.translation: Google Play 尚未提供購買價格。你仍可回復現有的購買項目。
降 E 調中音薩克斯風
降 B 調次中音薩克斯風

items.source: %1$@ cents closer to the target on average.
items.translation: 平均更接近目標 %1$@ 音分。

items.source: %1$@ cents farther from the target on average.
items.translation: 平均離目標更遠 %1$@ 音分。
平均音高準確度沒有變化。

items.source: Not enough measured practice to compare yet.
items.translation: 目前測量的練習還不足以比較。

items.source: Compared with the previous two weeks on this instrument.
items.translation: 與使用這種樂器的前兩週相比。
每日練習 · 最高長條 %1$@
平均音高偏差 %1$@ 音分

items.source: No recent sessions for this instrument. Your next practice will appear here.
items.translation: 最近沒有這種樂器的練習紀錄。下次練習會顯示在這裡。

items.source: No stable pitch measurement in this session.
items.translation: 這次練習沒有穩定的音高測量結果。

items.source: Sessions in the last two weeks: %1$d

items.translation: 測得的音高中有 %1$d%% 保持穩定

items.source: Purchase restored. Full access is ready.
items.translation: 購買項目已回復，可開始完整使用。

items.source: No purchase found for this Google account. If you paid with a different account, switch accounts in Google Play and try again.
items.translation: 此 Google 帳號找不到購買項目。若使用其他帳號付款，請在 Google Play 切換帳號後再試。

items.source: Your purchase was found. Google Play is still confirming the payment.
items.translation: 已找到購買項目，Google Play 仍在確認付款。

items.source: Google Play could not be reached. Your access is unchanged. Try restoring again when you are online.
items.translation: 無法連線至 Google Play。你的存取權沒有變更，連上網路後請再試著回復。

items.source: All features are available for review on this device.
items.translation: 此裝置可使用所有功能以供審查。

items.source: Enter a number from 415 to 466 Hz.
items.translation: 請輸入 415 至 466 Hz 之間的數值。
關於 App 與隱私權

items.source: Use your device language, or choose one for this app.
items.translation: 使用裝置語言，或為此 App 選擇語言。

items.source: A higher threshold asks for a clearer note before showing a reading.
items.translation: 門檻越高，需要越清晰的音符才會顯示讀值。

items.source: Three instruments are available without a purchase. One purchase opens the full collection, singing practice and Studio.
items.translation: 三種樂器無須購買即可使用。一次購買即可解鎖完整收藏、歌唱練習與工作室。

items.source: Microphone audio is analysed on this device. Recordings are not saved or uploaded.
items.translation: 麥克風音訊會在此裝置上分析，不會儲存或上傳錄音。

items.source: Choose a concert pitch or enter a value from 415 to 466 Hz.
items.translation: 選擇基準音高，或輸入 415 至 466 Hz 之間的數值。

items.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb needs three notes: open string 2 is B, fret 2 on string 3 is A, and open string 3 is G. Your second finger plays the A.

items.translation: 《瑪莉有隻小綿羊》只需要三個音：第 2 弦空弦是 B，第 3 弦第 2 品是 A，第 3 弦空弦是 G。用中指按弦彈出 A。

items.source: String 3, fret 2, second finger. That's A.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · song gtr-1-6 “Mary Had a Little Lamb: three notes” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第 3 弦、第 2 品，用中指，這就是 A。

items.source: B A G A B B B: open string 2, then string 3.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · song gtr-1-6 “Mary Had a Little Lamb: three notes” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: B A G A B B B：先用第 2 弦空弦，再換第 3 弦。

items.source: String 2 works like string 1. Open, it's B. Fret 1 with your first finger is C. Fret 3 with your third finger is D.

items.translation: 第 2 弦與第 1 弦的方式相同。空弦是 B，用食指按第 1 品是 C，用無名指按第 3 品是 D。

items.source: String 2, fret 1, first finger. That's C.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-1 “Three notes on string 2” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第 2 弦、第 1 品，用食指，這就是 C。

items.source: String 2, fret 3, third finger. That's D.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-1 “Three notes on string 2” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第 2 弦、第 3 品，用無名指，這就是 D。

items.translation: 一根手指負責一品：第 1 品用第 1 指，第 2 品用第 2 指，第 3 品用第 3 指。

items.source: In tab, a 3 on the top line means…

items.translation: 指法譜最上方的線上寫著 3，代表…

items.translation: 最上方的線是最細的第 1 弦，數字代表品位。

items.source: A half note rings for two beats. Pick once, count one, two, and let it sustain until the next note.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-3 “Long and short notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 二分音符要響兩拍。撥一次，數一、二，讓聲音持續到下一個音符。

items.translation: 四拍小節的一半是兩拍，四分音符則持續一拍。

items.source: Going from string 2 to string 1 is a tiny move. Keep your picking hand close to the strings so the next note is ready.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-3 “Long and short notes” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 從第 2 弦換到第 1 弦只需要小幅移動。撥弦手靠近琴弦，就能準備好下一個音。

items.source: Fret 3 on string 2, then open string 1. Lift your finger as you pick.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-3 “Long and short notes” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 先彈第 2 弦第 3 品，再彈第 1 弦空弦。撥弦時抬起按弦手指。

items.source: C and D on string 2, then E, F and G on string 1.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-3 “Long and short notes” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 先彈第 2 弦的 C、D，再彈第 1 弦的 E、F、G。

items.source: This melody comes from Beethoven's Ninth Symphony. It uses C, D, E, F and G, and it moves mostly one step at a time.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · song gtr-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 這段旋律出自貝多芬第九號交響曲。它使用 C、D、E、F、G，大多每次只移動一級。

items.source: The first line, slowly: E E F G G F E D.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · song gtr-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 慢慢彈第一行：E E F G G F E D。

items.source: Then: C C D E E D D.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · song gtr-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 接著：C C D E E D D。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · song gtr-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: Each line ends with a lilt: a longer note, a quick one, then a held one. Count one-and-two, and slip the quick note in on the and.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · song gtr-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 每行結尾都有輕快起伏：一個較長的音、一個短音，再一個延長的音。數一又二，把短音放在「又」上。

items.translation: 這首兒歌在 C、D、E 之間行進，再跳上 G。這個跳進是從第 1 弦空弦到第 3 品。

items.source: E D C D E E E: open string 1, down to string 2 and back.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · song gtr-2-5 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: E D C D E E E：從第 1 弦空弦到第 2 弦，再回來。

items.source: D D D on string 2, then E and G on string 1.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · song gtr-2-5 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 在第 2 弦彈 D D D，再到第 1 弦彈 E、G。

items.source: Letters in a Shoebox is a Timbre Original, a slow ballad in C. Its chorus lives on strings 1 and 2, and its hook opens with the long, short lilt you played in Ode to Joy. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-spotlight “Song spotlight: Letters in a Shoebox” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 《鞋盒裡的信》是 Timbre 原創歌曲，一首 C 調慢板抒情曲。副歌在第 1、2 弦上，記憶點樂句以《歡樂頌》中練過的長短節奏開頭。完整歌曲在歌曲頁面的原創歌曲中。

items.source: The hook: C and D on string 2, then E, F and G on string 1, and back to D.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-spotlight “Song spotlight: Letters in a Shoebox” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 記憶點樂句：第 2 弦上的 C、D，接著第 1 弦上的 E、F、G，再回到 D。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 “First chords” · title

items.source: E minor, E, A minor and A, played cleanly, and your first chord changes.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 “First chords” · unit summary
items.translation: 乾淨地彈出 E 小和弦、E、A 小和弦與 A，並練習初次換和弦。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-1 “Clean chords” · title
Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-1 “Clean chords” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Press with your fingertips, arched like a bridge, so no finger leans on the string below it. Short nails make this much easier.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-1 “Clean chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 用指尖按弦，手指像橋一樣拱起，避免碰到下方的琴弦。剪短指甲會容易許多。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-1 “Clean chords” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Pick the strings one at a time, thick to thin. A dull thud means a finger is touching that string. Adjust and pick it again.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-1 “Clean chords” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 從粗到細逐條撥弦。若聲音悶悶的，表示有手指碰到那條弦。調整後再撥一次。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-1 “Clean chords” · step 4 (along) · title

items.source: One string sounds dull. What's the likely cause?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-1 “Clean chords” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 有一條弦聲音悶悶的，可能是什麼原因？

items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-1 “Clean chords” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-1 “Clean chords” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-1 “Clean chords” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A fingertip leaning on a neighboring string stops it ringing. Arch your fingers more.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-1 “Clean chords” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 指尖碰到相鄰琴弦，會讓它無法響亮發聲。把手指再拱起一些。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-2 “E major: add one finger” · title
items.translation: E 大和弦：加一根手指

items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-2 “E major: add one finger” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Keep your E minor shape and add your first finger on string 3, fret 1. That one note turns minor into major.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-2 “E major: add one finger” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 保留 E 小和弦指型，加上食指按住第 3 弦第 1 品。這一個音就讓小和弦變成大和弦。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-2 “E major: add one finger” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Major chords tend to sound bright and settled. Minor chords sound darker. E and E minor differ by just one note.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-2 “E major: add one finger” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 大和弦通常聽起來明亮、安定，小和弦較暗沉。E 與 E 小和弦只差一個音。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-2 “E major: add one finger” · step 4 (listen) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-2 “E major: add one finger” · step 4 (listen) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-2 “E major: add one finger” · step 4 (listen) · quiz answer

Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-3 “A minor” · title
Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-3 “A minor” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A minor is the E shape moved one string thinner: fingers 2 and 3 on fret 2, finger 1 on string 2, fret 1.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-3 “A minor” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: A 小和弦是把 E 指型往細弦方向移一條弦：第 2、3 指按第 2 品，第 1 指按第 2 弦第 1 品。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-3 “A minor” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: The root is the note a chord is named after. In A minor it's open string 5, so start your strum there and skip string 6.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-3 “A minor” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 根音是和弦命名所依據的音。A 小和弦的根音是第 5 弦空弦，因此從這裡開始掃弦，略過第 6 弦。

items.source: Which string do you skip in A minor?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-3 “A minor” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: A 小和弦要略過哪條弦？

items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-3 “A minor” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-3 “A minor” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-3 “A minor” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A minor's root is open string 5. Start the strum there.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-3 “A minor” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: A 小和弦的根音是第 5 弦空弦，從這裡開始掃弦。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-3 “A minor” · step 5 (listen) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-3 “A minor” · step 6 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-4 “A major” · title
Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-4 “A major” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A packs fingers 1, 2 and 3 side by side on fret 2, on strings 4, 3 and 2. Strum from string 5.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-4 “A major” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: A 將第 1、2、3 指並排在第 2 品，分別按第 4、3、2 弦。從第 5 弦開始掃。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-4 “A major” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: If your fingers feel cramped, slant them so each sits just behind the fret at a slight angle. Keep string 1 clear so it rings.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-4 “A major” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 若手指覺得擠，可以稍微斜放，讓每根手指都靠在品絲後方。別碰到第 1 弦，讓它清楚發聲。

items.source: Which fret holds all three fingers in A?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-4 “A major” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: A 和弦的三根手指都在哪一品？

items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-4 “A major” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-4 “A major” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-4 “A major” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: From E minor to A minor
items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-5 “From E minor to A minor” · title
items.translation: 從 E 小和弦到 A 小和弦

items.source: Move the shape, not the fingers
items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-5 “From E minor to A minor” · step 1 (explain) · title
items.translation: 移動整個指型，不逐指移動

items.source: From E minor to A minor, fingers 2 and 3 hop together to strings 4 and 3. Then finger 1 lands on string 2. Your hand barely moves.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-5 “From E minor to A minor” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 從 E 小和弦換到 A 小和弦時，第 2、3 指一起移到第 4、3 弦，再將第 1 指放到第 2 弦。整隻手幾乎不必移動。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-5 “From E minor to A minor” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: Strum once, then use the rest of the bar to change. Aim to land the new chord right on beat one. Speed comes later, by itself.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-5 “From E minor to A minor” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 掃弦一次，利用小節剩餘的時間換和弦。目標是讓新和弦正好在第一拍到位。熟悉後，速度自然會提升。

items.source: How should your fingers travel between chords?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-5 “From E minor to A minor” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 換和弦時，手指應該怎麼移動？

items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-5 “From E minor to A minor” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-5 “From E minor to A minor” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-5 “From E minor to A minor” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Moving the fingers as a unit is faster and lands cleaner. Keep them low, just above the strings.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-5 “From E minor to A minor” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 把手指當成一組來移動，速度更快、落點更乾淨。保持低姿態，就在琴弦上方移動。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-6 “From A to E” · title
Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-6 “From A to E” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Every finger moves from A to E. Picture the E shape before you lift, then move all three together. Aim finger 2 at string 5.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-6 “From A to E” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 從 A 換到 E，每根手指都要動。抬手前先想像 E 指型，再將三根手指一起移動，第 2 指對準第 5 弦。

items.source: Song spotlight: Dust on the Dashboard
items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-spotlight “Song spotlight: Dust on the Dashboard” · title
items.translation: 歌曲焦點：儀表板上的塵埃

items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-spotlight “Song spotlight: Dust on the Dashboard” · step 1 (explain) · title
items.translation: E 與 A 的鄉村曲風

items.source: Dust on the Dashboard is a Timbre Original: country in A. Every verse ends on two bars of E and two of A, the change you just learned. See the shape, move early and land on beat one. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-spotlight “Song spotlight: Dust on the Dashboard” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 《儀表板上的塵埃》是 Timbre 原創歌曲，一首 A 調鄉村曲。每段主歌都以兩小節 E、兩小節 A 結尾，正是你剛學會的切換。想好指型、提早移動，在第一拍到位。完整歌曲在歌曲頁面的原創歌曲中。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-spotlight “Song spotlight: Dust on the Dashboard” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction

items.source: Over E: open B, open E, D at fret 3 on string 2, C sharp at fret 2, then G sharp at fret 1 on string 3.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-spotlight “Song spotlight: Dust on the Dashboard” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 搭配 E：空弦 B、空弦 E，第 2 弦第 3 品的 D、第 2 品的升 C，再到第 3 弦第 1 品的升 G。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-spotlight “Song spotlight: Dust on the Dashboard” · step 6 (along) · title

Guitar · Unit 3 · challenge gtr-3-7 “Chord-change challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: No new ideas: E minor, E, A minor and A. Land each shape cleanly, then keep the changes steady.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · challenge gtr-3-7 “Chord-change challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 沒有新內容：E 小和弦、E、A 小和弦與 A。每個指型都先按乾淨，再保持穩定切換。

items.source: Which finger turns E minor into E?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · challenge gtr-3-7 “Chord-change challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 哪根手指能把 E 小和弦變成 E？

items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · challenge gtr-3-7 “Chord-change challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 3 · challenge gtr-3-7 “Chord-change challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 3 · challenge gtr-3-7 “Chord-change challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Finger 1 on string 3, fret 1 is the one note that makes E major.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · challenge gtr-3-7 “Chord-change challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 第 1 指按第 3 弦第 1 品，就是讓它成為 E 大和弦的那個音。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 “Strumming” · title

items.source: Downstrokes, down-up eighths, accents and a strumming hand that never stops.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 “Strumming” · unit summary
items.translation: 下撥、上下八分音符、重音，以及不停擺動的掃弦手。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-1 “One strum per beat” · title
Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-1 “One strum per beat” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A quarter note lasts one beat. Strum down on every beat and count out loud: one, two, three, four.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-1 “One strum per beat” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 四分音符持續一拍。每拍向下掃，並大聲數：一、二、三、四。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-1 “One strum per beat” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: Let the motion come from a loose wrist and forearm, like shaking water off your hand. A stiff arm sounds harsh.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-1 “One strum per beat” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 讓放鬆的手腕與前臂帶動，就像甩掉手上的水。手臂僵硬會讓聲音生硬。

items.source: How many quarter-note strums fill a bar of four?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-1 “One strum per beat” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 四拍小節可掃幾次四分音符？

items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-1 “One strum per beat” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-1 “One strum per beat” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-2 “Down and up” · title
Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-2 “Down and up” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Split each beat in two. Strum down on the number and up on the and: one and two and. That's eight strums per bar.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-2 “Down and up” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 將每拍分成兩半。數字時向下掃，「又」時向上掃：一又二又。這樣每小節共掃八次。

items.source: Where does the up strum fall?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-2 “Down and up” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-2 “Down and up” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-2 “Down and up” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-2 “Down and up” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Down on the number, up on the and. Your hand goes down and up once per beat.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-2 “Down and up” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 數字時向下，「又」時向上。每拍手都往下再往上一次。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-2 “Down and up” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: Up strums are naturally softer. Brush just the thinner three or four strings on the way up. That gives the groove its lift.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-2 “Down and up” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 向上掃弦自然比較柔和，回程只輕掃較細的三、四條弦，能讓律動更輕盈。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-3 “Accent beat one” · title
Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-3 “Accent beat one” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: An accent is a note played a little louder. Strum beat one harder than the rest. It tells everyone where the bar begins.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-3 “Accent beat one” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 重音就是稍微大聲一點的音。第一拍比其他拍掃得更有力，讓大家知道小節從哪裡開始。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-3 “Accent beat one” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-3 “Accent beat one” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-3 “Accent beat one” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-3 “Accent beat one” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Beat one starts the bar. A slightly louder first strum keeps you, and anyone listening, in time.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-3 “Accent beat one” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 第一拍是小節的起點。第一下稍微大聲一點，能讓你和聽的人都跟上節拍。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-3 “Accent beat one” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: Say the bar number on beat one: one, two, three, four; two, two, three, four. You always know where you are.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-3 “Accent beat one” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 在第一拍說出小節數：一、二、三、四；二、二、三、四。這樣隨時都知道彈到哪裡。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-4 “Keep the hand moving” · title
Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-4 “Keep the hand moving” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Your strumming hand swings down and up all the time, like a pendulum. To skip a strum, keep swinging and simply miss the strings.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-4 “Keep the hand moving” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 掃弦手一直像鐘擺般上下擺動。想略過一次掃弦時，繼續擺動，只要不碰琴弦即可。

items.source: To skip a strum, your hand…
items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-4 “Keep the hand moving” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: Keeps moving and misses the strings
items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-4 “Keep the hand moving” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-4 “Keep the hand moving” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-4 “Keep the hand moving” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A hand that never stops keeps steady time. The skipped strum is a swing that doesn't touch the strings.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-4 “Keep the hand moving” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 手不停，節奏就穩。略過的掃弦只是一次沒有碰到琴弦的擺動。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-5 “The folk strum” · title
Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-5 “The folk strum” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: This pattern drives countless songs. On beat three your hand swings down without touching the strings, then catches the up strum.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-5 “The folk strum” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 這個節奏型帶動了無數歌曲。第三拍手往下擺但不碰弦，接著在回程向上掃。

items.source: In this pattern, which beat has no strum on the number?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-5 “The folk strum” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 這個節奏型的哪一拍，數字上沒有掃弦？

items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-5 “The folk strum” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-5 “The folk strum” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: On three the hand swings down past the strings, then strums up on the and.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-5 “The folk strum” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 第三拍手往下擺、略過琴弦，再於「又」向上掃。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-spotlight “Song spotlight: Low Tide Radio” · title
Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-spotlight “Song spotlight: Low Tide Radio” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Low Tide Radio is a Timbre Original: laid-back reggae on E minor and A. The guitar plays only the ands. Keep your hand swinging down and up, miss the strings on each number and catch every and. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-spotlight “Song spotlight: Low Tide Radio” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 《低潮電台》是 Timbre 原創歌曲，以 E 小和弦與 A 彈出放鬆的雷鬼風格。吉他只在「又」上演奏。手持續上下擺，數字時略過琴弦，每個「又」都掃到。完整歌曲在歌曲頁面的原創歌曲中。

items.source: Where does the guitar play in Low Tide Radio?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-spotlight “Song spotlight: Low Tide Radio” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 《低潮電台》的吉他在哪裡演奏？

items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-spotlight “Song spotlight: Low Tide Radio” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-spotlight “Song spotlight: Low Tide Radio” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-spotlight “Song spotlight: Low Tide Radio” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Bass and drums hold the numbers. The guitar answers between them, on the ands.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-spotlight “Song spotlight: Low Tide Radio” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 貝斯與鼓守住數字上的拍點，吉他在它們之間、也就是「又」上回應。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · challenge gtr-4-6 “Strumming challenge” · title

items.source: No new ideas: quarters, eighths and the folk strum on the chords you know. Keep the hand swinging and lean on beat one.

items.translation: 沒有新內容：用熟悉的和弦練四分音符、八分音符與民謠掃弦。手持續擺動，第一拍加重。

items.source: Down-up eighths: where are the up strums?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · challenge gtr-4-6 “Strumming challenge” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 上下八分音符中，向上掃弦在哪裡？

Guitar · Unit 5 “More open chords” · title

items.source: C, G, D and D minor, two classic progressions, and the one-minute change.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 “More open chords” · unit summary
items.translation: C、G、D 與 D 小和弦、兩種經典進行，以及一分鐘換和弦。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-1 “C major” · title
Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-1 “C major” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: C climbs like a staircase: finger 3 on string 5, fret 3; finger 2 on string 4, fret 2; finger 1 on string 2, fret 1.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-1 “C major” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: C 像樓梯一樣往上排：第 3 指按第 5 弦第 3 品，第 2 指按第 4 弦第 2 品，第 1 指按第 2 弦第 1 品。

items.source: Which string do you skip in C?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-1 “C major” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: C 和弦要略過哪條弦？

items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-1 “C major” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: C's root is on string 5, fret 3. Start the strum there.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-1 “C major” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: C 的根音在第 5 弦第 3 品，從這裡開始掃弦。

items.source: A minor to C: one finger
items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-1 “C major” · step 5 (explain) · title
items.translation: A 小和弦到 C：一根手指

items.source: Fingers 1 and 2 stay exactly where they are. Only finger 3 moves, from string 3 to string 5, fret 3.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-1 “C major” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 第 1、2 指完全不動，只有第 3 指從第 3 弦移到第 5 弦第 3 品。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-2 “G major” · title
Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-2 “G major” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: G spreads out: finger 2 on string 6, fret 3; finger 1 on string 5, fret 2; finger 3 on string 1, fret 3. All six strings ring.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-2 “G major” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: G 的指型較展開：第 2 指按第 6 弦第 3 品，第 1 指按第 5 弦第 2 品，第 3 指按第 1 弦第 3 品。六條弦都發聲。

items.source: In G, which strings ring open?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-2 “G major” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: G 和弦中，哪些弦是空弦？

items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-2 “G major” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-2 “G major” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-2 “G major” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-2 “G major” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: When you change, land the finger for the lowest string first. It's the first note your strum hits, which buys a moment for the rest.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-2 “G major” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 換和弦時，先放好最低音弦的手指。掃弦會先碰到這個音，讓其餘手指多一點時間就位。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-3 “D and D minor” · title
items.translation: D 與 D 小和弦

items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-3 “D and D minor” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: D lives on the thinnest three strings: finger 1 on string 3, fret 2; finger 3 on string 2, fret 3; finger 2 on string 1, fret 2.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-3 “D and D minor” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: D 在最細的三條弦上：第 1 指按第 3 弦第 2 品，第 3 指按第 2 弦第 3 品，第 2 指按第 1 弦第 2 品。

items.source: Where does a D chord's strum start?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-3 “D and D minor” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: D 和弦從哪條弦開始掃？

items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-3 “D and D minor” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: D's root is open string 4. Strings 5 and 6 stay quiet.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-3 “D and D minor” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: D 的根音是第 4 弦空弦，第 5、6 弦保持安靜。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-3 “D and D minor” · step 5 (explain) · title
items.translation: D 小和弦：一個音降低

items.source: For D minor, the note on string 1 drops to fret 1. Reshuffle: finger 1 on string 1, finger 2 on string 3, finger 3 stays on string 2.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-3 “D and D minor” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: D 小和弦將第 1 弦的音降到第 1 品。重新安排：第 1 指按第 1 弦，第 2 指按第 3 弦，第 3 指留在第 2 弦。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-4 “G, C and D” · title
Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-4 “G, C and D” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A key is a song's home base. In the key of G, the chords G, C and D do most of the work. Countless folk and rock songs use only these three.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-4 “G, C and D” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 調性就像歌曲的家。在 G 調中，G、C、D 和弦就能完成大部分伴奏。無數民謠與搖滾歌曲只用這三個和弦。

items.source: You keep landing late on a change. What helps most?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-4 “G, C and D” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 換和弦總是太晚到位，怎麼做最有幫助？

items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-4 “G, C and D” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-4 “G, C and D” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-4 “G, C and D” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Slow, early changes build the habit. Speed follows on its own.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-4 “G, C and D” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 慢慢練、提早換，能養成動作習慣，速度自然會提升。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-5 “A minor, C, G, D” · title
Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-5 “A minor, C, G, D” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A progression is a chord sequence that repeats. A minor, C, G, D starts dark and brightens as it climbs.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-5 “A minor, C, G, D” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 和弦進行是會重複的和弦順序。A 小和弦、C、G、D 從暗沉開始，隨著上行逐漸明亮。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-5 “A minor, C, G, D” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: Away from the app, pick two chords and switch for one minute, one strum each. Count your clean changes and beat that score tomorrow. Start with D and D minor.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-5 “A minor, C, G, D” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 離開 App 後，挑兩個和弦切換一分鐘，每個掃一次。數出乾淨切換的次數，明天再超越它。先從 D 與 D 小和弦開始。

items.source: In a one-minute change, what do you count?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-5 “A minor, C, G, D” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 一分鐘換和弦時，要數什麼？

items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-spotlight “Song spotlight: Kite Weather” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Kite Weather is a Timbre Original: bright campfire pop on G, D, E minor and C, around and around. Change early, and land the finger for the lowest string first. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-spotlight “Song spotlight: Kite Weather” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 《放風箏的天氣》是 Timbre 原創歌曲，以 G、D、E 小和弦、C 不斷循環，帶來明亮的營火流行曲風。提早換和弦，最低音弦的手指先到位。完整歌曲在歌曲頁面的原創歌曲中。

items.source: Which chord in Kite Weather skips strings 5 and 6?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-spotlight “Song spotlight: Kite Weather” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 《放風箏的天氣》哪個和弦略過第 5、6 弦？

items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-spotlight “Song spotlight: Kite Weather” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: D's root is open string 4, so strings 5 and 6 stay quiet.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-spotlight “Song spotlight: Kite Weather” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: D 的根音是第 4 弦空弦，因此第 5、6 弦保持安靜。

items.source: The verse adds A on string 3, fret 2: the note finger 1 holds in D. Open G, A, then open B.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · lesson gtr-5-spotlight “Song spotlight: Kite Weather” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 主歌加入第 3 弦第 2 品的 A，也就是 D 和弦中第 1 指按的音。依序彈空弦 G、A，再彈空弦 B。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · challenge gtr-5-6 “Open-chord challenge” · title
Guitar · Unit 5 · challenge gtr-5-6 “Open-chord challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: No new ideas: C, G, D and D minor join E minor, E, A minor and A. Change early, strum steady and let each chord ring.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · challenge gtr-5-6 “Open-chord challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 沒有新內容：在 E 小和弦、E、A 小和弦與 A 之外，加入 C、G、D 和 D 小和弦。提早換、穩定掃，讓每個和弦響亮發聲。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 5 · challenge gtr-5-6 “Open-chord challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 哪個和弦略過第 5、6 弦？

items.source: G and A on string 3, D, E and F on string 4, the C major scale and two traditional tunes.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 “Melodies on strings 3 and 4” · unit summary
items.translation: 第 3 弦上的 G、A，第 4 弦上的 D、E、F，以及 C 大音階和兩首傳統曲。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-1 “Notes on string 3” · title
Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-1 “Notes on string 3” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Open string 3 is G. Put finger 2 on fret 2 and you get A. The same rule holds: the finger matches the fret.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-1 “Notes on string 3” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 第 3 弦空弦是 G，第 2 指按第 2 品就是 A。同樣的規則：手指對應品位。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-1 “Notes on string 3” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 撥第 3 弦空弦，這就是 G。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-1 “Notes on string 3” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: G and A on string 3, then B, C and D on string 2.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-1 “Notes on string 3” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 先彈第 3 弦的 G、A，再彈第 2 弦的 B、C、D。

items.source: G up to D and back
items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-1 “Notes on string 3” · step 6 (along) · title
items.translation: G 上行到 D 再回來

items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-2 “Notes on string 4” · title
Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-2 “Notes on string 4” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Open string 4 is D. Fret 2 is E and fret 3 is F. Keep your thumb low behind the neck so your fingers can reach.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-2 “Notes on string 4” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 第 4 弦空弦是 D，第 2 品是 E，第 3 品是 F。拇指在琴頸後方放低，手指就能伸到位置。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-2 “Notes on string 4” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 撥第 4 弦空弦，這就是 D。

items.source: Fret 2, then fret 3: E, then F.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-2 “Notes on string 4” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第 2 品，再第 3 品：E，再 F。

items.source: Open string 4 and string 2, fret 3 share which name?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-2 “Notes on string 4” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 第 4 弦空弦與第 2 弦第 3 品有什麼共同音名？

items.source: Both are D, an octave apart: the same note name, one higher than the other.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-2 “Notes on string 4” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 兩個都是 D，相差一個八度：音名相同，但其中一個比較高。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-2 “Notes on string 4” · step 5 (listen) · question or instruction

items.source: D, E and F on string 4, then G and A on string 3.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-2 “Notes on string 4” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 先彈第 4 弦的 D、E、F，再彈第 3 弦的 G、A。

Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-3 “The C major scale” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Put finger 3 on string 5, fret 3. That's C, the note the C major scale starts on.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-3 “The C major scale” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 將第 3 指放在第 5 弦第 3 品。這是 C，也是 C 大音階的起點。

items.source: String 5, fret 3, third finger. That's C.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-3 “The C major scale” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第 5 弦、第 3 品，用無名指，這就是 C。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-3 “The C major scale” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: A scale climbs note by note from one letter to the same letter an octave higher. C major uses only plain letter names: C D E F G A B C.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-3 “The C major scale” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 音階逐音上行，從一個字母音名走到高一個八度的同音名。C 大音階只使用沒有升降記號的音名：C D E F G A B C。

items.source: String 5 fret 3, then strings 4, 3 and 2. Go slowly.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-3 “The C major scale” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 從第 5 弦第 3 品開始，再到第 4、3、2 弦，慢慢彈。

items.source: How many different letter names are in C major?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-3 “The C major scale” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: C 大音階有幾個不同的字母音名？

items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-3 “The C major scale” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-3 “The C major scale” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-3 “The C major scale” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: C D E F G A B, then C again an octave higher.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-3 “The C major scale” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: C D E F G A B，接著是高一個八度的 C。

Guitar · Unit 6 · song gtr-6-4 “When the Saints Go Marching In” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: This traditional spiritual became a jazz standard. It uses C, D, E, F and G on strings 5, 4 and 3.

items.translation: 這首傳統靈歌後來成為爵士標準曲。它使用第 5、4、3 弦上的 C、D、E、F、G。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · song gtr-6-4 “When the Saints Go Marching In” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 弱起是引向強拍的幾個音。這裡第一拍不發聲，由 C、E、F 引向延長的 G。

items.source: The chorus: E E D C, then C E G G G F.

items.translation: 副歌：E E D C，接著 C E G G G F。

items.source: Amazing Grace is in three: count one, two, three, with the weight on one. Its notes sit on strings 4, 3 and 2.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · song gtr-6-5 “Amazing Grace” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 《奇異恩典》是三拍子：數一、二、三，重心放在一。音符落在第 4、3、2 弦上。

items.source: How many beats are in each bar here?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · song gtr-6-5 “Amazing Grace” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: A bar of three feels like a gentle sway: strong, weak, weak.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · song gtr-6-5 “Amazing Grace” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 三拍小節像輕輕搖擺：強、弱、弱。

items.translation: 開頭：D、G、B G、B、A。使用第 4、3、2 弦空弦，再加 A。

items.source: The high part: open B up to D at fret 3, then down through B, G and A.

items.translation: 高音段落：從空弦 B 上行到第 3 品的 D，再經過 B、G、A 往下。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-spotlight “Song spotlight: Halogen” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 《鹵素光》是 Timbre 原創歌曲，一首 D 小調沙漠搖滾。反覆樂句用到剛學的音：空弦 D、第 3 品的 F、空弦 G，以及第 5 弦第 3 品的 C。完整歌曲在歌曲頁面的原創歌曲中。

items.source: Open string 4, F at fret 3, open string 3, then C at fret 3 on string 5.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-spotlight “Song spotlight: Halogen” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第 4 弦空弦、第 3 品的 F、第 3 弦空弦，再到第 5 弦第 3 品的 C。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 6 · lesson gtr-6-spotlight “Song spotlight: Halogen” · step 3 (along) · title

items.source: C major from string 5, up to G on string 1.

items.translation: 從第 5 弦開始彈 C 大音階，一路到第 1 弦的 G。

items.source: A mini F, D7, and two traditional songs with both chords and melody.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 “Songs with chords” · unit summary
items.translation: 簡易 F、D7，以及兩首兼有和弦與旋律的傳統歌曲。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-1 “The mini F” · title
Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-1 “The mini F” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: This small F uses four strings. Finger 1 lies flat across strings 1 and 2 at fret 1, finger 2 goes on string 3, fret 2, and finger 3 on string 4, fret 3.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-1 “The mini F” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 這個小 F 使用四條弦。第 1 指平按第 1、2 弦的第 1 品，第 2 指按第 3 弦第 2 品，第 3 指按第 4 弦第 3 品。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-1 “The mini F” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Tilt finger 1 slightly onto its thumb side. The bonier edge presses two strings more easily. Check that string 2 rings.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-1 “The mini F” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 將第 1 指稍微轉向拇指側。較硬的側緣更容易壓住兩條弦。檢查第 2 弦是否發聲。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-1 “The mini F” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: This progression climbs step by step from A minor and lands on your new F. Strum twice per chord and change early.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-1 “The mini F” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 這組和弦進行從 A 小和弦逐步上行，落在新學的 F。每個和弦掃兩次，提早切換。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-2 “Greensleeves: the chords” · title
Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-2 “Greensleeves: the chords” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: This English tune is over 400 years old. Its chords are all ones you know: A minor, C, G, E minor, F and E. It's in three: strum once per bar, then on every beat.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-2 “Greensleeves: the chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 這首英格蘭曲子已有超過 400 年歷史。和弦都是你會的：A 小和弦、C、G、E 小和弦、F 與 E。它是三拍子：先每小節掃一次，再每拍都掃。

items.source: Which strings does the mini F leave silent?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-2 “Greensleeves: the chords” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 簡易 F 哪些弦不發聲？

items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-2 “Greensleeves: the chords” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-2 “Greensleeves: the chords” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-2 “Greensleeves: the chords” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: The mini F starts on string 4. Begin your strum there and skip strings 5 and 6.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-2 “Greensleeves: the chords” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 簡易 F 從第 4 弦開始掃，略過第 5、6 弦。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-3 “Greensleeves: the melody” · title
Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-3 “Greensleeves: the melody” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A sharp raises a note by one fret. Greensleeves uses G sharp on string 3, fret 1, and F sharp on string 4, fret 4. Reach that one with your little finger.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-3 “Greensleeves: the melody” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 升音讓音符提高一品。《綠袖子》用到第 3 弦第 1 品的升 G，以及第 4 弦第 4 品的升 F。升 F 用小指伸過去按。

items.source: G sharp, A, B: string 3 at frets 1 and 2, then open string 2.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-3 “Greensleeves: the melody” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 升 G、A、B：第 3 弦第 1、2 品，再彈第 2 弦空弦。

items.source: The opening: A, C D, E F E, D B.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-3 “Greensleeves: the melody” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 開頭：A、C D、E F E、D B。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-3 “Greensleeves: the melody” · step 4 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-3 “Greensleeves: the melody” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-3 “Greensleeves: the melody” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-3 “Greensleeves: the melody” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-3 “Greensleeves: the melody” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Sharp means one fret higher. G sharp sits between G and A.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-3 “Greensleeves: the melody” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 升音代表提高一品，升 G 位於 G 與 A 之間。

items.source: The chorus starts high: G on string 1, fret 3, then F sharp at fret 2.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-3 “Greensleeves: the melody” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 副歌從高處開始：第 1 弦第 3 品的 G，再到第 2 品的升 F。

Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-3 “Greensleeves: the melody” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
items.translation: 傳統曲（英格蘭，1580 年代）

items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-4 “D7 and the Clementine chords” · title
items.translation: D7 與克萊門汀的和弦

items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-4 “D7 and the Clementine chords” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A seventh chord adds a note that pulls toward home. D7 wants to move to G. Fingers: 2 on string 3, fret 2; 1 on string 2, fret 1; 3 on string 1, fret 2.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-4 “D7 and the Clementine chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 七和弦多了一個帶著回家傾向的音。D7 想走向 G。指法：第 2 指按第 3 弦第 2 品，第 1 指按第 2 弦第 1 品，第 3 指按第 1 弦第 2 品。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-4 “D7 and the Clementine chords” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: This American ballad from the 1880s needs only G and D7. It's in three, like Amazing Grace. Strum once per bar, then on every beat.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-4 “D7 and the Clementine chords” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 這首來自 1880 年代的美國民謠只需要 G 和 D7。它像《奇異恩典》一樣是三拍子。先每小節掃一次，再每拍都掃。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-5 “Clementine” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Clementine's melody sits on strings 4, 3 and 2. Its last line uses F sharp again: string 4, fret 4, little finger.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-5 “Clementine” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 《克萊門汀》的旋律在第 4、3、2 弦上。最後一行再次用到升 F：第 4 弦第 4 品，用小指。

items.source: The opening: G G G, down to open D, up to open B.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-5 “Clementine” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 開頭：G G G，向下到空弦 D，再向上到空弦 B。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-5 “Clementine” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-5 “Clementine” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: D7's extra note leans toward G. When G arrives, the tension lets go.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-5 “Clementine” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: D7 多出的音傾向走向 G。G 出現時，緊張感就解除了。

items.source: The last line: A, open D, F sharp at fret 4, A, then home to G.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-5 “Clementine” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 最後一行：A、空弦 D、第 4 品的升 F、A，再回到 G。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-5 “Clementine” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-spotlight “Song spotlight: Ghost Light” · title
Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-spotlight “Song spotlight: Ghost Light” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Ghost Light is a Timbre Original: a slow, dark ballad. Its verse walks A minor, F, C and E, so your mini F gets a song, and the G sharp in E pulls the tune back home. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-spotlight “Song spotlight: Ghost Light” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 《幽光》是 Timbre 原創歌曲，一首緩慢而暗沉的抒情曲。主歌依序走過 A 小和弦、F、C、E，讓簡易 F 派上用場，而 E 中的升 G 會把旋律拉回家。完整歌曲在歌曲頁面的原創歌曲中。

items.source: Listen to the verse's last chord. Major or minor?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-spotlight “Song spotlight: Ghost Light” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction
items.translation: 聽主歌最後的和弦，是大和弦還是小和弦？

items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-spotlight “Song spotlight: Ghost Light” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: The ballad strum: one big strum on beat one and let it ring, another on three, then down-up on four. The space after each strum is part of the song.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-spotlight “Song spotlight: Ghost Light” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 抒情曲掃弦：第一拍有力掃一次，讓琴弦持續響；第三拍再掃一次，第四拍下上掃。每次掃弦後的空間也是歌曲的一部分。

items.source: The verse's last line: open B, C at fret 1, B, G sharp at fret 1 on string 3, B, then open E.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-spotlight “Song spotlight: Ghost Light” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 主歌最後一行：空弦 B、第 1 品的 C、B、第 3 弦第 1 品的升 G、B，再到空弦 E。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · challenge gtr-7-6 “Songbook challenge” · title
Guitar · Unit 7 · challenge gtr-7-6 “Songbook challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: No new ideas: the mini F, D7 and both songs from this unit. Change chords early and let the melodies sing.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · challenge gtr-7-6 “Songbook challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 沒有新內容：簡易 F、D7，以及本單元兩首歌曲。提早換和弦，讓旋律流暢歌唱。

items.source: Which chord pulls hardest toward G?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · challenge gtr-7-6 “Songbook challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 哪個和弦最強烈地引向 G？

items.source: E7, A7, G7 and B7, sus chords, the shuffle and your first 12-bar blues.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 “Seventh and sus chords” · unit summary
items.translation: E7、A7、G7、B7、掛留和弦、搖擺節奏，以及你的第一段 12 小節藍調。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-1 “E7 and A7” · title
Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-1 “E7 and A7” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Play E, then lift finger 3 off string 4. The open D that rings is the seventh, a note that adds bluesy tension.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-1 “E7 and A7” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 先彈 E，再把第 3 指從第 4 弦抬起。響起的空弦 D 是七音，增添藍調的緊張感。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-1 “E7 and A7” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-1 “E7 and A7” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: Play A, then lift finger 2 off string 3. Open G rings, and A becomes A7.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-1 “E7 and A7” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 先彈 A，再把第 2 指從第 3 弦抬起。空弦 G 響起，A 就變成 A7。

items.source: How do you turn E into E7 here?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-1 “E7 and A7” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 這裡如何把 E 變成 E7？

items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-1 “E7 and A7” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-1 “E7 and A7” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-2 “G7 and B7” · title
Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-2 “G7 and B7” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: G7 keeps the low G but puts F on top: finger 3 on string 6, fret 3; finger 2 on string 5, fret 2; finger 1 on string 1, fret 1.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-2 “G7 and B7” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: G7 保留低音 G，但最上方改成 F：第 3 指按第 6 弦第 3 品，第 2 指按第 5 弦第 2 品，第 1 指按第 1 弦第 1 品。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-2 “G7 and B7” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: Build B7 from string 5: finger 2 at fret 2, finger 1 on string 4, fret 1, finger 3 on string 3, fret 2, little finger on string 1, fret 2. String 2 rings open.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-2 “G7 and B7” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 從第 5 弦組出 B7：第 2 指按第 2 品，第 1 指按第 4 弦第 1 品，第 3 指按第 3 弦第 2 品，小指按第 1 弦第 2 品。第 2 弦空弦發聲。

items.source: Which chord does B7 lead to most naturally?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-2 “G7 and B7” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: B7 最自然地走向哪個和弦？

items.source: B7 pulls toward E. Its tension melts into E minor or E.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-2 “G7 and B7” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: B7 會引向 E，它的緊張感會在 E 小和弦或 E 中化解。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-3 “The shuffle” · title
Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-3 “The shuffle” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A shuffle splits each beat unevenly: a long strum down, a short one up. It's the heartbeat of the blues. Think hum-pty, dum-pty.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-3 “The shuffle” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 搖擺節奏將每拍不平均地分成兩段：向下掃較長，向上掃較短。這是藍調的心跳。想像 hum-pty、dum-pty 的長短律動。

items.source: In a shuffle, each beat splits into…
items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-3 “The shuffle” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-3 “The shuffle” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-3 “The shuffle” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-3 “The shuffle” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-4 “12-bar blues in E” · title
Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-4 “12-bar blues in E” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Many blues songs follow one 12-bar plan. In E: four bars of E7, two of A7, two of E7, then one each of B7, A7, E7 and B7.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-4 “12-bar blues in E” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 許多藍調歌曲都遵循同一種 12 小節架構。E 調依序是四小節 E7、兩小節 A7、兩小節 E7，最後 B7、A7、E7、B7 各一小節。

items.source: How many bars of E7 open the 12-bar blues?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-4 “12-bar blues in E” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 12 小節藍調開頭有幾小節 E7？

items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-4 “12-bar blues in E” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-4 “12-bar blues in E” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: The last four bars move faster: B7, A7, E7, then B7, which turns you around to the top. Change early and keep the shuffle going.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-4 “12-bar blues in E” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 最後四小節切換更快：B7、A7、E7，再用 B7 帶回開頭。提早換和弦，持續搖擺節奏。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-5 “Sus chords” · title
Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-5 “Sus chords” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A sus chord swaps the note that makes it major or minor for a neighbor. It sounds open and unresolved until it settles home.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-5 “Sus chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 掛留和弦把決定大或小的音換成相鄰音。聽起來開闊、尚未解決，直到回到穩定的和弦。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-5 “Sus chords” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-5 “Sus chords” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: Lift finger 2 off string 1 to get Dsus2. For Asus4, play A and add your little finger on string 2, fret 3.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-5 “Sus chords” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 把第 2 指從第 1 弦抬起，就得到 Dsus2。Asus4 則是按好 A，再加小指按第 2 弦第 3 品。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-spotlight “Song spotlight: Rust Belt Shuffle” · title
Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-spotlight “Song spotlight: Rust Belt Shuffle” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Rust Belt Shuffle is a Timbre Original: a 12-bar blues in E, the plan you just strummed, with a swung tune on top. Keep the long-short feel in both hands. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-spotlight “Song spotlight: Rust Belt Shuffle” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 《鏽帶搖擺》是 Timbre 原創歌曲：E 調 12 小節藍調，正是剛掃過的架構，上面再加搖擺旋律。雙手都保持長短的感覺。完整歌曲在歌曲頁面的原創歌曲中。

items.source: Open G, then G sharp at fret 1 on string 3, then open B: the bluesy slide in bar two.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-spotlight “Song spotlight: Rust Belt Shuffle” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 空弦 G，接著第 3 弦第 1 品的升 G，再到空弦 B：這是第二小節的藍調滑音。

items.source: Bar two slides from G to G sharp. Which one belongs to E7?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-spotlight “Song spotlight: Rust Belt Shuffle” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 第二小節從 G 滑到升 G，哪個音屬於 E7？

items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-spotlight “Song spotlight: Rust Belt Shuffle” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: E7 is E, G sharp, B and D. G is the blue note: it rubs against the chord, then slides into it.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-spotlight “Song spotlight: Rust Belt Shuffle” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: E7 由 E、升 G、B、D 組成。G 是藍調音，先與和弦產生摩擦，再滑進和弦音。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-spotlight “Song spotlight: Rust Belt Shuffle” · step 5 (along) · title

items.source: Bar nine, over B7: F sharp at fret 2 on string 1, open E, D sharp at fret 4 on string 2 with your little finger, then B.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-spotlight “Song spotlight: Rust Belt Shuffle” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第九小節搭配 B7：第 1 弦第 2 品的升 F、空弦 E，用小指按第 2 弦第 4 品的升 D，再到 B。

Guitar · Unit 8 · challenge gtr-8-6 “Blues challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Power chords, open and movable, palm muting and a riff of your own.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 “Power chords and riffs” · unit summary
items.translation: 開放與可移動強力和弦、掌根悶音，以及你自己的反覆樂句。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-1 “E5 and A5” · title
Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-1 “E5 and A5” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A power chord plays only the root and the fifth, the note five letters up. Neither major nor minor, it stays punchy, even loud. E5 is the bottom of E minor.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-1 “E5 and A5” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 強力和弦只彈根音與五音，也就是向上數五個字母的音。沒有大或小的性質，即使大聲演奏仍有衝擊力。E5 就是 E 小和弦的低音部分。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-1 “E5 and A5” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: Move the same two fingers to strings 4 and 3. With open string 5, that's A5. Aim your strum at strings 5, 4 and 3 only.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-1 “E5 and A5” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 將同樣兩根手指移到第 4、3 弦，搭配第 5 弦空弦，就是 A5。掃弦只對準第 5、4、3 弦。

items.source: Which notes make a power chord?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-1 “E5 and A5” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 強力和弦由哪些音組成？

items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-1 “E5 and A5” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
