Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-2 “Palm muting” · title

items.source: Rest the edge of your hand
items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-2 “Palm muting” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Lay the outer edge of your picking hand on the strings, right where they meet the bridge. Strum, and the notes turn short and chunky.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-2 “Palm muting” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 把撥弦手的外緣輕放在琴弦與琴橋交接處。掃弦後，音符會變得短促有力。

items.source: Where does your palm rest for palm muting?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-2 “Palm muting” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 掌根悶音時，手掌應放在哪裡？

items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-2 “Palm muting” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-2 “Palm muting” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-2 “Palm muting” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-2 “Palm muting” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: At the bridge the strings still sound, just shorter. Move forward and they go dead.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-2 “Palm muting” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 放在琴橋旁時，琴弦仍能發聲，只是較短。往前移，聲音就會消失。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-2 “Palm muting” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: Rock often builds with muted eighths, then lands on an open chord. Lift your palm for the big strum and let it ring.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-2 “Palm muting” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 搖滾常用悶音八分音符累積力道，再落在開放發聲的和弦上。有力掃弦時抬起掌根，讓聲音延續。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-3 “Movable power chords” · title
Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-3 “Movable power chords” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Finger 1 on string 6, fret 3, then fingers 3 and 4 two frets higher on strings 5 and 4. That's G5. Slide it and the name follows the fret.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-3 “Movable power chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 第 1 指按第 6 弦第 3 品，第 3、4 指在第 5、4 弦上高兩品，這就是 G5。滑動整個指型，名稱就隨品位改變。

items.source: Your root is on string 6, fret 5. Which power chord is it?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-3 “Movable power chords” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 根音在第 6 弦第 5 品，是哪個強力和弦？

items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-3 “Movable power chords” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-3 “Movable power chords” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-3 “Movable power chords” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Count up string 6: E open, F at 1, G at 3, A at 5.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-3 “Movable power chords” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 沿第 6 弦往上數：空弦 E、第 1 品 F、第 3 品 G、第 5 品 A。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-3 “Movable power chords” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: The same shape works from string 5. Finger 1 on string 5, fret 3 gives C5. Let the tip of finger 1 touch string 6 to keep it quiet.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-3 “Movable power chords” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 同樣指型也可從第 5 弦開始。第 1 指按第 5 弦第 3 品就是 C5。讓第 1 指尖輕碰第 6 弦，使它保持安靜。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-4 “Your first riff” · title
Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-4 “Your first riff” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A riff is a short, catchy phrase that repeats. This one bounces off open low E. Rest your palm at the bridge to keep it tight.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-4 “Your first riff” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 反覆樂句是短小、抓耳又不斷重複的樂句。這一段圍繞低音空弦 E 跳動。掌根靠在琴橋旁，讓聲音緊實。

items.source: Open E, string 6 at fret 3, then open A.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-4 “Your first riff” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 空弦 E、第 6 弦第 3 品，再到空弦 A。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-4 “Your first riff” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: The second bar climbs string 5: fret 2, then fret 5 with your little finger, then back to fret 2. Keep finger 1 parked near fret 2.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-4 “Your first riff” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 第二小節沿第 5 弦上行：第 2 品，再用小指按第 5 品，然後回第 2 品。第 1 指保持在第 2 品附近。

items.source: String 5: fret 2, fret 5 with your little finger, fret 2 again.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-4 “Your first riff” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第 5 弦：第 2 品、小指按第 5 品，再回第 2 品。

items.source: What makes a riff a riff?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-4 “Your first riff” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 反覆樂句的特點是什麼？

items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-4 “Your first riff” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-4 “Your first riff” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-5 “Riffs and power chords” · title
Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-5 “Riffs and power chords” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Songs often answer a riff with power chords. Play the riff, then hit the chords on one, the and of two, and four.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-5 “Riffs and power chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 歌曲常用強力和弦回應反覆樂句。先彈樂句，再於第一拍、第二拍後半拍與第四拍打出和弦。

items.source: Slide G5 up two frets. What do you get?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-5 “Riffs and power chords” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 將 G5 向上滑兩品，會得到什麼？

items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-5 “Riffs and power chords” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-5 “Riffs and power chords” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Two frets above G is A. The chord's name moves with its root.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-5 “Riffs and power chords” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: G 往上兩品是 A，和弦名稱隨根音移動。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-spotlight “Song spotlight: Basement Weather” · title
Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-spotlight “Song spotlight: Basement Weather” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Basement Weather is a Timbre Original: garage rock in A. A riff on the low strings opens it, then power chords punch back on one, the and of two, and four. Keep your palm at the bridge. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-spotlight “Song spotlight: Basement Weather” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 《地下室天氣》是 Timbre 原創歌曲，一首 A 調車庫搖滾。先以低音弦反覆樂句開場，再用強力和弦於第一拍、第二拍後半拍與第四拍有力回應。掌根靠在琴橋旁。完整歌曲在歌曲頁面的原創歌曲中。

items.source: Open A, C at fret 3 on string 5, open D, then G at fret 3 on string 6 and open low E.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-spotlight “Song spotlight: Basement Weather” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 空弦 A、第 5 弦第 3 品的 C、空弦 D，再到第 6 弦第 3 品的 G 與低音空弦 E。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-spotlight “Song spotlight: Basement Weather” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: You know C5, with finger 1 on string 5, fret 3. Slide the whole shape up two frets and it becomes D5. G5 sits at fret 3 too, one string lower than C5.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-spotlight “Song spotlight: Basement Weather” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 你已會第 1 指按第 5 弦第 3 品的 C5。整個指型向上滑兩品，就變成 D5。G5 也在第 3 品，但比 C5 低一條弦。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · challenge gtr-9-6 “Riff challenge” · title
Guitar · Unit 9 · challenge gtr-9-6 “Riff challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: No new ideas: power chords, open and movable, palm muting and your riff. Lock in with the click and keep the mutes tight.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · challenge gtr-9-6 “Riff challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 沒有新內容：開放與可移動強力和弦、掌根悶音，以及你的反覆樂句。跟緊節拍聲，保持悶音緊實。

items.source: Your root is on string 5, fret 3. Which power chord is it?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · challenge gtr-9-6 “Riff challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 根音在第 5 弦第 3 品，是哪個強力和弦？

items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · challenge gtr-9-6 “Riff challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: String 5 counts up from A: B at 2, C at 3.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · challenge gtr-9-6 “Riff challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 第 5 弦從 A 往上數：第 2 品 B、第 3 品 C。

items.source: Which one is a power chord?

Guitar · Unit 10 “Barre chords and the pentatonic” · title

items.source: The F barre and B minor, the A minor pentatonic scale and your first solo.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 10 “Barre chords and the pentatonic” · unit summary
items.translation: F 橫按與 B 小和弦、A 小調五聲音階，以及你的第一段獨奏。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-1 “On the way to F” · title
Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-1 “On the way to F” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Full barre chords take weeks, so build up to them. You know the mini F. Next comes a five-string F, then the full barre.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-1 “On the way to F” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 完整封閉和弦需要幾週練習，慢慢建立能力。你已會簡易 F，接著是五弦 F，最後才是完整橫按。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-1 “On the way to F” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Move finger 3 to string 5, fret 3, and put your little finger on string 4, fret 3. Five strings ring and the F sounds fuller.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-1 “On the way to F” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 將第 3 指移到第 5 弦第 3 品，小指放在第 4 弦第 3 品。五條弦一起發聲，F 聽起來更飽滿。

items.source: Barre chords feel hard at first. What helps most?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-1 “On the way to F” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 封閉和弦一開始很難，怎麼做最有幫助？

items.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-1 “On the way to F” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Squeezing as hard as you can
items.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-1 “On the way to F” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-1 “On the way to F” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Strength and feel build slowly. Short, daily practice beats one long, painful session.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-1 “On the way to F” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 力量與手感需要慢慢建立。每天短時間練習，比一次練到疼痛更好。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-2 “The full F barre” · title
Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-2 “The full F barre” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Lay finger 1 flat across all six strings at fret 1. Fingers 2, 3 and 4 make an E shape in front of it. F is E moved up one fret.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-2 “The full F barre” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 第 1 指平放，在第 1 品橫按全部六條弦。第 2、3、4 指在前方形成 E 指型。F 就是 E 向上移一品。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-2 “The full F barre” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: Let your arm's weight pull the barre in, as if gently drawing the neck toward you. Your thumb only steadies. Roll finger 1 onto its side.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-2 “The full F barre” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 讓手臂的重量帶動橫按，像輕輕把琴頸拉向自己。拇指只負責穩定，第 1 指稍微側轉。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-2 “The full F barre” · step 4 (along) · title

items.source: The F barre is which open shape, moved up a fret?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-2 “The full F barre” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: F 橫按是哪個開放指型提高一品？

items.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-3 “B minor” · title
Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-3 “B minor” · step 1 (explain) · title
items.translation: B 小和弦：第 2 品橫按

items.source: Finger 1 barres strings 1 to 5 at fret 2. Fingers 2, 3 and 4 build an A minor shape two frets higher. Skip string 6.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-3 “B minor” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 第 1 指在第 2 品橫按第 1 至 5 弦，第 2、3、4 指形成比原位高兩品的 A 小和弦指型。略過第 6 弦。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-3 “B minor” · step 2 (explain) · title
items.translation: 更容易的 B 小和弦

items.source: Not ready to barre? Play the top four strings only: fret 4 on strings 4 and 3, fret 3 on string 2, fret 2 on string 1.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-3 “B minor” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 還沒準備好橫按？只彈高音四條弦：第 4、3 弦第 4 品，第 2 弦第 3 品，第 1 弦第 2 品。

items.source: Which chord is E moved up one fret with a barre?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-3 “B minor” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: E 向上移一品並橫按，會變成哪個和弦？

items.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-3 “B minor” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-4 “The A minor pentatonic” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: The minor pentatonic scale has five notes. In A minor they're A, C, D, E and G. It's the sound of countless blues and rock solos.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-4 “The A minor pentatonic” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 小調五聲音階只有五個音。A 小調中是 A、C、D、E、G，無數藍調與搖滾獨奏都使用這種聲音。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-4 “The A minor pentatonic” · step 2 (explain) · title
items.translation: 第 5 品的第 1 指型

items.source: Finger 1 covers fret 5 on every string. Fingers 3 and 4 take frets 7 and 8. Two notes per string, one finger per fret.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-4 “The A minor pentatonic” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 第 1 指負責每條弦的第 5 品，第 3、4 指負責第 7、8 品。每條弦兩個音，每根手指負責一品。

items.source: Fret 5, fret 8 on string 6, then fret 5, fret 7 on string 5.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-4 “The A minor pentatonic” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第 6 弦第 5、8 品，再到第 5 弦第 5、7 品。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-4 “The A minor pentatonic” · step 4 (along) · title

items.source: Which notes are in A minor pentatonic?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-4 “The A minor pentatonic” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: A 小調五聲音階有哪些音？

items.source: A solo is a melody built from short phrases. Play a few notes, leave a gap, then answer. Ending on A, the root, sounds like a full stop.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-5 “Your first solo” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 獨奏由短樂句組成旋律。彈幾個音，留一點空間，再回應。結尾落在根音 A，聽起來就像句點。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-5 “Your first solo” · step 2 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-5 “Your first solo” · step 3 (along) · title

items.source: Which note sounds most like a full stop in A minor?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-5 “Your first solo” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 在 A 小調中，哪個音最像句點？

items.source: A is the root, the home of A minor. Ending a phrase on it sounds finished.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-5 “Your first solo” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: A 是根音，也是 A 小調的家。樂句在它上面結束，聽起來就完整了。

items.source: A power ballad with a barre
items.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-spotlight “Song spotlight: Glass Satellites” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Glass Satellites is a Timbre Original: a power ballad on A minor, F, C and G. Your full F barre takes the second chord, and box 1 fits over the whole loop, so it gets a solo. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-spotlight “Song spotlight: Glass Satellites” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

items.translation: 拇指彈低音、p-i-m-a、Travis 指彈，以及指彈抒情曲。

Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-1 “Thumb on the bass” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Fingerpicking means plucking with your fingers instead of a pick. Your thumb owns the bass strings, 6, 5 and 4, and plays on the beat like a bass drum.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-1 “Thumb on the bass” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 指彈就是用手指取代撥片來撥弦。拇指負責第 6、5、4 弦的低音，像大鼓一樣在拍點上演奏。

items.source: Thumb only: push down through strings 6, 5 and 4, one at a time.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-1 “Thumb on the bass” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 只用拇指：依序向下撥過第 6、5、4 弦，一次一條。

items.source: Which strings does your thumb usually play?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-1 “Thumb on the bass” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: The thumb takes the bass strings. Your fingers take the thinner ones.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-1 “Thumb on the bass” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 拇指負責低音弦，其餘手指負責較細的弦。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-1 “Thumb on the bass” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: Hold A minor. Your thumb plays the root on string 5, then rocks over to string 4, the chord's fifth. Root, fifth, root, fifth: that's an alternating bass.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-1 “Thumb on the bass” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 按好 A 小和弦。拇指先彈第 5 弦的根音，再移到第 4 弦的和弦五音。根音、五音、根音、五音，就是交替低音。

items.source: Fingerstyle borrows Spanish names: p for the thumb, i index, m middle, a ring. Rest i on string 3, m on string 2 and a on string 1, ready to pluck.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-2 “p, i, m and a” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 指彈借用西班牙文名稱：p 是拇指、i 是食指、m 是中指、a 是無名指。把 i 放在第 3 弦、m 放在第 2 弦、a 放在第 1 弦，準備撥弦。

items.source: i, m, a: index on string 3, middle on 2, ring on 1.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-2 “p, i, m and a” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: i、m、a：食指第 3 弦、中指第 2 弦、無名指第 1 弦。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-2 “p, i, m and a” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-2 “p, i, m and a” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: p thumb, i index, m middle, a ring. The little finger usually rests.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-2 “p, i, m and a” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: p 拇指、i 食指、m 中指、a 無名指，小指通常休息。

Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-2 “p, i, m and a” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: Each finger plucks up and slightly toward your palm, then relaxes. Keep your hand still above the strings and let the fingers do the moving.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-2 “p, i, m and a” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 每根手指向上、略朝手心撥弦，接著放鬆。整隻手穩定停在琴弦上方，只讓手指動作。

items.source: Travis picking, named after Merle Travis, keeps the thumb alternating on every beat while the fingers pluck in between, on the ands.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-3 “Travis picking” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Travis 指彈以 Merle Travis 命名。拇指每拍交替彈低音，其餘手指則在拍間的「又」撥弦。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-3 “Travis picking” · step 2 (along) · title

items.source: In Travis picking, what does the thumb do?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-3 “Travis picking” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Travis 指彈中，拇指做什麼？

items.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-3 “Travis picking” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-3 “Travis picking” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Alternates bass notes on every beat
items.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-3 “Travis picking” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: The thumb is the steady pulse: a bass note on every beat, rocking between two strings.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-3 “Travis picking” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 拇指是穩定的脈動，每拍彈一個低音，在兩條弦間交替。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-3 “Travis picking” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: Keep the thumb going. Between thumb notes, m plucks string 2 and i plucks string 3: thumb, m, thumb, i. Go slowly until it runs by itself.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-3 “Travis picking” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 拇指繼續彈。在兩個拇指音之間，m 撥第 2 弦，i 撥第 3 弦：拇指、m、拇指、i。慢慢練，直到動作自然。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-3 “Travis picking” · step 5 (along) · title

items.source: Between thumb notes, which finger plucks string 2?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-3 “Travis picking” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 拇指音之間，哪根手指撥第 2 弦？

items.source: In this pattern m takes string 2 and i takes string 3. The a finger rests for now.

items.translation: 這個節奏型中，m 負責第 2 弦，i 負責第 3 弦，a 暫時休息。

items.translation: 換和弦時，拇指在第一拍準確彈到新根音。其他手指仍像之前一樣撥第 2、3 弦。

items.source: An arpeggio plays a chord one note at a time. This one rolls p, i, m, a, then back down m, i. Six notes fill a bar of three, two to a beat.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-5 “A fingerpicked ballad” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 琶音就是把和弦逐音彈出。這裡依序 p、i、m、a，再回到 m、i。六個音填滿三拍小節，每拍兩個音。

items.translation: 琶音在最高處轉向：p、i、m、a，再由 m、i 回來。

Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-5 “A fingerpicked ballad” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: One bar each: A minor, F, C, G, then A minor, F, E, A minor. Your thumb finds each new root: strings 5, 4, 5 and 6.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-5 “A fingerpicked ballad” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 每個一小節：A 小和弦、F、C、G，再接 A 小和弦、F、E、A 小和弦。拇指找到每個新根音：第 5、4、5、6 弦。

items.source: Porchlight is a Timbre Original: a slow ballad in D. Fingerpick it: your thumb on each chord's root, then i, m and a up strings 3, 2 and 1. Let every note ring into the next. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-spotlight “Song spotlight: Porchlight” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 《門廊燈》是 Timbre 原創歌曲，一首 D 調慢板抒情曲。用指彈演奏：拇指彈各和弦的根音，再由 i、m、a 依序彈第 3、2、1 弦。讓每個音延續到下一個。完整歌曲在歌曲頁面的原創歌曲中。

items.source: In D, which string does your thumb play?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-spotlight “Song spotlight: Porchlight” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: D 和弦中，拇指彈哪條弦？

items.source: D's root is open string 4. Strings 5 and 6 stay quiet in this chord.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-spotlight “Song spotlight: Porchlight” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: D 的根音是第 4 弦空弦，這個和弦的第 5、6 弦保持安靜。

items.source: The 12-bar in A, the quick change, a boogie bass line, the turnaround and your first blues licks.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 “Blues” · unit summary
items.translation: A 調 12 小節、快速換和弦、布吉低音線、迴轉樂句，以及初次藍調短句。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-1 “The blues in A” · title
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-1 “The blues in A” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Blues chords sit on the first, fourth and fifth notes of the key. In E that's E7, A7 and B7. Move to the key of A and they become A7, D7 and E7.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-1 “The blues in A” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 藍調和弦建立在調性的第一、第四與第五音。E 調是 E7、A7、B7；換到 A 調，就成為 A7、D7、E7。

items.source: In the key of A, which chord does the job B7 did in E?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-1 “The blues in A” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: A 調中，哪個和弦扮演 E 調 B7 的角色？

items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-1 “The blues in A” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: B7 is five letters up from E. Five letters up from A is E, so E7 takes its place.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-1 “The blues in A” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 從 E 往上數五個字母是 B，所以用 B7；從 A 往上數五個字母是 E，因此換成 E7。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-1 “The blues in A” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: Four bars of A7, two of D7, two of A7, then one each of E7, D7, A7 and E7. The last E7 turns you back to the top.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-1 “The blues in A” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 四小節 A7、兩小節 D7、兩小節 A7，最後 E7、D7、A7、E7 各一小節。最後的 E7 帶你回到開頭。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-2 “The quick change” · title
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-2 “The quick change” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: In a quick change, bar 2 jumps to the four chord and straight back. In A: A7, D7, A7, A7. It adds motion right from the start.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-2 “The quick change” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 快速換和弦會在第 2 小節跳到四級和弦，再立刻回來。A 調是 A7、D7、A7、A7，讓開頭就有動感。

items.source: In a quick change in A, which chord is bar 2?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-2 “The quick change” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: A 調快速換和弦中，第 2 小節是哪個和弦？

items.source: The four chord in A is D7. The quick change visits it in bar 2, then returns to A7.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-2 “The quick change” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: A 調的四級和弦是 D7，快速換和弦在第 2 小節拜訪它，再回到 A7。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-2 “The quick change” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: The quick change works in any key. In E: E7, A7, E7, E7. Watch for B7 near the end, your four-finger chord.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-2 “The quick change” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 快速換和弦適用於任何調。E 調是 E7、A7、E7、E7。注意接近結尾的 B7，那是四指齊用的和弦。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · title
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A boogie line walks up the chord and back, each note twice, long-short like the shuffle. Over A7 it climbs A, C sharp, E, F sharp, G, then walks back down.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 布吉低音線沿和弦上行再回來，每個音彈兩次，像搖擺節奏一樣長短交替。搭配 A7 時，上行 A、升 C、E、升 F、G，再往下走。

items.source: Open A, fret 4 on string 5, frets 2 and 4 on string 4, then open G.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 空弦 A、第 5 弦第 4 品、第 4 弦第 2、4 品，再到空弦 G。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 3 (along) · title

items.source: How do the two notes of each pair feel?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 每組兩個音的感覺是什麼？

items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: It's the shuffle again: a long note on the beat, a short one just before the next.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 又是搖擺節奏：拍點上是一個長音，下一拍前是一個短音。

items.source: Move it to D and E
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: The same walk starts from D on string 4 and from E on string 6. Over D7: D, F sharp, A, B, C. Over E7: E, G sharp, B, C sharp, D.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 同樣的走法可從第 4 弦的 D、第 6 弦的 E 開始。D7 用 D、升 F、A、B、C；E7 用 E、升 G、B、升 C、D。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 6 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 7 (along) · title

items.source: Boogie, A to D and back
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 8 (along) · title
items.translation: 布吉：A 到 D 再回來

items.source: A lick that turns you around
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Bars 11 and 12 often get a turnaround, a short lick that leads back to the top. This one walks down from A to E, one fret at a time.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 第 11、12 小節常加入迴轉短句，引導回到開頭。這一段從 A 往下到 E，每次一品。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第 3 弦：第 2 品、第 1 品，再空弦。

items.source: String 4: fret 4, then 3, then 2. Let the E ring.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第 4 弦：第 4 品，再第 3 品、第 2 品。讓 E 延續。

items.source: Where does a turnaround usually go?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 迴轉樂句通常放在哪裡？

items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: The last two bars. It leads the ear back to bar 1 for another time around.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 最後兩小節，帶耳朵回到第 1 小節，開始下一輪。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 6 (explain) · title

items.source: Strum the first ten bars with the quick change, then switch to the lick for bars 11 and 12. That's how a blues band ends each time around.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 前十小節以快速換和弦掃奏，第 11、12 小節改彈短句。藍調樂團就是這樣結束每一輪。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · title
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Your A minor pentatonic box fits right over a blues in A. Its C rubs against the C sharp in A7, and that rub is the sound of the blues.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: A 小調五聲音階指型正好適合 A 調藍調。其中的 C 與 A7 的升 C 產生摩擦，這就是藍調的聲音。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 3 (along) · title

items.source: Over a blues in A, which note sounds most like home?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: A 調藍調中，哪個音最像回家？

items.source: A is the root of the key. Licks that end on A sound settled; G and C leave you hanging.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: A 是這個調的根音。短句結束在 A 上會安定，G 與 C 則讓人期待下文。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 5 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 6 (explain) · title

items.source: Blues phrases talk to each other. Play lick 1 as the question, then answer with lick 2, which lands on the low A.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 藍調樂句會互相對話。用短句 1 提問，再用落在低音 A 的短句 2 回應。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 7 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 8 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · title
items.translation: 歌曲焦點：霓虹自助洗衣店

items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Neon Laundromat is a Timbre Original: funk that sits on one chord, A7. Its hook slides from C to C sharp, the same rub your blues licks make, and its chorus drops to E7. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 《霓虹自助洗衣店》是 Timbre 原創歌曲，以單一 A7 和弦為主的放克。記憶點樂句從 C 滑到升 C，產生與藍調短句相同的摩擦，副歌則降到 E7。完整歌曲在歌曲頁面的原創歌曲中。

items.source: A at fret 2 on string 3, then C and C sharp at frets 1 and 2 on string 2, then open E.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第 3 弦第 2 品的 A，再到第 2 弦第 1、2 品的 C 與升 C，接著空弦 E。

items.source: Over A7, which note rubs against the chord?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 搭配 A7 時，哪個音會與和弦產生摩擦？

items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A7 is A, C sharp, E and G. C, from your pentatonic box, rubs against its C sharp, and the hook slides from one to the other.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: A7 由 A、升 C、E、G 組成。五聲音階指型中的 C 與升 C 摩擦，記憶點樂句就在兩者間滑動。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: Neon Laundromat doesn't shuffle. Play your boogie walk in even eighths and it becomes a bass line under the A7: A, C sharp, E, F sharp, G, and back down.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 《霓虹自助洗衣店》不使用搖擺節奏。把布吉音型彈成平均八分音符，就成為 A7 下方的低音線：A、升 C、E、升 F、G，再往下。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · challenge gtr-12-6 “Blues challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: No new ideas: the 12-bar in A and E, the quick change, the boogie line, the turnaround and your licks. Keep the shuffle swinging.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · challenge gtr-12-6 “Blues challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 沒有新內容：A 調與 E 調的 12 小節、快速換和弦、布吉低音線、迴轉與藍調短句。持續搖擺的律動。

items.source: In a quick change in E, which chord is bar 2?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · challenge gtr-12-6 “Blues challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: E 調快速換和弦中，第 2 小節是哪個和弦？

items.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · challenge gtr-12-6 “Blues challenge” · step 4 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 13 “Lead technique” · title

items.source: Hammer-ons, pull-offs, slides, bends and vibrato, and a second pentatonic box.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 “Lead technique” · unit summary
items.translation: 搥弦、勾弦、滑音、推弦與揉弦，以及第二種五聲音階指型。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · title
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A hammer-on sounds a second note with the fretting hand alone. Pick a note, then bring another finger down hard, just behind a higher fret. The string keeps ringing.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 搥弦只靠按弦手讓第二個音發聲。撥出一個音，再將另一根手指有力落在較高品的品絲後方，琴弦會持續響。

items.source: Pick open string 3, then hammer finger 2 onto fret 2. Don't pick the second note.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 撥第 3 弦空弦，再用第 2 指搥到第 2 品。第二個音不要再撥。

items.source: String 3: pick fret 5 with finger 1, then hammer finger 3 onto fret 7.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第 3 弦：用第 1 指按第 5 品並撥弦，再以第 3 指搥到第 7 品。

items.source: What makes a hammer-on ring clearly?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A fast, firm landing right behind the fret
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: 快速、穩固地落在品絲正後方

items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Speed and aim matter more than force. Land on the fingertip, right behind the fret, and the string keeps singing.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 速度與落點比力氣重要。指尖準確落在品絲後方，琴弦就能持續發聲。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 6 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 7 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · title
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A pull-off drops to a lower note. With both fingers down, pick the higher note, then flick the top finger off sideways so it plucks the string as it leaves.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 勾弦讓音降到較低的音。兩指都先按好，撥出較高音，再將高音手指向側邊勾離，在離弦時撥動琴弦。

items.source: Fret 2 on string 3, then flick finger 2 off to sound open G.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第 3 弦第 2 品，接著勾開第 2 指，讓空弦 G 發聲。

items.source: Fingers 1 and 3 on frets 5 and 7. Pick, then pull finger 3 off.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第 1、3 指按第 5、7 品，撥弦後將第 3 指勾離。

items.source: In a pull-off, the top finger…
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Flicks off sideways, plucking the string
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: 向側邊勾離，同時撥動琴弦

items.source: Lifting straight up lets the note die. A small sideways flick plucks the lower note into life.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 直接抬起會讓聲音消失。輕輕往側邊勾，才能讓低音接著響起。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 6 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 7 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · title
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: To slide, pick a note and keep pressing as you glide the same finger to a new fret. The pressure carries the sound; only the first note is picked.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 滑音時，先撥弦，再保持按壓，用同一根手指滑到新的品位。持續壓力讓聲音延續，只有第一個音需要撥。

items.source: Finger 3 on string 3, fret 7. Pick, then slide up to fret 9 without lifting.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第 3 指按第 3 弦第 7 品。撥弦後不抬指，向上滑到第 9 品。

items.source: During a slide, what keeps the note sounding?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 滑音時，什麼讓音符持續發聲？

items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Ease off and the note dies. Keep the same pressure all the way to the new fret.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 鬆開壓力，聲音就會消失。一路保持相同壓力，直到新的品位。

items.source: Now back: pick fret 9 and slide down to fret 7.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 現在回來：撥第 9 品，再向下滑到第 7 品。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 5 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 7 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · title
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A bend pushes the string across the fret to raise its pitch. A whole-step bend, the size of two frets, from fret 7 must sound exactly like fret 9.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 推弦會讓琴弦橫向移動，提高音高。從第 7 品推高一個全音，也就是兩品的距離，必須聽起來與第 9 品完全相同。

items.source: String 3, fret 9: this is your bend target. Let it ring and remember it.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第 3 弦第 9 品：這是推弦的目標音。讓它響起，記住聲音。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Put finger 3 on fret 7 with fingers 1 and 2 behind it on the same string. Push all three toward the ceiling, turning your wrist as if turning a doorknob.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 第 3 指按第 7 品，第 1、2 指放在同弦後方。三指一起朝天花板推，手腕像轉門把一樣旋轉。

items.source: Your bend from fret 7 sounds lower than fret 9. What now?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 從第 7 品推弦，聽起來仍低於第 9 品，該怎麼做？

items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A bend that falls short sounds sour. Push until it matches the target you heard.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 推不到目標音，聽起來就不準。繼續推，直到符合剛聽到的目標音。

items.source: Target, then a short bend. Same note or different?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 5 (listen) · question or instruction
items.translation: 先聽目標音，再聽未推足的音。相同還是不同？

items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 5 (listen) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 5 (listen) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 6 (explain) · title

items.source: Vibrato is a small bend and release, repeated quickly on a held note. Keep it narrow and even so the note stays in tune.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 揉弦是在延長的音上，快速反覆小幅推弦再放回。幅度要小而均勻，才能保持音準。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 7 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-5 “Box 2 and the link” · title
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-5 “Box 2 and the link” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: The same five notes repeat up the neck. Box 2 starts where box 1 ends: finger 1 at fret 7 on strings 5, 4 and 3, finger 2 at fret 8 on strings 6, 2 and 1.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-5 “Box 2 and the link” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 相同五個音會在琴頸上反覆出現。第 2 指型從第 1 指型的結尾開始：第 1 指按第 5、4、3 弦的第 7 品，第 2 指按第 6、2、1 弦的第 8 品。

items.source: String 6: frets 8 and 10. String 5: frets 7 and 10.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-5 “Box 2 and the link” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-5 “Box 2 and the link” · step 3 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-5 “Box 2 and the link” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: The same five notes as box 1, A C D E G, in a new place on the neck.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-5 “Box 2 and the link” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 與第 1 指型相同的五個音 A C D E G，只是在琴頸的新位置。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-5 “Box 2 and the link” · step 5 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-5 “Box 2 and the link” · step 6 (explain) · title

items.source: To travel from box 1 to box 2, slide finger 3 from fret 7 to fret 9 on string 3. You arrive in box 2 with your hand already in place.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-5 “Box 2 and the link” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 從第 1 指型到第 2 指型，把第 3 指沿第 3 弦從第 7 品滑到第 9 品。到達第 2 指型時，手也已就位。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-5 “Box 2 and the link” · step 7 (along) · title
items.translation: 從第 1 指型到第 2 指型

items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-5 “Box 2 and the link” · step 8 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-spotlight “Song spotlight: Saltwater Sunday” · title
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-spotlight “Song spotlight: Saltwater Sunday” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Saltwater Sunday is a Timbre Original: laid-back reggae in A minor, where Am7 and D7 trade bars. Both pentatonic boxes fit over them. Hammer, pull and slide, and land on a chord note as each bar begins. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-spotlight “Song spotlight: Saltwater Sunday” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 《海水星期天》是 Timbre 原創歌曲，一首 A 小調的悠閒雷鬼曲，Am7 與 D7 逐小節交替。兩種五聲音階指型都適合。搥、勾、滑，每小節開頭落在和弦音。完整歌曲在歌曲頁面的原創歌曲中。

items.source: D7 is D, F sharp, A and C. C, its seventh, sounds settled; E and G only pass through.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-spotlight “Song spotlight: Saltwater Sunday” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: D7 由 D、升 F、A、C 組成。七音 C 聽起來安定，E 與 G 則適合經過。

items.source: E and A shapes up the neck, major and minor, the closer shape, and a progression in A.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 “Moving barre chords” · unit summary
items.translation: E、A 指型沿琴頸移動，分辨大與小，選擇較近指型，並演奏 A 調進行。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-1 “The E shape moves” · title
Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-1 “The E shape moves” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Your F barre is an E shape with a barre at fret 1. Slide the whole thing up and the name follows the root on string 6: at fret 3 it's G, at fret 5 it's A.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-1 “The E shape moves” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: F 橫按就是第 1 品橫按的 E 指型。整體往上滑，名稱會跟著第 6 弦根音改變：第 3 品是 G，第 5 品是 A。

items.source: An E-shape barre at fret 5. Which chord?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-1 “The E shape moves” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 第 5 品的 E 指型橫按，是哪個和弦？

items.source: String 6 counts up from E: F at 1, G at 3, A at 5. The barre's fret names the chord.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-1 “The E shape moves” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 第 6 弦從 E 往上數：第 1 品 F、第 3 品 G、第 5 品 A。橫按的品位決定和弦名稱。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-1 “The E shape moves” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: Lift finger 2 and let the barre cover string 3. That's the E minor shape, and it moves the same way: F sharp minor at fret 2, A minor at fret 5.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-1 “The E shape moves” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 抬起第 2 指，讓橫按手指負責第 3 弦。這就是 E 小和弦指型，也能同樣移動：第 2 品是升 F 小和弦，第 5 品是 A 小和弦。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-2 “The A shape moves” · title
Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-2 “The A shape moves” · step 1 (explain) · title
items.translation: A 指型，根音在第 5 弦

items.source: B minor was an A minor shape with a barre. The major A shape moves too: barre strings 1 to 5, then lay finger 3 flat across strings 4, 3 and 2, two frets higher.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-2 “The A shape moves” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: B 小和弦是加上橫按的 A 小和弦指型。大和弦的 A 指型也能移動：橫按第 1 至 5 弦，再用第 3 指平按高兩品的第 4、3、2 弦。

items.source: An A-shape barre at fret 3. Which chord?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-2 “The A shape moves” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 第 3 品的 A 指型橫按，是哪個和弦？

items.source: String 5 counts up from A: B at 2, C at 3, D at 5.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-2 “The A shape moves” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 第 5 弦從 A 往上數：第 2 品 B、第 3 品 C、第 5 品 D。

items.source: The minor A shape moves too
items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-2 “The A shape moves” · step 5 (explain) · title
items.translation: A 小和弦指型也能移動

items.source: For minor, use your B minor fingers: 2, 3 and 4 build the A minor pattern in front of the barre. At fret 3 that's C minor.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-2 “The A shape moves” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 小和弦沿用 B 小和弦指法：第 2、3、4 指在橫按前方形成 A 小和弦指型。第 3 品就是 C 小和弦。

items.translation: E 指型還是 A 指型？

items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Most chords can be an E shape, root on string 6, or an A shape, root on string 5. Pick whichever sits closer to where your hand already is.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 多數和弦可用第 6 弦為根音的 E 指型，或第 5 弦為根音的 A 指型。選擇距離目前手位較近的那個。

items.source: You're playing G at fret 3. Where's the closest C?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 你在第 3 品彈 G，最近的 C 在哪裡？

items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: 第 8 品的 E 指型

items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: 第 3 品的 A 指型

items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: 第 8 品的 A 指型

items.source: C's root is on string 5, fret 3. Stay at fret 3 and switch to the A shape.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: C 的根音在第 5 弦第 3 品。留在第 3 品，換成 A 指型即可。

items.source: Keep the barre, swap the shape
items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: From G to C at fret 3, finger 1 stays on the barre. Only the fingers in front of it change. It's the smoothest barre change there is.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 第 3 品從 G 換 C 時，第 1 指繼續橫按，只改變前方的手指。這是最流暢的封閉和弦切換。

items.source: D as an A shape sits at which fret?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: A 指型的 D 在第幾品？

Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: String 5: A open, B at 2, C at 3, D at 5.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 第 5 弦：空弦 A、第 2 品 B、第 3 品 C、第 5 品 D。

Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-4 “F sharp minor, D, A, E” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: F sharp minor, D, A and E all live in the key of A. Start with F sharp minor as a barre and the other three open.

items.translation: 升 F 小和弦、D、A、E 都屬於 A 調。先把升 F 小和弦用橫按，其餘三個用開放指型。

items.source: F sharp minor as an E-shape barre sits at…
items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-4 “F sharp minor, D, A, E” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: E 指型的升 F 小和弦橫按在…

items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-4 “F sharp minor, D, A, E” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 第 6 弦：第 1 品 F，第 2 品升 F。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-4 “F sharp minor, D, A, E” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: Play it up the neck: F sharp minor at fret 2, D as an A shape at fret 5, A as an E shape at fret 5, and E as an A shape at fret 7.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-4 “F sharp minor, D, A, E” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 沿琴頸演奏：第 2 品升 F 小和弦、第 5 品 A 指型的 D、第 5 品 E 指型的 A，以及第 7 品 A 指型的 E。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · title
Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Let the barre go soft for an instant as you move, then squeeze as you land. Gripping hard all the way tires your hand and slows the change.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 移動瞬間讓橫按放鬆，到位時再按緊。一路用力抓著會讓手疲倦，也會拖慢切換。

items.source: When should your fretting hand squeeze?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 按弦手什麼時候應該按緊？

items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Squeeze to land, relax to move. Constant force wears out your hand in minutes.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 到位時按緊，移動時放鬆。持續用力，幾分鐘就會讓手疲倦。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: On the last up strum before a change, lift the barre and keep strumming. The open strings sound for a moment, the rhythm never stops, and you land on time.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 換和弦前最後一次向上掃時，抬起橫按手指但繼續掃。空弦會短暫發聲，節奏不中斷，也能準時到位。

Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-spotlight “Song spotlight: Spray Paint Sunrise” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Spray Paint Sunrise is a Timbre Original: indie pop in E on E, B, C sharp minor and A. B and C sharp minor are both A-shape barres, two frets apart, so one hand shape does most of the work. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-spotlight “Song spotlight: Spray Paint Sunrise” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 《噴漆日出》是 Timbre 原創歌曲，以 E、B、升 C 小和弦、A 組成 E 調獨立流行曲。B 與升 C 小和弦都是 A 系列橫按，相隔兩品，一種手形就能完成大部分動作。完整歌曲在歌曲頁面的原創歌曲中。

items.source: C sharp minor as an A minor shape barre sits at…
items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-spotlight “Song spotlight: Spray Paint Sunrise” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: A 小和弦指型的升 C 小和弦橫按在…

items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-spotlight “Song spotlight: Spray Paint Sunrise” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: String 5 counts up from A: B at 2, C at 3, C sharp at 4.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-spotlight “Song spotlight: Spray Paint Sunrise” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 第 5 弦從 A 往上數：第 2 品 B、第 3 品 C、第 4 品升 C。

Guitar · Unit 14 · challenge gtr-14-6 “Barre challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · challenge gtr-14-6 “Barre challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 沒有新內容：E、A 指型的大與小和弦、選較近的指型，以及流暢切換。和弦間放鬆，在第一拍到位。

items.source: An E-shape barre at fret 3 is…
items.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · challenge gtr-14-6 “Barre challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 第 3 品的 E 指型橫按是…

items.translation: 根音在第 5 弦，代表哪個指型？

Guitar · Unit 15 “Rhythm styles” · title

items.source: Funk sixteenths and scratches, the reggae chop, country boom-chick and a syncopated pop strum.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 “Rhythm styles” · unit summary
items.translation: 放克十六分音符與悶掃、雷鬼切音、鄉村低音掃弦，以及切分流行掃弦。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-1 “Sixteenth notes” · title
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-1 “Sixteenth notes” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Sixteenth notes split each beat in four: one-e-and-a, two-e-and-a. Your strumming hand doubles its speed, down-up-down-up inside every beat.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-1 “Sixteenth notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 十六分音符把每拍分成四份：one-e-and-a、two-e-and-a。掃弦手加倍速度，每拍內下、上、下、上。

items.source: How many sixteenth notes fill one beat?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-1 “Sixteenth notes” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 一拍有幾個十六分音符？

items.source: One-e-and-a: four even slices of every beat.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-1 “Sixteenth notes” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-1 “Sixteenth notes” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: Funk loves the ninth chord. Finger 2 on string 5, fret 7, finger 1 on string 4, fret 6, and finger 3 flat across strings 3, 2 and 1 at fret 7.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-1 “Sixteenth notes” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 放克喜愛九和弦。第 2 指按第 5 弦第 7 品，第 1 指按第 4 弦第 6 品，第 3 指在第 7 品平按第 3、2、1 弦。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · title
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Keep your hand moving in sixteenths, but relax your fretting fingers so most strums are dead, scratchy clicks. Press down only for the hits.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 手持續做十六分音符動作，但放鬆按弦手指，讓多數掃弦成為短促沙沙聲。只在重擊時按緊。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: Fretting fingers resting lightly on the strings
items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: 按弦手指輕放在琴弦上

items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Touching without pressing stops the strings from ringing. The strum turns into a crisp, percussive click.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 只輕碰、不按緊，琴弦就不會持續發聲，掃弦會變成清脆的打擊聲。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: Squeeze for each hit, then relax right away so it stays short. Slide the whole E9 shape down two frets and you have D9.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 每次重擊時按緊，立刻放鬆，讓聲音短促。將整個 E9 指型往下滑兩品，就是 D9。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · title
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Reggae guitar answers the drums with short, bright chords on beats two and four. Strum just the thin strings and cut each chord off right away.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 雷鬼吉他在第二、第四拍用短促明亮的和弦回應鼓聲。只掃細弦，每次和弦發聲後立即切斷。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Use the top four strings only. This A minor is the top of your A minor barre at fret 5: finger 3 on string 4, fret 7, finger 1 barring the rest.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 只用高音四條弦。這個 A 小和弦是第 5 品橫按指型的高音部分：第 3 指按第 4 弦第 7 品，其餘由第 1 指橫按。

items.source: How long should a reggae chop ring?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Squeeze, strum, release. The chop is a short bark, and the space after it is the groove.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 按緊、掃弦、放鬆。切音像短促的一聲喊，後面的空間就是律動。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 6 (explain) · title

items.source: Now the top of your D barre: finger 3 flat across strings 4, 3 and 2 at fret 7, finger 1 on string 1 at fret 5.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 現在用 D 橫按的高音部分：第 3 指在第 7 品平按第 4、3、2 弦，第 1 指按第 1 弦第 5 品。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · title
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Country rhythm splits the bar: a single bass note on beats one and three, a quick strum of the thin strings on two and four. Boom, chick, boom, chick.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 鄉村節奏將小節分開：第一、第三拍彈單一低音，第二、第四拍快速掃過細弦。咚、鏘、咚、鏘。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 2 (along) · title

items.source: In boom-chick, what happens on beats two and four?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 低音掃弦中，第二、第四拍做什麼？

items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A short strum of the thin strings
items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: Move the second boom to another string: in G, string 6 then string 4. In C, string 5 then 4. In D, string 4 then open string 5.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 第二個低音換到另一條弦：G 用第 6 弦再第 4 弦；C 用第 5 弦再第 4 弦；D 用第 4 弦再第 5 弦空弦。

items.source: Booms in G, C and D
items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 6 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · title
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Syncopation puts the strum where you don't expect it. Down on one, up on the and of two, up on the and of three, then down-up on four.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 切分讓掃弦出現在意料之外的位置。第一拍向下，第二、第三拍的後半拍向上，第四拍下上。

items.source: In this pattern, what does your hand do on beat two?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 這個節奏型中，第二拍手做什麼？

items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: The pendulum never stops. On two the hand swings down without touching, ready for the up strum.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 鐘擺動作不停。第二拍向下擺但不碰弦，準備接著向上掃。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 6 (explain) · title

items.source: Pop players often change chords on the last up strum, the and of four, so the new chord arrives a hair early. It pushes the song forward.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 流行樂手常在最後一次向上掃，也就是第四拍後半拍換和弦，讓新和弦稍早到來，推動歌曲前進。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · title

items.source: The pop strum on four chords
items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Sparkler Season is a Timbre Original: a summer anthem in C on C, G, A minor and F. Give it the syncopated pop strum, and change a hair early, on the and of four. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 《仙女棒季節》是 Timbre 原創歌曲，以 C、G、A 小和弦、F 組成 C 調夏日頌歌。用切分流行掃弦，在第四拍後半拍稍早換和弦。完整歌曲在歌曲頁面的原創歌曲中。

items.source: Open E and D at fret 3 on string 2, twice, then G at fret 3 on string 1, and back down to D.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 空弦 E 與第 2 弦第 3 品的 D，重複兩次；再到第 1 弦第 3 品的 G，然後下行到 D。

items.source: Why change chords on the and of four?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 為什麼在第四拍後半拍換和弦？

items.source: So the new chord rings on beat one
items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: 讓新和弦在第一拍響起

items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Moving on the last up strum gets your hand there a hair early, so the new chord is ready for beat one.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 最後一次向上掃時移動，手會稍早到位，讓新和弦準備好迎接第一拍。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · challenge gtr-15-6 “Rhythm styles challenge” · title
Guitar · Unit 15 · challenge gtr-15-6 “Rhythm styles challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: No new ideas: funk sixteenths, the reggae chop, boom-chick and the syncopated pop strum. Keep the hand swinging and change only what it hits.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · challenge gtr-15-6 “Rhythm styles challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 沒有新內容：放克十六分音符、雷鬼切音、鄉村低音掃弦與切分流行掃弦。手持續擺動，只改變碰弦的時機。

items.source: Reggae chops land on which beats?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · challenge gtr-15-6 “Rhythm styles challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 15 · challenge gtr-15-6 “Rhythm styles challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

Guitar · Unit 16 “Putting it together” · title

items.source: A capo, G and D shapes on capo 2, and Oh! Susanna arranged with a verse and a chorus.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 “Putting it together” · unit summary
items.translation: 移調夾、第 2 品移調夾上的 G、D 指型，以及含主歌與副歌的《噢！蘇珊娜》編曲。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-1 “The capo” · title
Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-1 “The capo” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A capo clamps every string at one fret. On fret 2, each open string sounds two frets higher, and your open chord shapes all move up with it.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-1 “The capo” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 移調夾會把所有琴弦夾在同一品。夾第 2 品時，每條空弦都提高兩品，開放和弦指型的音高也一起提高。

items.source: Before the capo: pluck strings 1 and 2 open. That's E and B.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-1 “The capo” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 夾上前，撥第 1、2 弦空弦，分別是 E 與 B。

items.source: Now clamp the capo just behind fret 2 and pluck them again: F sharp and C sharp.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-1 “The capo” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 現在夾在第 2 品品絲正後方，再撥一次：升 F 與升 C。

items.source: Capo on fret 2. You play a G shape. Which chord sounds?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-1 “The capo” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 移調夾夾第 2 品，彈 G 指型，實際響起什麼和弦？

items.source: Two frets up from G is A. The shape stays G; the sound moves up with the capo.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-1 “The capo” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: G 提高兩品是 A。指型仍是 G，聲音則隨移調夾提高。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-1 “The capo” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: With a capo you still think G, C and D, the shapes you know. The diagrams here name the chord you actually hear, so a G shape on capo 2 reads A.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-1 “The capo” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 使用移調夾時，仍想著熟悉的 G、C、D 指型。這裡的圖表標示實際聽到的和弦，因此第 2 品移調夾上的 G 指型會顯示 A。

items.source: G and D shapes on capo 2
items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-2 “G and D shapes on capo 2” · title
items.translation: 第 2 品移調夾上的 G、D 指型

items.source: The G family, two frets up
items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-2 “G and D shapes on capo 2” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: On capo 2, G, C, D and E minor shapes sound as A, D, E and F sharp minor. Same fingers, new key: A major.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-2 “G and D shapes on capo 2” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 移調夾夾第 2 品時，G、C、D、E 小和弦指型分別發出 A、D、E、升 F 小和弦。指法相同，新調性則是 A 大調。

items.source: Capo on fret 2. A D shape sounds as…
items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-2 “G and D shapes on capo 2” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 移調夾夾第 2 品，D 指型響起的是…

items.source: Two frets above D is E.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-2 “G and D shapes on capo 2” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-2 “G and D shapes on capo 2” · step 6 (explain) · title

items.source: D shapes work the same way. On capo 2, D, G and A shapes sound as E, A and B: the key of E with easy open fingerings.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-2 “G and D shapes on capo 2” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: D 指型也一樣。移調夾夾第 2 品，D、G、A 指型會發出 E、A、B，讓你用簡單開放指法演奏 E 調。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · title
Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Most songs alternate two sections. The verse tells the story; the chorus repeats the hook. Stephen Foster's Oh! Susanna (1848) has both. Capo off: it's in G.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 多數歌曲交替使用兩個段落。主歌講故事，副歌重複記憶點。《噢！蘇珊娜》（Stephen Foster，1848）兩者都有。拿下移調夾，這首是 G 調。

items.source: The pickup and first bar: open G, A at fret 2, then open B, D at fret 3 twice, and open E.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 弱起與第一小節：空弦 G、第 2 品 A，再到空弦 B，第 3 品 D 兩次，接著空弦 E。

items.source: Which section usually comes back with the same words?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 哪個段落通常以相同歌詞反覆出現？

items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Verses change their words as the story moves on. The chorus returns unchanged, and that's what people sing along to.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 主歌隨故事推進更換歌詞，副歌則不變地回來，也是大家跟著唱的部分。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 6 (explain) · title

items.source: Back the verse with G and D7, boom-chick style: bass on one, strum on two. Three bars of G, one of D7, two of G, then D7 and G.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 用 G、D7 配主歌，採鄉村低音掃弦：第一拍低音、第二拍掃弦。三小節 G、一小節 D7、兩小節 G，再接 D7 與 G。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 8 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 9 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-4 “Oh! Susanna: the chorus” · title
Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-4 “Oh! Susanna: the chorus” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: The chorus opens on C, string 2, fret 1, then jumps to open E. Its chords are C, G and D7, and its second half matches the verse's ending.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-4 “Oh! Susanna: the chorus” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 副歌以第 2 弦第 1 品的 C 開頭，再跳到空弦 E。和弦是 C、G、D7，後半段與主歌結尾相同。

items.source: The opening: C twice on string 2, fret 1, then open E three times.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-4 “Oh! Susanna: the chorus” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 開頭：第 2 弦第 1 品的 C 兩次，再彈空弦 E 三次。

items.source: Then down: D twice, open B, open G, and A at fret 2.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-4 “Oh! Susanna: the chorus” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 接著下行：D 兩次、空弦 B、空弦 G，再到第 2 品的 A。

items.source: The three E's go short, long, short. Where does the long one start?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-4 “Oh! Susanna: the chorus” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 三個 E 依序短、長、短，長音從哪裡開始？

items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-4 “Oh! Susanna: the chorus” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-4 “Oh! Susanna: the chorus” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: It starts on the and and rings across the next beat. That push is syncopation, like your pop strum.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-4 “Oh! Susanna: the chorus” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 它從後半拍的「又」開始，延續跨過下一拍。這種推進就是切分，和流行掃弦一樣。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · title
Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: An arrangement decides what you play, and when. Yours: a Travis-picked intro, the verse as melody, the chorus strummed boom-chick, then the chorus melody to finish.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 編曲決定何時彈什麼。你的安排是：Travis 指彈前奏、主歌彈旋律、副歌用低音掃弦，最後以副歌旋律結束。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · step 2 (along) · title
items.translation: 前奏：G 的 Travis 指彈

items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: Sets the key and tempo before the melody
items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: 旋律前建立調性與速度

items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A few bars of chords tell everyone where home is and how fast to go.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 幾小節和弦就能告訴大家主音在哪裡，以及要用多快的速度。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · step 4 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · step 6 (explain) · title

items.source: Finish with the chorus melody and let the last G ring. Ending on the tune everyone just heard feels complete.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 最後彈副歌旋律，讓最後的 G 延續。用大家剛聽過的旋律收尾，感覺就完整了。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-spotlight “Song spotlight: Gravel Road Two-Step” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 《碎石路雙步舞》是 Timbre 原創歌曲，以 A、D、E 組成 A 調舞廳鄉村曲。移調夾夾第 2 品，用你最熟悉的 G、C、D 指型演奏。完整歌曲在歌曲頁面的原創歌曲中。

items.source: Capo on fret 2. Which shape sounds as E?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-spotlight “Song spotlight: Gravel Road Two-Step” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 移調夾夾第 2 品，哪個指型會響出 E？

items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-spotlight “Song spotlight: Gravel Road Two-Step” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-spotlight “Song spotlight: Gravel Road Two-Step” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-spotlight “Song spotlight: Gravel Road Two-Step” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Two frets above D is E. On capo 2 the G shape gives A, and the C shape gives D.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-spotlight “Song spotlight: Gravel Road Two-Step” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: D 往上兩品是 E。移調夾夾第 2 品，G 指型發出 A，C 指型發出 D。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-spotlight “Song spotlight: Gravel Road Two-Step” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: Pick the chord's root on beats one and three, and strum on two and four, each with a quick up after it. Boom, chick-a, boom, chick-a: the dancers' steps.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-spotlight “Song spotlight: Gravel Road Two-Step” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 第一、第三拍撥和弦根音，第二、第四拍掃弦，後面各接一次快速向上掃。咚、鏘呀、咚、鏘呀，就是舞者的步伐。

Guitar · Unit 16 · challenge gtr-16-6 “Final showcase” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: No new ideas: the capo, G and D shapes, and your Oh! Susanna arrangement. Play it as if someone's listening. Maybe someone is.
