items.source: Five open shapes become five places to play G, and chords that stay near your hand.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 “The CAGED system” · unit summary
items.translation: 五個開放指型成為演奏 G 的五個位置，讓和弦留在手邊。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-1 “One chord, five shapes” · title
Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-1 “One chord, five shapes” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Every major chord can borrow the shape of open C, A, G, E or D, moved up the neck. Climbing from any one, the shapes come in that order, C A G E D, and each locks onto the next.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-1 “One chord, five shapes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 每個大和弦都能借用開放 C、A、G、E、D 指型，沿琴頸移動。從任一指型往上走，都依 C A G E D 的循環順序排列，彼此銜接。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-1 “One chord, five shapes” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-1 “One chord, five shapes” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-1 “One chord, five shapes” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-1 “One chord, five shapes” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: C, A, G, E and D: the five open shapes that every major chord can borrow, anywhere on the neck.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-1 “One chord, five shapes” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: C、A、G、E、D：每個大和弦都能借用的五種開放指型，適用於琴頸各處。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-1 “One chord, five shapes” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: Climb from open G and the next shape is the E shape: your G barre at fret 3. Its root on string 6 is the same G as in the open chord.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-1 “One chord, five shapes” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 從開放 G 往上走，下一個是 E 指型，也就是第 3 品的 G 橫按。第 6 弦的根音，與開放和弦中的 G 相同。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-1 “One chord, five shapes” · step 6 (listen) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 1 (explain) · title
items.translation: 第 5 品的 D 指型

items.source: Open D moved up five frets is G. Finger 1 holds string 4 at fret 5, where the nut used to be. Fingers 2, 4 and 3 rebuild the D triangle above it.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 開放 D 提高五品就是 G。第 1 指按住第 4 弦第 5 品，取代原本弦枕的位置。第 2、4、3 指在前方重新組成 D 三角形。

items.source: The D shape, string by string
items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 3 (along) · title

items.source: Where is the D shape's root?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: D 指型的根音在哪裡？

items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: 第 1 弦，第 3 指下方

items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: 第 3 弦，第 2 指下方

items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: 第 4 弦，第 1 指下方

items.source: Open D's root is open string 4. Moved up, finger 1 holds it: G at fret 5. String 2, fret 8 is a G too.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 開放 D 的根音是第 4 弦空弦。移高後由第 1 指按住：第 5 品的 G。第 2 弦第 8 品也是 G。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: The E shape at fret 3 and the D shape at fret 5 share one note: G on string 4, fret 5. Keep your eyes on it as you move between them.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 第 3 品 E 指型與第 5 品 D 指型共享一個音：第 4 弦第 5 品的 G。兩者切換時，眼睛留意這個音。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-3 “The C shape” · step 1 (explain) · title
items.translation: 第 7 品的 C 指型

items.source: Open C moved up seven frets is G. Finger 1 lies across strings 3, 2 and 1 at fret 7, finger 2 takes string 2 at fret 8, and fingers 3 and 4 stretch to strings 4 and 5.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-3 “The C shape” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 開放 C 提高七品就是 G。第 1 指在第 7 品橫按第 3、2、1 弦，第 2 指按第 2 弦第 8 品，第 3、4 指伸到第 4、5 弦。

items.source: The C shape, string by string
items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-3 “The C shape” · step 3 (along) · title

items.source: Like open C, the C shape's root is on…
items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-3 “The C shape” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 和開放 C 一樣，C 指型的根音在…

items.source: Open C's root is string 5, fret 3. Here your little finger holds it: G at fret 10.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-3 “The C shape” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 開放 C 的根音在第 5 弦第 3 品。這裡由小指按住：第 10 品的 G。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-3 “The C shape” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: Slide the C shape down to fret 2 and it's D, with its root on string 5, fret 5. The name always follows the root.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-3 “The C shape” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 把 C 指型往下滑到第 2 品就成為 D，根音在第 5 弦第 5 品。名稱永遠跟著根音。

items.source: The A shape, and around again
items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · title
Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · step 1 (explain) · title
items.translation: 第 10 品的 A 指型

items.source: Barre strings 5 to 1 at fret 10 and lay finger 3 across strings 4, 3 and 2 at fret 12. It's your A-shape barre, and it's G again.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 第 10 品橫按第 5 至 1 弦，再把第 3 指放在第 12 品，橫按第 4、3、2 弦。這是 A 指型橫按，又是一個 G。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Past the A shape, the G shape comes back at fret 12: open G, one octave higher. From there the five shapes repeat in the same order.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 過了 A 指型，第 12 品又出現 G 指型，也就是提高一個八度的開放 G。從這裡起，五個指型以相同順序重複。

items.source: Going up the neck, which shape comes after A?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 沿琴頸往上，A 之後是哪個指型？

items.source: The order loops: C, A, G, E, D, then C again. After A comes G.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 順序循環是 C、A、G、E、D，再回到 C。A 之後是 G。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · step 5 (listen) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-5 “Chords near your hand” · title
Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-5 “Chords near your hand” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: With CAGED you rarely have to jump. Around fret 5, G is the D shape, C is the G shape and D is the A shape. Three chords, one spot.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-5 “Chords near your hand” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 有了 CAGED，很少需要大幅跳動。在第 5 品附近，G 用 D 指型、C 用 G 指型、D 用 A 指型。三個和弦，一個區域。

items.source: Which shape plays C right beside the D-shape G?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-5 “Chords near your hand” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 哪個指型能在 D 指型的 G 旁邊彈 C？

items.source: C's G shape uses frets 5 and 8, right where your hand already is.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-5 “Chords near your hand” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: C 的 G 指型使用第 5、8 品，就在你目前手位附近。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-5 “Chords near your hand” · step 7 (explain) · title

items.source: The same idea works lower: G as the E shape at fret 3, C as the A shape at fret 3, and D as the C shape at fret 2.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-5 “Chords near your hand” · step 7 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 低把位也同樣適用：第 3 品 E 指型的 G、第 3 品 A 指型的 C，以及第 2 品 C 指型的 D。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-spotlight “Song spotlight: Lantern Hill” · title
Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-spotlight “Song spotlight: Lantern Hill” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Lantern Hill is a Timbre Original: a campfire sing-along on G, C and D. Play its chorus open, then near fret 5, then near fret 3, and the same song moves around the neck. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-spotlight “Song spotlight: Lantern Hill” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 《燈籠山丘》是 Timbre 原創歌曲，用 G、C、D 一起唱出營火旋律。副歌先用開放指型，再移到第 5 品附近，最後到第 3 品附近，同一首歌就能走遍琴頸。完整歌曲在歌曲頁面的原創歌曲中。

items.source: Near fret 5, which shape plays C?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-spotlight “Song spotlight: Lantern Hill” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 第 5 品附近，用哪個指型彈 C？

items.source: C's G shape uses frets 5 and 8, right beside the D-shape G and the A-shape D.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-spotlight “Song spotlight: Lantern Hill” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: C 的 G 指型使用第 5、8 品，就在 D 指型的 G 與 A 指型的 D 旁邊。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-spotlight “Song spotlight: Lantern Hill” · step 6 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 17 · challenge gtr-17-6 “CAGED challenge” · title
Guitar · Unit 17 · challenge gtr-17-6 “CAGED challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: No new ideas: G in all five shapes, and G, C and D near fret 3 and fret 5. Name each shape as you land it.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · challenge gtr-17-6 “CAGED challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 沒有新內容：五種指型的 G，以及第 3 品、第 5 品附近的 G、C、D。每次按好就說出指型名稱。

items.source: G with the D shape sits at…
items.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · challenge gtr-17-6 “CAGED challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: D 指型的 G 位於…

items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 “Triads up the neck” · title

items.source: Three-note chords on the top strings: major and minor, every inversion, and progressions that barely move.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 “Triads up the neck” · unit summary
items.translation: 高音弦上的三音和弦：大與小、所有轉位，以及幾乎不必移動的進行。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · title
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A triad is the smallest full chord: a root, a third and a fifth. On strings 3, 2 and 1, triads ring clear and bright, and they work anywhere on the neck.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 三和弦是最小的完整和弦：根音、三音、五音。在第 3、2、1 弦上，聲音清晰明亮，也能沿琴頸移動。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 3 (along) · title

items.source: Which notes make a C major triad?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: C 大三和弦由哪些音組成？

items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Root, third, fifth: from C, skip a letter to E, then skip another to G.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 根音、三音、五音：從 C 隔一個字母到 E，再隔一個到 G。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: Move the lowest note to the top and you get an inversion. With E at the bottom, C sits at frets 9, 8 and 8. With G at the bottom, it's the top of your open C.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 把最低音搬到最高處，就得到轉位。E 在最下方時，C 位於第 9、8、8 品；G 在最下方時，就是開放 C 的高音部分。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · title
items.translation: G 與 D 的轉位

items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Every major triad on these strings uses one of three shapes, one per inversion. Learn them on G and D and you can find any major chord.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 這些弦上的每個大三和弦，都使用三種指型之一，各對應一種排列。學會 G 與 D，就能找到任何大和弦。

items.source: G at frets 4, 3 and 3 has the same shape as…
items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 第 4、3、3 品的 G 與哪個指型相同？

items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Both put the third at the bottom: one fret up on string 3, the other two level. Same shape, five frets apart.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 兩者都把三音放在最下方：第 3 弦高一品，另兩弦同品。指型相同，相隔五品。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: D at frets 7, 7 and 5 has the root-position shape of your C at fret 5. Lower down, frets 2, 3 and 2 are the top of your open D.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 第 7、7、5 品的 D，與第 5 品 C 的原位指型相同。較低處的第 2、3、2 品，則是開放 D 的高音部分。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · title
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A minor triad is a major triad with its third one fret lower. On these strings, A minor at frets 2, 1 and 0 is the top of your open A minor.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 小三和弦就是將大三和弦的三音降低一品。這些弦上的第 2、1、0 品，是開放 A 小和弦的高音部分。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · step 4 (explain) · title
items.translation: 第 5 品的 A 小和弦

items.source: Barre fret 5 across strings 3, 2 and 1 and you have A minor with C at the bottom. One finger, three notes.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 在第 5 品橫按第 3、2、1 弦，就得到以 C 為最低音的 A 小和弦。一根手指，三個音。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · step 6 (explain) · title
items.translation: 旁邊的 E 小和弦

items.source: E minor at frets 4, 5 and 3 puts B at the bottom. It sits right beside A minor at fret 5, so the change is tiny.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 第 4、5、3 品的 E 小和弦，把 B 放在最下方。它就在第 5 品 A 小和弦旁邊，切換幅度很小。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · title
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Pick the inversion closest to your hand and a progression barely moves. G, E minor, C and D all live between frets 2 and 5.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 選最靠近手位的轉位，整個進行幾乎不必移動。G、E 小和弦、C、D 都在第 2 至 5 品之間。

items.source: From G at frets 4, 3, 3 to E minor at 4, 5, 3, which notes stay?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 從第 4、3、3 品的 G 到第 4、5、3 品的 E 小和弦，哪些音不動？

items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: B on string 3 and G on string 1 stay put. Only string 2 moves, from D up to E.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 第 3 弦的 B、第 1 弦的 G 留在原位。只有第 2 弦移動，從 D 提高到 E。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: The same four chords sit higher too: G at frets 7, 8 and 7, E minor at 9, 8 and 7, C at 9, 8 and 8, and D at 7, 7 and 5.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 相同四個和弦也在更高處：G 在第 7、8、7 品，E 小和弦在第 9、8、7 品，C 在第 9、8、8 品，D 在第 7、7、5 品。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · title
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Play a triad's notes one at a time and you have an arpeggio. Through a progression, the notes make a melody of their own.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 將三和弦的音逐一彈出，就是琶音。沿著和弦進行，這些音會形成自己的旋律。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 2 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: A chord played one note at a time
items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 4 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: The top notes here run G, G, G, F sharp: almost still while the chords change under them. A note that two chords share is a common tone, and it's why triads sound so smooth.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 這裡的最高音依序是 G、G、G、升 F；下方和弦改變時，它幾乎不動。兩個和弦共享的音叫共同音，也是三和弦聽起來流暢的原因。

items.source: Did the top note go up or down?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 6 (listen) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 7 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-spotlight “Song spotlight: Roller Rink” · title
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-spotlight “Song spotlight: Roller Rink” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Roller Rink is a Timbre Original: retro dance pop on G, E minor, C and D, your four triads between frets 2 and 5. Small shapes on the top strings sound bright and tight, like a second guitar. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-spotlight “Song spotlight: Roller Rink” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 《溜冰場》是 Timbre 原創歌曲，用 G、E 小和弦、C、D 演奏復古舞曲流行樂，正是第 2 至 5 品的四個三和弦。高音弦的小指型明亮緊實，像第二把吉他。完整歌曲在歌曲頁面的原創歌曲中。

items.source: Roller Rink's loop is the one, six, four and five of G. Which chord is the six?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-spotlight “Song spotlight: Roller Rink” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 《溜冰場》的循環是 G 調的一、六、四、五級。哪個和弦是六級？

items.source: Count up G major: G 1, A 2, B 3, C 4, D 5, E 6. The chord on 6 is minor: E minor.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-spotlight “Song spotlight: Roller Rink” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 沿 G 大調往上數：G 1、A 2、B 3、C 4、D 5、E 6。第 6 級是小和弦：E 小和弦。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-spotlight “Song spotlight: Roller Rink” · step 4 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 18 · challenge gtr-18-6 “Triad challenge” · title
Guitar · Unit 18 · challenge gtr-18-6 “Triad challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: No new ideas: major and minor triads, their inversions, G, E minor, C and D in two places, and the arpeggios. Keep every move small.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · challenge gtr-18-6 “Triad challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 沒有新內容：大、小三和弦及其轉位、兩個位置的 G、E 小和弦、C、D，以及琶音。每次移動都保持小幅度。

items.source: A minor triad is a major triad with…
items.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · challenge gtr-18-6 “Triad challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 小三和弦是將大三和弦的…

Guitar · Unit 19 “Seventh chords and jazz voicings” · title

items.source: Major, minor and dominant sevenths, open and barred, the ii–V–I, and swing comping.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 “Seventh chords and jazz voicings” · unit summary
items.translation: 開放與橫按的大七、小七、屬七和弦、ii–V–I，以及搖擺伴奏。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · title
Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A major seventh chord adds the note one fret below the root's octave. It turns a plain major chord soft and dreamy. Open Cmaj7 is C with finger 1 lifted.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 大七和弦加入比根音高八度低一品的音，讓普通大和弦變得柔和夢幻。開放 Cmaj7 就是 C 抬起第 1 指。

items.source: Cmaj7 is C plus which note?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Cmaj7 是 C 加上哪個音？

items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: The major seventh sits one fret below the root's octave: B, just under C.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 大七度在根音高八度的下方一品：也就是緊鄰 C 下方的 B。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: Play the mini F, but let finger 1 press string 2 only. Open string 1, E, is the major seventh of F.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 按簡易 F，但第 1 指只按第 2 弦。第 1 弦空弦 E，就是 F 的大七度音。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · title
Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A minor seventh chord adds the note two frets below the root's octave. It sounds mellow, between dark and bright. Am7 is A minor with finger 3 lifted.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 小七和弦加入比根音高八度低兩品的音，聲音柔和，介於暗沉與明亮之間。Am7 就是 A 小和弦抬起第 3 指。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: Dm7: finger 2 on string 3, fret 2, and finger 1 flat across strings 2 and 1 at fret 1. Em7: just finger 2 on string 5, fret 2.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Dm7：第 2 指按第 3 弦第 2 品，第 1 指在第 1 品平按第 2、1 弦。Em7：只需第 2 指按第 5 弦第 2 品。

items.source: Am7 is A minor plus which note?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Am7 是 A 小和弦加上哪個音？

items.source: The minor seventh sits two frets below the root's octave: G, two frets under A.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 小七度在根音高八度下方兩品：也就是 A 下方兩品的 G。

items.source: Sevenths with the root on string 5
items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · title
items.translation: 根音在第 5 弦的七和弦

items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Finger 1 holds string 5 at fret 3 and lies across to string 1. Finger 3 takes string 4, finger 2 string 3 and finger 4 string 2.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 第 1 指按第 5 弦第 3 品，並橫按至第 1 弦。第 3 指負責第 4 弦，第 2 指第 3 弦，第 4 指第 2 弦。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 3 (explain) · title
items.translation: 第 5 品的 Dm7 與 D7

items.source: Dm7 is your A minor barre with the little finger lifted. D7 is the A-shape barre with fingers 3 and 4 on strings 4 and 2. Both are named after string 5.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Dm7 是 A 小和弦橫按抬起小指。D7 則用 A 指型橫按，第 3、4 指分別按第 4、2 弦。兩者都以第 5 弦命名。

items.source: Dm7 at fret 5. Where is its root?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 第 5 品的 Dm7，根音在哪裡？

items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Like every A-shape chord, it's named after its note on string 5.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 和所有 A 指型和弦一樣，它以第 5 弦上的音命名。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · title
Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Jazz's favorite move: the chord on the second note of the key, then the fifth, then home. In C that's Dm7, G7 and Cmaj7.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 爵士最愛的走法：調性第二音上的和弦，再到第五音，最後回家。C 調就是 Dm7、G7、Cmaj7。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: Play the E7 shape as a barre at fret 3: finger 1 across all six strings, finger 3 on string 5 and finger 2 on string 3. Its root is on string 6.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 在第 3 品橫按 E7 指型：第 1 指橫跨六條弦，第 3 指按第 5 弦，第 2 指按第 3 弦。根音在第 6 弦。

items.source: In the key of C, which chord is the ii?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: C 調中，哪個和弦是 ii？

items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Count up from C: C is one, D is two. The seventh chord built on D is D minor seven.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 從 C 往上數：C 是一，D 是二。建立在 D 上的七和弦是 D 小七和弦。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 7 (explain) · title

items.source: Jazz players often let each chord ring for just a moment. Squeeze as you strum, ease off right after, and the chords start to swing.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 7 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 爵士樂手常讓和弦只響一下。掃弦時按緊，之後立刻放鬆，和弦就開始有搖擺感。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-5 “Swing comping” · title
Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-5 “Swing comping” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Swing guitarists comp: short chords that answer the band. The Charleston rhythm hits beat one and the swung and of two, then leaves space.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-5 “Swing comping” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 搖擺吉他用短促和弦回應樂團，稱為和弦伴奏。查爾斯頓節奏在第一拍和第二拍的搖擺後半拍落下，再留出空間。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-5 “Swing comping” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: In G, the two, five, one is Am7, D7 and Gmaj7. Am7 is the E minor seven barre at fret 5; Gmaj7 skips string 5, with its root on string 6, fret 3.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-5 “Swing comping” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: G 調的二、五、一級是 Am7、D7、Gmaj7。Am7 是第 5 品的 E 小七指型橫按；Gmaj7 略過第 5 弦，根音在第 6 弦第 3 品。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-spotlight “Song spotlight: Late Checkout” · title
Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-spotlight “Song spotlight: Late Checkout” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Late Checkout is a Timbre Original: lo-fi in C on Dm7, G7, Cmaj7 and Am7. That's a ii–V–I, plus the six chord to start it over. Comp it with your barred sevenths and the Charleston. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-spotlight “Song spotlight: Late Checkout” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 《延遲退房》是 Timbre 原創歌曲，以 Dm7、G7、Cmaj7、Am7 組成 C 調低傳真曲風。這是 ii–V–I，再加六級和弦帶回循環。用橫按七和弦與查爾斯頓節奏伴奏。完整歌曲在歌曲頁面的原創歌曲中。

items.source: In Late Checkout, which chord is the V?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-spotlight “Song spotlight: Late Checkout” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 《延遲退房》中，哪個和弦是 V？

items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-spotlight “Song spotlight: Late Checkout” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Count up C major: C 1, D 2, E 3, F 4, G 5. The seventh chord on G is G7.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-spotlight “Song spotlight: Late Checkout” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 沿 C 大調往上數：C 1、D 2、E 3、F 4、G 5。建立在 G 上的七和弦是 G7。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · challenge gtr-19-6 “Jazz chord challenge” · title
Guitar · Unit 19 · challenge gtr-19-6 “Jazz chord challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: No new ideas: major, minor and dominant sevenths, open and barred, and the ii–V–I in C and G. Keep the chords short and the swing steady.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · challenge gtr-19-6 “Jazz chord challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 沒有新內容：開放與橫按的大七、小七、屬七和弦，以及 C 調、G 調 ii–V–I。和弦保持短促，搖擺保持穩定。

items.source: Which seventh sits one fret below the root's octave?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · challenge gtr-19-6 “Jazz chord challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 哪種七度在根音高八度下方一品？

items.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · challenge gtr-19-6 “Jazz chord challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 19 · challenge gtr-19-6 “Jazz chord challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 20 “The major scale in position” · title

items.source: G major in two octaves at fret 2, scale degrees and chords, and the Dorian and Mixolydian modes.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 “The major scale in position” · unit summary
items.translation: 第 2 品把位的兩個八度 G 大音階、音級與和弦，以及多利安、混合利底亞調式。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · title
Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A half step is one fret, a whole step two. Every major scale climbs whole, whole, half, whole, whole, whole, half. That pattern gives major its sound.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 半音是一品，全音是兩品。每個大音階都以全、全、半、全、全、全、半上行，這個排列造就大調的聲音。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 2 (explain) · title
items.translation: 第 2 品把位的 G 大音階

items.source: Put finger 1 at fret 2 and give each finger its own fret, up to fret 5. From G on string 6, fret 3, the scale climbs across strings 6, 5 and 4.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 第 1 指放第 2 品，每根手指各負責一品，直到第 5 品。從第 6 弦第 3 品的 G 開始，跨第 6、5、4 弦上行。

items.source: String 6: frets 3 and 5, fingers 2 and 4. String 5: frets 2 and 3, fingers 1 and 2.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第 6 弦：第 3、5 品，用第 2、4 指。第 5 弦：第 2、3 品，用第 1、2 指。

items.source: String 5, fret 5, then string 4: frets 2, 4 and 5. Home on G.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第 5 弦第 5 品，再到第 4 弦第 2、4、5 品，回家到 G。

items.source: Where do the half steps fall in a major scale?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 大音階的半音落在哪裡？

items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: 第 3、4 音及第 7、8 音之間

items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Whole, whole, half: the first half step is from 3 to 4. Whole, whole, whole, half: the second is from 7 to 8.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 全、全、半：第一個半音從第 3 到第 4 音。全、全、全、半：第二個從第 7 到第 8 音。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 7 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · title
Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: The same position carries on: A, B and C on string 3, D and E on string 2, F sharp and G on string 1. Your hand never moves.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 沿同一把位繼續：第 3 弦 A、B、C，第 2 弦 D、E，第 1 弦升 F、G。整隻手不用移動。

items.source: String 3: frets 2, 4, 5. String 2: frets 3, 5. String 1: frets 2, 3.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 3 (along) · title

items.source: In this position, which finger plays fret 5?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 這個把位中，哪根手指彈第 5 品？

items.source: Finger 1 sits at fret 2, so fret 5 belongs to finger 4, your little finger.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 第 1 指在第 2 品，因此第 5 品由第 4 指，也就是小指負責。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 5 (along) · title

items.source: A carol built on the scale
items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 6 (explain) · title

items.source: Joy to the World, arranged by Lowell Mason in 1839, opens with the G major scale straight down from the top. You know every note already.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Lowell Mason 於 1839 年編曲的《普世歡騰》，開頭就是 G 大音階從最高處一路下行。每個音你都已經會了。

items.source: Joy to the World, in position
items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 7 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · title
Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Number the scale from G: G is 1, A is 2, and so on up to F sharp, 7. Musicians use these numbers to talk about melodies and chords in any key.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 從 G 為音階編號：G 是 1、A 是 2，一路到升 F 的 7。樂手用這些數字討論任何調性的旋律與和弦。

items.source: In G major, which note is 5?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: G 大調中，第 5 音是哪個？

items.source: Count up from G: G 1, A 2, B 3, C 4, D 5.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Stack every other scale note on each degree and you get the key's chords. Chords on 1, 4 and 5 are major; on 2, 3 and 6 they're minor. In G: G, C and D, then A minor, B minor and E minor.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 在每個音級上隔一音疊加，就得到調內和弦。第 1、4、5 級是大和弦，第 2、3、6 級是小和弦。G 調中分別是 G、C、D，以及 A 小和弦、B 小和弦、E 小和弦。

items.source: In G major, which chord is built on 6?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: G 大調中，第 6 級建立什麼和弦？

items.source: The sixth note is E, and chords on 2, 3 and 6 are minor. Stack E, G and B: E minor.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 第六音是 E，而第 2、3、6 級是小和弦。疊起 E、G、B，就是 E 小和弦。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 7 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · title
Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Play G major's notes but treat A as home, and the scale turns minor. This sound is A Dorian, a mode of G major: same position, new starting note.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 彈 G 大音階的音，但以 A 為家，音階就帶小調色彩。這是 G 大調的調式 A 多利安：相同把位，新的起音。

items.source: Start on A, string 6, fret 5, with finger 4, and climb the same frets to A on string 3.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 用第 4 指從第 6 弦第 5 品的 A 開始，沿相同品位上行到第 3 弦的 A。

items.source: Which note makes A Dorian brighter than plain A minor?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 哪個音讓 A 多利安比一般 A 小調明亮？

items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Plain A minor has F. Dorian keeps G major's F sharp: a bright spot in a minor scale.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 一般 A 小調有 F，多利安保留 G 大調的升 F，為小調音階添一點亮色。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 5 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 6 (along) · title
items.translation: A 多利安旋律：流暢演奏

items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · title
Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Now treat D as home. G major's notes from D to D make D Mixolydian: a major scale with its seventh one fret lower. It's all over folk, rock and fiddle tunes.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 現在以 D 為家。用 G 大調的音從 D 到 D，就是 D 混合利底亞：大音階的第七音降低一品。民謠、搖滾與民俗小提琴曲常使用它。

items.source: From D on string 5, fret 5, up the same position to D on string 2, fret 3.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 從第 5 弦第 5 品的 D，沿同一把位上行到第 2 弦第 3 品的 D。

items.source: D major has C sharp. D Mixolydian has…

items.source: Many older songs use AABA: a tune, the same tune again, a contrasting bridge, then the tune once more. Each section often runs eight bars; here they run four.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 許多老歌使用 AABA：一段旋律、再重複一次、形成對比的橋段，最後再回到原旋律。每段通常有八小節；這裡每段是四小節。

items.source: In AABA form, which section is the bridge?

items.translation: AABA 曲式中，哪一段是橋段？

items.source: The easiest intro is the song's last line, played before the first verse. It sets the key, the tempo and the mood, and the singer knows exactly where to come in.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-2 “Intros and endings” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 最簡單的前奏，就是在第一段主歌前，先彈歌曲的最後一句。它能確立調性、速度和氣氛，讓歌手清楚知道何時加入。

items.source: An intro from the last line

items.source: Why start with the song's last line?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-2 “Intros and endings” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: To end, repeat the last line, often twice more, and let the final chord ring. A tag tells everyone the song is closing.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-2 “Intros and endings” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 結尾時，再重複最後一句，通常再唱兩次，並讓最後的和弦持續鳴響。尾句讓大家知道歌曲即將結束。

items.source: Arrangers lift a chorus by changing what the guitar does. Fingerpick the verse softly, then strum the chorus, and the same chords suddenly sound bigger.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-3 “Picked verse, strummed chorus” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 編曲者會改變吉他的彈奏方式，讓副歌更有氣勢。主歌輕柔指彈，副歌改用刷弦，同樣的和弦就會突然變得更飽滿。

items.source: Verse: Travis on G and D7

items.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · song gtr-22-5 “Down by the Riverside: your arrangement” · title

items.source: Down by the Riverside, a spiritual first printed in 1918, gets the full treatment: a Travis-picked intro, two verses and choruses, a pentatonic solo, and a tag.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · song gtr-22-5 “Down by the Riverside: your arrangement” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 《河畔》是一首於 1918 年首次出版的靈歌。這次做完整編曲：Travis 指彈前奏、兩次主歌與副歌、五聲音階獨奏，以及尾句。

items.source: The solo uses G major pentatonic in open position: G, A, B, D and E. It follows the verse's chords and ends a beat early, so the singer can come back in.

items.translation: 這段獨奏使用開放把位的 G 大調五聲音階：G、A、B、D 和 E。它跟隨主歌的和弦，並提早一拍結束，讓歌手能再次加入。

items.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-spotlight “Song spotlight: Jukebox Moon” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Jukebox Moon is a Timbre Original: a fifties slow dance in AABA form, a verse, the verse again, a bridge on F, then the verse once more. Strum every beat, with a quick swung up into each new bar. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
items.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-spotlight “Song spotlight: Jukebox Moon” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 《點唱機下的月亮》是 Timbre 原創曲：採用 AABA 曲式的五〇年代慢舞曲，一段主歌、再唱一次主歌、以 F 和弦展開的橋段，最後再回到主歌。每拍刷弦，並在每個新小節前加一下快速、帶搖擺感的上刷。完整歌曲位於「歌曲」的「原創歌曲」分類。

items.source: In Jukebox Moon, which section is the B?
items.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-spotlight “Song spotlight: Jukebox Moon” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 《點唱機下的月亮》中，哪一段是 B？

items.translation: 主歌共用同一段旋律：A、A。橋段帶來新和弦和新旋律，也就是 B，然後再回到主歌。

items.source: On most instruments the strings get lower as you go up. On ukulele, string 4 (G) is higher than string 3 (C). This is called re-entrant tuning.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 1 · lesson uke-1-3 “The high G string” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 大多數弦樂器越往上，弦的音就越低。烏克麗麗的第 4 弦（G）卻比第 3 弦（C）高。這叫作重入式調弦。

items.translation: 高音 G 讓每個和弦的音靠得更近，也更明亮。這就是大家熟悉的烏克麗麗那種甜美、清亮的聲音。

items.translation: 用拇指指腹從第 4 弦往第 1 弦，向下輕刷四條弦。手腕保持放鬆。

items.source: Which finger plays the C chord?
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 1 · lesson uke-2-1 “Your first chord: C” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 彈 C 和弦要用哪根手指？

items.context: Ukulele · Unit 1 · lesson uke-2-1 “Your first chord: C” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 1 · lesson uke-2-1 “Your first chord: C” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Your third finger reaches fret 3 without a stretch.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 1 · lesson uke-2-1 “Your first chord: C” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 第三指可以自然伸到第 3 品，不必勉強伸展。

items.context: Ukulele · Unit 1 · song uke-1-7 “Row, Row, Row Your Boat” · title
Ukulele · Unit 1 · song uke-1-7 “Row, Row, Row Your Boat” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Row, Row, Row Your Boat needs only C. Strum it on the two big beats of every bar, then play the tune on strings 1 to 3.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 1 · song uke-1-7 “Row, Row, Row Your Boat” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 《划呀，划呀，划小船》只需要 C 和弦。每小節在兩個大拍上刷弦，再用第 1 至 3 弦彈旋律。

items.source: The tune's five notes: C and D on string 3, E, F and G on string 2.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 1 · song uke-1-7 “Row, Row, Row Your Boat” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 旋律的五個音：第 3 弦的 C 和 D，第 2 弦的 E、F 和 G。

items.context: Ukulele · Unit 1 · song uke-1-7 “Row, Row, Row Your Boat” · arrangement · song section label (Intro, Verse 1 …) on a small chip
Ukulele · Unit 1 · song uke-1-7 “Row, Row, Row Your Boat” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)

items.source: A minor, F, G7 and G: with C, the chords behind countless songs.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 “First chords” · unit summary
items.translation: A 小和弦、F、G7 和 G：加上 C，就是無數歌曲背後的和弦。

items.source: A minor and your first change
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-2 “A minor and your first change” · title
items.translation: A 小和弦與第一次換和弦

items.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-2 “A minor and your first change” · step 1 (explain) · title
items.translation: A 小和弦：還是只用一根手指

items.source: Put your second finger on fret 2 of string 4 and strum all four strings. A minor sounds darker than C.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-2 “A minor and your first change” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 第二指按第 4 弦第 2 品，刷響四條弦。A 小和弦聽起來比 C 更暗沉。

items.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-2 “A minor and your first change” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction
items.translation: 哪個和弦聽起來更暗沉？

items.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-2 “A minor and your first change” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: Lift the finger you don't need and place the new one while the last strum still rings. Look ahead to the next chord.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-2 “A minor and your first change” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 趁最後一次刷弦還在鳴響時，抬起不需要的手指，放好新的手指。提前看向下一個和弦。

items.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-3 “F: two fingers” · title
Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-3 “F: two fingers” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: First finger on fret 1 of string 2, second finger on fret 2 of string 4. Strings 3 and 1 ring open.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-3 “F: two fingers” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 第一指按第 2 弦第 1 品，第二指按第 4 弦第 2 品。第 3、1 弦彈空弦。

items.source: Which chord shares a finger with F?
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-3 “F: two fingers” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 哪個和弦與 F 共用一根手指的位置？

items.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-3 “F: two fingers” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Your second finger sits on fret 2 of string 4 for both. Keep it down when you change.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-3 “F: two fingers” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 兩個和弦的第二指都按在第 4 弦第 2 品。換和弦時，讓它留在原位。

items.source: G7, the chord that leads home
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-4 “G7, the chord that leads home” · title
Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-4 “G7, the chord that leads home” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: First finger on fret 1 of string 2, second on fret 2 of string 3, third on fret 2 of string 1. Strum all four.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-4 “G7, the chord that leads home” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 第一指按第 2 弦第 1 品，第二指按第 3 弦第 2 品，第三指按第 1 弦第 2 品。刷響四條弦。

items.source: A chord that wants to go home
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-4 “G7, the chord that leads home” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: G7 sounds unfinished. Play C after it and the tension lets go. That pull is why so many songs put G7 before C.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-4 “G7, the chord that leads home” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: G7 聽起來尚未結束。接著彈 C，緊張感就會釋放。這種吸引力，正是許多歌曲在 C 前放 G7 的原因。

items.source: Does this end at home or leave you hanging?
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-4 “G7, the chord that leads home” · step 4 (listen) · question or instruction
items.translation: 這個結尾有回家的感覺，還是懸而未決？

items.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-4 “G7, the chord that leads home” · step 4 (listen) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-4 “G7, the chord that leads home” · step 4 (listen) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-5 “G: three fingers” · title

items.source: First finger on fret 2 of string 3, second on fret 2 of string 1, third on fret 3 of string 2. Arch your fingers so string 4 rings.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-5 “G: three fingers” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 第一指按第 3 弦第 2 品，第二指按第 1 弦第 2 品，第三指按第 2 弦第 3 品。手指拱起，讓第 4 弦能鳴響。

items.source: G and G7 both press which spot?
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-5 “G: three fingers” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: G 和 G7 都要按哪個位置？

items.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-5 “G: three fingers” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-5 “G: three fingers” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-5 “G: three fingers” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Both chords put a finger on fret 2 of string 3. Use it as your anchor.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-5 “G: three fingers” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 兩個和弦都有一根手指按在第 3 弦第 2 品。把它當作固定的支點。

items.source: Which one is G7, the one with more tension?
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-5 “G: three fingers” · step 5 (listen) · question or instruction
items.translation: 哪個是緊張感更強的 G7？

items.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · challenge uke-2-6 “Challenge: five chords” · title
Ukulele · Unit 2 · challenge uke-2-6 “Challenge: five chords” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: C, A minor, F, G7 and G cover hundreds of songs. Make each shape clean, then keep the beat as you change.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · challenge uke-2-6 “Challenge: five chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: C、A 小和弦、F、G7 和 G 能伴奏數百首歌曲。每個指型都要按清楚，再保持拍子換和弦。

items.source: Which chord uses only one finger?
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · challenge uke-2-6 “Challenge: five chords” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 哪個和弦只用一根手指？

items.source: Steady downs, down-ups and the island strum.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 “Strumming” · unit summary
items.translation: 穩定下刷、下上刷，以及島嶼刷法。

items.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-1 “Steady down strums” · title
Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-1 “Steady down strums” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Strum down on every beat: 1, 2, 3, 4. Use the nail of your index finger. When you change chords, your hand keeps moving.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-1 “Steady down strums” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 每拍向下刷：1、2、3、4。使用食指指甲刷弦。換和弦時，手也要持續擺動。

items.source: What should your hand do while you change chords?
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-1 “Steady down strums” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 換和弦時，刷弦的手應該怎麼做？

items.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-1 “Steady down strums” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-1 “Steady down strums” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-1 “Steady down strums” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A late chord is better than a broken beat. Keep strumming, even if a string buzzes.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-1 “Steady down strums” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 和弦晚一點，比拍子中斷好。即使有弦打品，也繼續刷。

items.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-2 “Down and up” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Count 1 and 2 and 3 and 4 and. Strum down on the numbers, up on each and. Your hand never stops moving.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-2 “Down and up” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 數 1 又 2 又 3 又 4 又。數字時下刷，每個「又」時上刷。手一直擺動，不要停。

items.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-2 “Down and up” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Up strums mostly catch strings 1 and 2. Brush them with the pad of your finger, a little softer than the downs.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-2 “Down and up” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 上刷主要碰到第 1、2 弦。用指腹輕刷，力道比下刷稍輕。

items.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-2 “Down and up” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-2 “Down and up” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-2 “Down and up” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Only at the end of a bar
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-2 “Down and up” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-3 “Down, down-up” · title
Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-3 “Down, down-up” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Down on 1, down-up on 2, down on 3, down-up on 4. Your hand still swings up after 1 and 3; it just misses the strings.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-3 “Down, down-up” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 第 1 拍下刷，第 2 拍下上刷，第 3 拍下刷，第 4 拍下上刷。第 1、3 拍之後，手仍向上擺，只是不碰弦。

items.source: What does your hand do on the and of 1?
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-3 “Down, down-up” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 數到第 1 拍的「又」時，手要怎麼做？

items.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-3 “Down, down-up” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-3 “Down, down-up” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-3 “Down, down-up” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A silent up stroke keeps your hand in time for the next down.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-3 “Down, down-up” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 不發聲的上擺能讓手維持節奏，準備下一次下刷。

items.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-4 “The island strum” · title
Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-4 “The island strum” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Down on 1, down-up on 2, skip the down on 3, then up, down-up. The missing down gives it a lilt.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-4 “The island strum” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 第 1 拍下刷，第 2 拍下上刷，第 3 拍略過下刷，再接上、下上。少了這次下刷，就有了輕快的律動。

items.source: Which strum do you skip in the island strum?
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-4 “The island strum” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-4 “The island strum” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-4 “The island strum” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-4 “The island strum” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Your hand still moves down on 3, it just misses the strings. That keeps the up after it in time.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-4 “The island strum” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 第 3 拍時，手仍然向下擺，只是不碰弦。這樣接下來的上刷才會準時。

items.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-5 “Island strum with changes” · title
Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-5 “Island strum with changes” · step 1 (explain) · title
items.translation: 趁最後一次上刷換和弦

items.source: The last up strum of a bar can be loose or open. Use it to move to the next chord, so beat 1 lands clean.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-5 “Island strum with changes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 一小節最後的上刷可以稍微放鬆按弦，或刷空弦。趁這時移到下一個和弦，讓第 1 拍乾淨落下。

items.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · challenge uke-3-6 “Challenge: strum patterns” · title
Ukulele · Unit 3 · challenge uke-3-6 “Challenge: strum patterns” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Downs, down-ups and the island strum. Keep your hand moving and let the chords come to you.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · challenge uke-3-6 “Challenge: strum patterns” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 下刷、下上刷與島嶼刷法。讓手持續擺動，逐漸熟悉和弦轉換。

items.source: Which pattern is the island strum?
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · challenge uke-3-6 “Challenge: strum patterns” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 哪個節奏型是島嶼刷法？

items.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · challenge uke-3-6 “Challenge: strum patterns” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 3 · challenge uke-3-6 “Challenge: strum patterns” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 4 “Melodies” · title

items.source: Play tunes note by note on strings 1 to 3.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 “Melodies” · unit summary
items.translation: 在第 1 至 3 弦上，逐音彈奏旋律。

items.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · lesson uke-4-1 “The C major scale” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: C D E F G A B C. Start on open string 3 and climb across strings 2 and 1. Every note sits in the first three frets.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · lesson uke-4-1 “The C major scale” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: C D E F G A B C。從第 3 弦空弦開始，經過第 2、1 弦往上彈。所有音都在前三品以內。

items.source: String 3 open and fret 2, then string 2 open and fret 1.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · lesson uke-4-1 “The C major scale” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第 3 弦空弦和第 2 品，再彈第 2 弦空弦和第 1 品。

items.source: String 2 fret 3, then string 1: open, fret 2, fret 3.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · lesson uke-4-1 “The C major scale” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第 2 弦第 3 品，再彈第 1 弦：空弦、第 2 品、第 3 品。

items.source: How many different note names are in the scale?
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · lesson uke-4-1 “The C major scale” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 這個音階有幾個不同的音名？

items.source: C to C is eight notes, but the top C repeats the first. Seven names, then they start again.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · lesson uke-4-1 “The C major scale” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 從 C 到 C 有八個音，但最高的 C 重複了第一個音名。七個音名，然後重新開始。

items.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Beethoven wrote this tune in 1824. It moves mostly by step, from one note to the next, on strings 2 and 3.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 貝多芬在 1824 年寫下這段旋律。它主要在第 2、3 弦上，以相鄰音逐步移動。

items.source: The opening: E E F G, G F E D.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 開頭：E E F G，G F E D。

items.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 3 (along) · title

items.source: The first line ends on D. Where does the second line end?
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 第一句在 D 結束。第二句在哪個音結束？

items.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Same start, different finish. The second line comes home to C.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 同樣的開頭，不同的結尾。第二句回到 C 這個歸宿。

Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-3 “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: This traditional tune leaps from C up to G, then walks back down one note at a time. Every line ends on a longer note.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-3 “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 這首傳統旋律先從 C 向上跳到 G，再逐音往下走。每句都以較長的音結束。

items.source: Open string 3, string 2 fret 3, open string 1.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-3 “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第 3 弦空弦、第 2 弦第 3 品、第 1 弦空弦。

items.source: Does this phrase go up or down?
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-3 “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 4 (listen) · question or instruction
items.translation: 這個樂句往上還是往下？

items.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-3 “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 5 (along) · title
Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-3 “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)

Ukulele · Unit 4 · lesson uke-4-4 “Long notes and short notes” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A quarter note lasts one beat, a half note two, a whole note four. Hold each one until the next note starts.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · lesson uke-4-4 “Long notes and short notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 四分音符持續一拍，二分音符兩拍，全音符四拍。每個音都要維持到下一個音開始。

items.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · lesson uke-4-4 “Long notes and short notes” · step 3 (along) · title
Ukulele · Unit 4 · lesson uke-4-4 “Long notes and short notes” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: A dot adds half the note's length. A dotted half note lasts three beats; a dotted quarter lasts one and a half.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · lesson uke-4-4 “Long notes and short notes” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 附點會增加原音符一半的時值。附點二分音符持續三拍；附點四分音符持續一拍半。

items.source: How many beats does a dotted half note last?
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · lesson uke-4-4 “Long notes and short notes” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 附點二分音符持續幾拍？

items.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-5 “Aura Lee” · title
Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-5 “Aura Lee” · step 1 (explain) · title
items.translation: 一首來自 1861 年的慢板情歌

items.source: "Aura Lee" was published in 1861, with music by George R. Poulton. Play it slowly and let each note ring into the next.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-5 “Aura Lee” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 《奧拉莉》於 1861 年出版，由 George R. Poulton 作曲。慢慢彈，讓每個音自然延續到下一個音。

items.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-5 “Aura Lee” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: Fret 2 on string 2 is F sharp, one fret above F. A sharp raises a note by one fret.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-5 “Aura Lee” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

items.translation: 第二指按第 4 弦第 2 品，第三指按第 3 弦第 2 品，第一指按第 2 弦第 1 品。第 1 弦彈空弦。

items.translation: D 小和弦的指型最接近哪個和弦？

items.source: D minor is F with one more finger, on fret 2 of string 3.

items.translation: D 小和弦就是 F 再多加一根手指，按在第 3 弦第 2 品。

items.translation: 第一指按第 1 弦第 2 品，第二指按第 2 弦第 3 品，第三指按第 3 弦第 4 品。第 4 弦彈空弦。

Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-2 “E minor” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer

items.source: E minor and G both leave which string open?

items.translation: E 小和弦和 G 都讓哪條弦彈空弦？

Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-3 “D and A” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Put fingers 1, 2 and 3 side by side on fret 2 of strings 4, 3 and 2. String 1 rings open.

items.translation: 第 1、2、3 指並排按在第 4、3、2 弦的第 2 品。第 1 弦彈空弦。

items.source: Second finger on fret 2 of string 4, first finger on fret 1 of string 3. Strings 2 and 1 ring open.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-3 “D and A” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 第二指按第 4 弦第 2 品，第一指按第 3 弦第 1 品。第 2、1 弦彈空弦。

items.source: Which chord has three fingers on the same fret?
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-3 “D and A” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 哪個和弦的三根手指都按在同一品？

items.source: First finger on fret 1 of string 4, second on fret 2 of string 3, third on fret 2 of string 1. String 2 rings open.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-4 “E7 leads to A minor” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 第一指按第 4 弦第 1 品，第二指按第 3 弦第 2 品，第三指按第 1 弦第 2 品。第 2 弦彈空弦。

items.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-4 “E7 leads to A minor” · step 3 (explain) · title
items.translation: 另一個帶有吸引力的和弦

items.source: G7 pulls toward C. In the same way, E7 pulls toward A minor. Play them back to back and listen for the release.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-4 “E7 leads to A minor” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: G7 引向 C。同樣地，E7 引向 A 小和弦。接著彈這兩個和弦，聽聽緊張感如何釋放。

items.source: Number the notes of the C scale and you can name chords by number: C is I, G is V, A minor is vi, F is IV. This order runs through countless songs.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-5 “Four chords, endless songs” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 為 C 大調音階的音編號，就能用級數稱呼和弦：C 是 I，G 是 V，A 小和弦是 vi，F 是 IV。無數歌曲都使用這個順序。

items.source: In the key of C, which chord is IV?
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-5 “Four chords, endless songs” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 在 C 調中，哪個和弦是 IV？

items.source: Count up the scale from C: C, D, E, F. F is the fourth note, so F is the IV chord.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-5 “Four chords, endless songs” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 從 C 往上數音階：C、D、E、F。F 是第四個音，所以 F 是 IV 級和弦。

items.source: Which chord is vi in C?
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-5 “Four chords, endless songs” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: C 調的 vi 是哪個和弦？

items.source: Lowercase numbers mean minor chords. The sixth note of C major is A.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-5 “Four chords, endless songs” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 小寫羅馬數字表示小和弦。C 大調的第六個音是 A。

Ukulele · Unit 5 · challenge uke-5-6 “Challenge: ten chords” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: C, A minor, F, G, G7, D minor, E minor, D, A and E7. Clean shapes first, then steady strums.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · challenge uke-5-6 “Challenge: ten chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: C、A 小和弦、F、G、G7、D 小和弦、E 小和弦、D、A 和 E7。先把指型按清楚，再穩定刷弦。

items.source: In the key of C, which chord is V?
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · challenge uke-5-6 “Challenge: ten chords” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 在 C 調中，哪個和弦是 V？

items.source: Stephen Foster wrote this song in 1848. It counts in two: 1 and 2 and. Most notes are quick eighth notes.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-1 “Oh! Susanna” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Stephen Foster 在 1848 年寫下這首歌。它以兩拍來數：1 又 2 又。大多數音是較快的八分音符。

items.source: The opening: C D E G, G A G E.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-1 “Oh! Susanna” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 開頭：C D E G，G A G E。

Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-2 “Camptown Races” · title

items.source: Another Foster song, from 1850. The melody bounces between G and E, and a short two-note call answers each line.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-2 “Camptown Races” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 另一首 Foster 的歌曲，寫於 1850 年。旋律在 G 和 E 之間跳動，每句後面都有兩個音的短呼喊回應。

items.source: G G E G A G E.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-2 “Camptown Races” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: G G E G A G E.

items.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-2 “Camptown Races” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: Like most songs in C, it comes home to C.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-2 “Camptown Races” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 和大多數 C 調歌曲一樣，它回到 C 這個歸宿。

items.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-2 “Camptown Races” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)

items.source: Count 1 2 3, 1 2 3, with the weight on 1. This is waltz time. "Clementine", first printed in 1884, sways in three.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-3 “Clementine” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 數 1 2 3、1 2 3，把重心放在 1。這是圓舞曲拍子。《克萊門汀》於 1884 年首次出版，以三拍搖曳。

items.source: String 2 fret 1, open 3, open 1, then string 1 frets 3 and 1.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-3 “Clementine” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第 2 弦第 1 品、第 3 弦空弦、第 1 弦空弦，再彈第 1 弦第 3、1 品。

items.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-3 “Clementine” · step 6 (explain) · title

items.source: First finger on fret 1 of string 1. With F, it carries the whole song.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-3 “Clementine” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 第一指按第 1 弦第 1 品。搭配 F，就能伴奏整首歌。

Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-4 “Red River Valley” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: This traditional tune was in print by 1896. Each line ends on a long note, so count it out before the next one.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-4 “Red River Valley” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 這首傳統旋律至遲在 1896 年已有出版版本。每句以長音結束，下一句開始前，要把拍子數完。

items.source: Open 3, string 2 fret 1, open 1, string 2 fret 3, string 1 frets 1 and 3.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-4 “Red River Valley” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第 3 弦空弦、第 2 弦第 1 品、第 1 弦空弦、第 2 弦第 3 品、第 1 弦第 1、3 品。

items.source: The last line starts D, C sharp, C. How do those notes move?
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-4 “Red River Valley” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 最後一句從 D、升 C、C 開始。這些音如何移動？

items.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-4 “Red River Valley” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Down one fret at a time
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-4 “Red River Valley” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-4 “Red River Valley” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Each note is one fret lower on string 3: fret 2, fret 1, open.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · song uke-6-4 “Red River Valley” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 在第 3 弦上，每個音都比前一個低一品：第 2 品、第 1 品、空弦。

Ukulele · Unit 6 · lesson uke-6-5 “Back a song with chords” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: When you strum a song, the melody lives in your head or in a friend's voice. Change chords where the tune leans, and keep the strum steady.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · lesson uke-6-5 “Back a song with chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 刷弦伴奏時，旋律在你的腦海中，或由朋友唱出來。依旋律的和聲走向換和弦，並保持穩定刷弦。

items.source: A song in F usually ends on which chord?
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · lesson uke-6-5 “Back a song with chords” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: F 調歌曲通常以哪個和弦結束？

items.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · lesson uke-6-5 “Back a song with chords” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Songs come home to their key chord. In F, that's F.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · lesson uke-6-5 “Back a song with chords” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 歌曲會回到所屬調性的主和弦。在 F 調中，就是 F。

items.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · challenge uke-6-6 “Challenge: your first set” · title
items.translation: 挑戰：你的第一套演出曲目

items.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · challenge uke-6-6 “Challenge: your first set” · step 1 (explain) · title
items.translation: 你的第一份演出曲目表

items.source: Four songs, a handful of chords and three strums. Play them like a small concert: count in, keep going, finish strong.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 6 · challenge uke-6-6 “Challenge: your first set” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 四首歌、幾個和弦、三種刷法。把它們當作一場小型音樂會：數拍開始、持續彈奏、有力收尾。

items.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 “New keys” · title

items.source: B flat, D7, B minor and G minor, the keys of G, F and D, and moving a song to any key.
items.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 “New keys” · unit summary
items.translation: 降 B、D7、B 小和弦與 G 小和弦，G、F、D 調，以及把歌曲移到任何調。
