Bass · Unit 6 “Grooves” · title

items.source: Eighth-note rock, dotted rhythms, space, and a Motown-style line.
items.context: Bass · Unit 6 “Grooves” · unit summary
items.translation: 八分音符搖滾、附點節奏、留白，以及摩城風格低音線。

items.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-1 “Eighth-note rock groove” · title
Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-1 “Eighth-note rock groove” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Count 1 and 2 and 3 and 4 and. Play a note on every count with your fingers taking turns. Even volume is the goal.
items.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-1 “Eighth-note rock groove” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 數 1 又 2 又 3 又 4 又。每一下都彈一個音，手指交替。目標是音量均勻。

items.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-1 “Eighth-note rock groove” · step 3 (along) · title
items.translation: 在 E 和 A 上彈八分音符

items.source: Your eighth notes start to rush. What helps?
items.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-1 “Eighth-note rock groove” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 八分音符開始越彈越快，什麼有幫助？

items.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-1 “Eighth-note rock groove” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Lock to the click and relax your hand
items.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-1 “Eighth-note rock groove” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-1 “Eighth-note rock groove” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-1 “Eighth-note rock groove” · step 5 (along) · title
Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-2 “Dotted rhythms” · title

items.source: A dotted quarter lasts one and a half beats. Play on 1, hold through 2, then play on the and of 2, then on 3 and 4.
items.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-2 “Dotted rhythms” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 附點四分音符持續一拍半。第 1 拍彈，延續越過第 2 拍，再於第 2 拍的「又」彈，接著彈第 3、4 拍。

items.source: Long-short on A, D and E
items.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-2 “Dotted rhythms” · step 3 (along) · title
items.translation: 在 A、D、E 上彈長短節奏

items.source: How long does a dotted quarter note last?
items.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-2 “Dotted rhythms” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 附點四分音符持續多久？

items.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-2 “Dotted rhythms” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-2 “Dotted rhythms” · step 6 (along) · title
Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-3 “Leave some space” · title

items.source: Silence is part of the groove
items.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-3 “Leave some space” · step 1 (explain) · title
items.translation: 安靜也是律動的一部分

items.source: Short notes with clean rests make a line bounce. Ease off the fretting finger, still touching the string, to stop each note right on time.
items.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-3 “Leave some space” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 短音搭配乾淨的休止，能讓低音線有彈跳感。按弦手指放鬆壓力，但仍碰著弦，讓每個音準時停止。

items.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-3 “Leave some space” · step 3 (along) · title

items.source: How do you stop a fretted note cleanly?
items.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-3 “Leave some space” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 如何乾淨地停止按品的音？

items.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-3 “Leave some space” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-3 “Leave some space” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Ease off but keep touching it
items.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-3 “Leave some space” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: 放鬆壓力，但繼續碰著弦

items.source: Release the pressure while your finger stays on the string. The note stops without a buzz.
items.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-3 “Leave some space” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 釋放壓力，手指仍留在弦上。聲音就會停止，不產生雜音。

items.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · title

items.source: Busy, but always in the pocket
items.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · step 1 (explain) · title
items.translation: 音多，卻始終穩穩嵌入律動

items.source: Motown-era bass lines moved a lot: chord tones, notes that lean into the next chord, and pushes off the beat. This line is new, written in that spirit.
items.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 摩城時代的低音線變化豐富：和弦音、引向下一個和弦的音，以及拍點之外的推進。這條低音線是依循那種精神新寫的。

items.source: The first bar: C, E, G, then B flat leaning into A.
items.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第一小節：C、E、G，再用降 B 引向 A。

items.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · step 6 (along) · title

items.source: What does B flat do at the end of bar 1?
items.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 第 1 小節結尾的降 B 有什麼作用？

items.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Leads down a fret into A
items.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer
Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: It's an approach note, one fret above A, the root of the next chord. It slides you into the next bar.
items.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 它是趨近音，比下一個和弦的根音 A 高一品，帶你滑入下一小節。

items.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · step 8 (along) · title
Bass · Unit 6 · challenge bass-6-5 “Challenge: groove set” · title
Bass · Unit 6 · challenge bass-6-5 “Challenge: groove set” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Eighth notes, dotted rhythms and a moving line. Stay with the click, keep your fingers taking turns and enjoy the groove.
items.context: Bass · Unit 6 · challenge bass-6-5 “Challenge: groove set” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 八分音符、附點節奏和流動的低音線。跟著節拍聲，手指持續交替，享受律動。

items.source: In an eighth-note groove, which counts get a note?
items.context: Bass · Unit 6 · challenge bass-6-5 “Challenge: groove set” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 八分音符律動中，哪些數拍要彈音？

items.context: Bass · Unit 6 · challenge bass-6-5 “Challenge: groove set” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Bass · Unit 6 · challenge bass-6-5 “Challenge: groove set” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Bass · Unit 6 · challenge bass-6-5 “Challenge: groove set” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin course · title

items.source: Bow, finger and play in tune, from open strings to fiddle tunes
items.context: Violin course · course subtitle
items.translation: 從空弦到民間舞曲，學習運弓、按指與準確音高

items.context: Violin · Unit 1 “Hello, violin” · title

items.source: Hold it, bow it, tune it, play the open strings and your first song.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 “Hello, violin” · unit summary
items.translation: 拿好琴、運弓、調音，拉空弦並演奏第一首歌。

items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · title
Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: With the violin under your chin, the strings run G, D, A, E from left to right. G is the thickest and lowest. E is the thinnest and highest, and we call it string 1.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 小提琴放在下巴下方時，從左到右是 G、D、A、E 弦。G 最粗、最低。E 最細、最高，我們稱它為第 1 弦。

items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: The bridge is the thin wooden arch that holds the strings up. String pressure alone keeps it standing. If it starts to lean, ask a teacher or shop to set it straight.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 琴橋是撐起琴弦的薄木拱，僅靠琴弦壓力站立。如果開始傾斜，請老師或琴行協助調正。

items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: E is the thinnest string and the highest. Strings count from E (1) to G (4).
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: E 弦最細，音也最高。弦從 E（1）數到 G（4）。

items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: Before you use the bow, pluck. Rest your right thumb against the side of the fingerboard and pull the string with your first finger. Players call this pizzicato.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 用弓之前，先撥弦。右手拇指靠在指板側邊，用食指拉動琴弦。這叫作撥奏。

items.source: Rest the violin on your lap like a small guitar. Pluck string 2, the A, and let it ring.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 把小提琴像小吉他一樣放在腿上。撥第 2 弦 A，讓它鳴響。

items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise

items.source: Now the thickest string, the G.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 7 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 現在撥最粗的 G 弦。

items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · title
Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Set the violin's lower edge on your left collarbone and turn your head to rest your jaw on the chin rest. The weight of your head holds it. No clamping.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 把琴身下緣放在左鎖骨上，轉頭讓下顎靠在腮托上。靠頭部重量穩住琴，不要用力夾。

items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: Point the scroll forward and to your left, about level with the floor. Your left hand cradles the neck, thumb across from your first finger. Keep the wrist straight and soft.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 琴頭朝前偏左，大致與地板平行。左手托住琴頸，拇指與食指相對。手腕保持直而放鬆。

items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: Your collarbone and the weight of your head
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Let your head rest on the chin rest. A squeezing hand or a raised shoulder makes you tense, and tension pulls notes out of tune.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 讓頭自然靠在腮托上。手用力擠握或聳肩都會造成緊繃，緊繃容易讓音準偏離。

items.source: Hold the violin in place and pluck the D string, string 3.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 保持持琴姿勢，撥 D 弦，也就是第 3 弦。

items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 6 (along) · title
Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · title
Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: The wooden stick runs from the frog, where you hold it, to the tip. Horsehair stretches between them. Tighten the screw until a pencil just fits between hair and stick.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 木製弓桿從手握的弓根延伸到弓尖，兩端之間繃著馬尾弓毛。旋緊螺絲，直到弓毛和弓桿間剛好能容下一支鉛筆。

items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: Bend your thumb and set its tip where the frog meets the stick. Drape your fingers over the stick, with your little finger standing curved on top. Keep the whole hand soft.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 彎曲拇指，把指尖放在弓根與弓桿相接處。其他手指自然垂覆弓桿，小指彎曲站在上方。整隻手保持放鬆。

items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: Bent, where the frog meets the stick
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: 彎曲，放在弓根與弓桿相接處

items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Flat on top of the stick
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A bent thumb at the frog lets the hand stay soft and balance the bow.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 拇指在弓根處保持彎曲，能讓手放鬆並平衡琴弓。

items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: Bare hair slides over the string without a sound. Rub the cake of rosin along the hair a few times before you play. A light coat is enough.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 未擦松香的弓毛滑過琴弦，難以發聲。演奏前，用松香塊沿弓毛擦幾次，薄薄一層就夠。

items.source: Set the bow on the A string, halfway between bridge and fingerboard. Pull it slowly to the right.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 把弓放在 A 弦上，位於琴橋與指板之間的中點，慢慢向右拉。

items.source: Now the D string. Lift your elbow a little, then pull slowly.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 現在拉 D 弦。手肘稍微抬高，再慢慢拉。

items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 7 (along) · title

items.source: From low to high: G, D, A, E. Each string is five letter names above the last, an interval called a fifth. Try: Good Dogs Always Eat.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-4 “The open strings” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 從低到高：G、D、A、E。每條弦比前一條高五個音名字母的位置，這個音程叫五度。可以用英文口訣「Good Dogs Always Eat」的字首來記。

items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-4 “The open strings” · step 2 (explain) · title
items.translation: 每條弦都有自己的高度

items.source: Your right elbow sets which string the bow plays. Raise it for G, lower it for E. Each string has its own level, like the steps of a stair.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-4 “The open strings” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 右手肘決定弓拉哪條弦。拉 G 時抬高，拉 E 時降低。每條弦都有自己的高度，像樓梯的階梯。

items.source: Bow the G string, then D. Your elbow is highest for G.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-4 “The open strings” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 先拉 G 弦，再拉 D 弦。拉 G 時，手肘最高。

items.source: Now A, then E. Lower your elbow one step for each.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-4 “The open strings” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 現在拉 A，再拉 E。每換一條，手肘就降低一階。

items.source: Which string needs the highest elbow?
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-4 “The open strings” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 拉哪條弦時，手肘需要最高？

items.source: The G string sits farthest to the left, so your arm lifts to reach it. E needs the lowest arm.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-4 “The open strings” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: G 弦在最左側，因此手臂要抬高才能拉到。E 弦需要的手臂高度最低。

items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · title
Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Orchestras tune to A. Timbre shows how far each string is from its note in cents; 100 cents make a half step, the smallest step on a piano. Tune A, then D, G and E.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 管弦樂團以 A 調音。Timbre 用音分顯示每條弦與目標音的差距；100 音分是一個半音，也就是鋼琴最小的音距。先調 A，再調 D、G 和 E。

items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: The small screws on the tailpiece are fine tuners. Turn one clockwise to raise the pitch, counterclockwise to lower it. Quarter turns are plenty.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 拉弦板上的小螺絲是微調器。順時針轉會升高音高，逆時針轉會降低。每次四分之一圈就很夠了。

items.source: A string is a little flat. What do you do?
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 一條弦稍微偏低，你該怎麼做？

items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: 順時針轉動它的微調器

items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: 逆時針轉動它的微調器

items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Flat means too low. Clockwise tightens the string and raises the pitch.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 偏低就是音高太低。順時針轉會拉緊弦，讓音高升高。

items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: If a fine tuner runs out of room, use the peg. Turn it a little while pushing it inward so it holds. If a string is far off, ask a teacher; pegs can slip.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 微調器沒有調整空間時，就用弦軸。小幅轉動，同時向內推，讓它固定。如果音差很多，請老師協助；弦軸可能打滑。

items.source: Tune your A string, then bow it and hold it steady.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 調好 A 弦，再用弓拉它，保持穩定。

items.source: Now D, G and E. Tune each one, then bow it and hold it.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 現在是 D、G 和 E。每條調好後，用弓拉並保持穩定。

items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · challenge vln-1-6 “Open-string checkup” · title
Violin · Unit 1 · challenge vln-1-6 “Open-string checkup” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Violin on your collarbone, soft bow hold, bow halfway between bridge and fingerboard. Now play everything from this unit.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · challenge vln-1-6 “Open-string checkup” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 小提琴放在鎖骨上，持弓放鬆，弓位於琴橋和指板之間的中點。現在演奏這個單元學過的內容。

items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · challenge vln-1-6 “Open-string checkup” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: Bow each open string from high to low. Hold each one steady.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · challenge vln-1-6 “Open-string checkup” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 從高到低拉各條空弦，每個音保持穩定。

items.source: Which string do you tune first?
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · challenge vln-1-6 “Open-string checkup” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: Orchestras tune to A, so start there and tune the others after it.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · challenge vln-1-6 “Open-string checkup” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 管弦樂團以 A 調音，所以從它開始，再調其他弦。

items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · challenge vln-1-6 “Open-string checkup” · step 6 (along) · title

items.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb lives on the A string: open A, first finger a whole step up for B, second finger another whole step up for C sharp. Pluck it first, then bow it.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · song vln-1-7 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 《瑪莉有隻小綿羊》在 A 弦上：A 空弦，第一指向上一個全音是 B，第二指再向上一個全音是升 C。先撥奏，再用弓拉。

items.source: First finger on the A string, a whole step up. That's B.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · song vln-1-7 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第一指按在 A 弦上，比空弦高一個全音。這就是 B。

items.source: Second finger a whole step above your first. That's C sharp.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · song vln-1-7 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第二指比第一指高一個全音。這就是升 C。

items.source: C sharp, B, A, B, then C sharp three times.
items.context: Violin · Unit 1 · song vln-1-7 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 升 C、B、A、B，再拉三次升 C。

items.context: Violin · Unit 2 “Bowing” · title

items.source: Long, even bows, clean string crossings and your first rhythms.
items.context: Violin · Unit 2 “Bowing” · unit summary
items.translation: 長而均勻的運弓、乾淨換弦，以及最初的節奏。

items.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · title
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A down-bow pulls the bow to the right, from frog to tip. An up-bow pushes it back to the left. In music, a down-bow mark looks like a little table and an up-bow like a V.
items.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 下弓把弓向右拉，從弓根走向弓尖。上弓則向左推回。樂譜中的下弓記號像小桌子，上弓記號像 V。

items.source: Which way does a down-bow move?
items.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Play halfway between the bridge and the end of the fingerboard. Keep the bow parallel to the bridge, like a train on its track.
items.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 在琴橋與指板末端之間的中點演奏。弓保持與琴橋平行，像火車沿軌道前進。

items.source: One slow down-bow, then one slow up-bow on A. Keep the sound even to the end.
items.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 在 A 弦慢慢拉一次下弓，再拉一次上弓。直到結尾都保持聲音均勻。

items.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 5 (along) · title
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 6 (along) · title
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · title
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A quarter note lasts one beat. Quick notes need less bow, so use the middle half of the bow and keep every stroke the same length.
items.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 四分音符持續一拍。快音需要較少弓長，所以用琴弓中間的一半，每次運弓長度相同。

items.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 3 (along) · title
items.translation: A 與 D 弦的四分音符

items.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: A half note lasts two beats. Use a longer, slower bow so the sound doesn't fade on the second beat.
items.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 二分音符持續兩拍。用更長、更慢的弓，讓聲音在第二拍也不減弱。

items.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 哪個音符需要更多弓長？

items.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A half note lasts twice as long, so it gets a longer, slower stroke.
items.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 二分音符的時值是兩倍，因此運弓要更長、更慢。

items.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 7 (along) · title
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · title
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: To cross strings, change levels with your elbow, not your wrist. Arrive at the new level just before the bow changes direction.
items.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 換弦時，用手肘改變高度，不是手腕。弓改變方向前一刻，就先到達新的高度。

items.source: A, E, A, E. Let your elbow rock between the two levels.
items.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: A、E、A、E。讓手肘在兩個高度之間擺動。

items.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 3 (along) · title

items.source: What moves the bow to a new string?
items.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 什麼把弓帶到另一條弦？

items.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: Going from G to A skips the D string, so your elbow makes a bigger move. Travel smoothly and don't let the middle string sound.
items.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 從 G 到 A 會跨過 D 弦，所以手肘要移動更大的幅度。平順移動，不要讓中間的弦發聲。

items.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 6 (along) · title
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-4 “Eighth notes” · title
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-4 “Eighth notes” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: An eighth note lasts half a beat, so two fit in each beat. Use small, quick bows near the middle of the bow.
items.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-4 “Eighth notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 八分音符持續半拍，所以每拍能容納兩個。在琴弓中段附近，用短而快的弓。

items.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-4 “Eighth notes” · step 3 (along) · title

items.source: How many eighth notes fit in one beat?
items.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-4 “Eighth notes” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 一拍能容納幾個八分音符？

items.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-4 “Eighth notes” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: Now mix them: a quarter, two eighths, then two quarters. Fiddlers lean on this rhythm. Say it first: long, short-short, long, long.
items.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-4 “Eighth notes” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 現在混合：一個四分音符、兩個八分音符，再接兩個四分音符。民間小提琴樂手常用這個節奏。先念出來：長、短短、長、長。

items.context: Violin · Unit 2 · challenge vln-2-5 “Bowing checkup” · title
Violin · Unit 2 · challenge vln-2-5 “Bowing checkup” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Straight bows at the contact point, crossings led by the elbow, and steady rhythms. Here's a mix of all three.
items.context: Violin · Unit 2 · challenge vln-2-5 “Bowing checkup” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 在觸弦點直線運弓、由手肘帶動換弦，以及穩定節奏。這裡把三者結合。

items.context: Violin · Unit 2 · challenge vln-2-5 “Bowing checkup” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Violin · Unit 2 · challenge vln-2-5 “Bowing checkup” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: 琴橋與指板之間的中點

items.source: Right on top of the bridge
items.context: Violin · Unit 2 · challenge vln-2-5 “Bowing checkup” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Over the end of the fingerboard
items.context: Violin · Unit 2 · challenge vln-2-5 “Bowing checkup” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 2 · challenge vln-2-5 “Bowing checkup” · step 4 (along) · title
Violin · Unit 2 · challenge vln-2-5 “Bowing checkup” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 2 · challenge vln-2-5 “Bowing checkup” · step 6 (along) · title
Violin · Unit 3 “First fingers: A and E” · title
items.translation: 初學按指：A 與 E 弦

items.source: Place fingers 1, 2 and 3, play the A major scale and your first song.
items.context: Violin · Unit 3 “First fingers: A and E” · unit summary
items.translation: 放好第 1、2、3 指，拉 A 大調音階與第一首歌。

items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · title
Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Your instrument has no frets, so your ear places every note. Many players stick thin tapes on the fingerboard as a guide while they learn.
items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 你的樂器沒有品格，因此每個音都要靠耳朵定位。許多樂手初學時會在指板貼細膠帶，作為指引。

items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: Put your first fingertip on the A string at the first tape. That's B, a whole step above A; a whole step is two half steps. Press until the string meets the fingerboard.
items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 把第一指指尖放在 A 弦第一條膠帶處。這是 B，比 A 高一個全音；一個全音等於兩個半音。按到弦碰到指板為止。

items.source: Open A, then B with your first finger. Hold B until it settles in tune.
items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: A 空弦，再用第一指按 B。延續 B，直到音準穩定。

items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: Timbre accepts a note within 30 cents, about a third of a half step. If you're sharp, nudge the finger toward the scroll. If you're flat, nudge it toward the bridge.
items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Timbre 接受 30 音分內的音準誤差，大約是三分之一個半音。偏高時，手指稍往琴頭移；偏低時，稍往琴橋移。

items.source: B, open A, B. Lift the finger and set it down in the same spot.
items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: B、A 空弦、B。抬指，再落回同一位置。

items.source: Open A, then B. How far apart?
items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 6 (listen) · question or instruction
items.translation: A 空弦，再拉 B。相隔多遠？

items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 6 (listen) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 6 (listen) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 7 (along) · title
Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-2 “Second finger: C sharp” · title
Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-2 “Second finger: C sharp” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Second finger plays C sharp, a whole step above B, so leave a gap after first finger. This spot is called high 2, because it sits close to where third finger will go.
items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-2 “Second finger: C sharp” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 第二指拉升 C，比 B 高一個全音，所以與第一指之間留空隙。這個位置叫高 2 指，因為它靠近第三指將放的位置。

items.source: A, B, C sharp. Keep first finger down while second plays.
items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-2 “Second finger: C sharp” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: A、B、升 C。第二指按弦時，第一指仍留在弦上。

items.source: From B to the next note: what kind of step?
items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-2 “Second finger: C sharp” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction
items.translation: 從 B 到下一個音：是哪種音距？

items.source: How far is C sharp above B?
items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-2 “Second finger: C sharp” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 升 C 比 B 高多少？

items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-2 “Second finger: C sharp” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: B to C sharp is two half steps, so second finger leaves a gap after first.
items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-2 “Second finger: C sharp” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: B 到升 C 是兩個半音，所以第二指與第一指之間要留空隙。

items.source: B, C sharp, B, A. Land each note in tune before you move on.
items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-2 “Second finger: C sharp” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: B、升 C、B、A。每個音都先拉準，再前進。

items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · title
Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Third finger plays D, a half step above C sharp, so it sits right against second finger. On the A string the pattern is 1, then 2 and 3 together.
items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 第三指拉 D，比升 C 高半音，因此緊靠第二指。A 弦上的指型是 1 指，再接靠在一起的 2、3 指。

items.source: A, B, C sharp, D. Leave each finger down as you add the next.
items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: A、B、升 C、D。每加一根手指，之前的手指都留在弦上。

items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: When your D is in tune, the open D string vibrates along with it. The two share a letter name, eight notes apart: an octave. Listen for the violin sounding fuller.
items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: D 拉準時，D 空弦會跟著共振。兩者音名相同，相隔八個音，也就是一個八度。聽聽琴聲是否更飽滿。

items.source: Third-finger D, open D, then third-finger D again. Listen for the ring.
items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第三指的 D、D 空弦，再回到第三指的 D。聽共鳴。

items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 5 (listen) · question or instruction
Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 5 (listen) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 5 (listen) · quiz answer

items.source: Which fingers touch on the A string?
items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: A 弦上哪些手指靠在一起？

items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: B to C sharp is a whole step, so 1 and 2 have a gap. C sharp to D is a half step, so 2 and 3 touch.
items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: B 到升 C 是全音，所以 1、2 指間有空隙。升 C 到 D 是半音，所以 2、3 指靠在一起。

items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 7 (along) · title
Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-4 “The E string” · title

items.source: On the E string, first finger plays F sharp, high second G sharp, and third A. It's the A-string shape, one string higher. Lower your bow arm to the E level.
items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-4 “The E string” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: E 弦上，第一指拉升 F，高位第二指拉升 G，第三指拉 A。這就是 A 弦的指型，移到高一條弦。把運弓手臂降低到 E 弦高度。

items.source: E, F sharp, G sharp, A. Same shape as on the A string.
items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-4 “The E string” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: E、升 F、升 G、A。與 A 弦的指型相同。

items.source: Your third finger on E plays A. What can you check it against?
items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-4 “The E string” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: E 弦第三指拉 A。可以用什麼核對音準？

items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-4 “The E string” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-4 “The E string” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-4 “The E string” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: The open A string is an octave below, so it rings along when your A is in tune.
items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-4 “The E string” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: A 空弦低一個八度，所以你拉的 A 準確時，它會跟著共鳴。

items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-4 “The E string” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: Join the halves: A, B, C sharp, D on the A string, then E, F sharp, G sharp, A on the E string. Eight notes, A to A, one shape played twice.
items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-4 “The E string” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 把兩半接起來：A 弦的 A、B、升 C、D，再接 E 弦的 E、升 F、升 G、A。八個音，從 A 到 A，同一指型用兩次。

items.source: Up the A major scale, slowly. Cross to E for the top four notes.
items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-4 “The E string” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 慢慢上行拉 A 大調音階。最高四個音換到 E 弦。

items.source: This French melody from the 1700s uses only notes you've learned: A, B, C sharp, D on the A string, and E and F sharp on the E string.
items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · song vln-3-5 “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 這首來自 1700 年起的那個世紀的法國旋律，只用你學過的音：A 弦的 A、B、升 C、D，以及 E 弦的 E 和升 F。

items.source: Whole step, whole step, half step: that's the pattern on A and E. Land each note in tune and let the open strings ring with you.
items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · challenge vln-3-6 “A and E checkup” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 全音、全音、半音：這就是 A 與 E 弦的指型。每個音都要拉準，讓空弦與你一起共鳴。

items.source: Second finger to third: what kind of step?
items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · challenge vln-3-6 “A and E checkup” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction
items.translation: 第二指到第三指是哪種音距？

items.source: B, C sharp, D, then open D. Listen for the ring.
items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · challenge vln-3-6 “A and E checkup” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: B、升 C、D，再拉 D 空弦。聽共鳴。

items.source: Which note does high 2 play on the E string?
items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · challenge vln-3-6 “A and E checkup” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: E 弦的高 2 指拉什麼音？

items.source: F sharp, G sharp, A on the E string, then open A an octave lower.
items.context: Violin · Unit 3 · challenge vln-3-6 “A and E checkup” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: E 弦的升 F、升 G、A，再拉低八度的 A 空弦。

Violin · Unit 3 · challenge vln-3-6 “A and E checkup” · step 7 (along) · title
Violin · Unit 4 “D and G strings” · title

items.source: The same finger pattern on two lower strings, D major and three tunes.
items.context: Violin · Unit 4 “D and G strings” · unit summary
items.translation: 在兩條低音弦上使用同一指型，學習 D 大調與三首旋律。

items.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-1 “The D string” · title
Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-1 “The D string” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: On the D string, first finger plays E, high second F sharp, and third G. It's the A-string pattern, one string lower. Raise your bow arm a step.
items.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-1 “The D string” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: D 弦上，第一指拉 E，高位第二指拉升 F，第三指拉 G。這就是 A 弦的指型，移到低一條弦。把運弓手臂抬高一階。

items.source: D, E, F sharp, G. Second and third fingers touch.
items.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-1 “The D string” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: D、E、升 F、G。第二指與第三指靠在一起。

items.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-1 “The D string” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Third-finger G on the D string is an octave above the open G string. When it's in tune, the G string hums along.
items.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-1 “The D string” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: D 弦第三指的 G 比 G 空弦高八度。音準確時，G 弦會跟著共鳴。

items.source: Third-finger G, open G, third-finger G. Listen for the ring.
items.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-1 “The D string” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第三指的 G、G 空弦、第三指的 G。聽共鳴。

items.source: On the D string, which fingers touch?
items.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-1 “The D string” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: D 弦上哪些手指靠在一起？

items.source: It's the A-string pattern again: whole step, whole step, half step. The half step is between 2 and 3.
items.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-1 “The D string” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 又是 A 弦的指型：全音、全音、半音。半音位於 2、3 指之間。

Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-2 “The D major scale” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Play D, E, F sharp, G on the D string, then A, B, C sharp, D on the A string. The D major scale is one finger shape played twice.
items.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-2 “The D major scale” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 先拉 D 弦的 D、E、升 F、G，再拉 A 弦的 A、B、升 C、D。D 大調音階就是同一手指指型用兩次。

items.source: Up the D major scale. Cross to the A string on the fifth note.
items.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-2 “The D major scale” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 上行拉 D 大調音階，第五個音換到 A 弦。

items.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-2 “The D major scale” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction
Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-2 “The D major scale” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer

items.source: Which notes are sharp in D major?
items.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-2 “The D major scale” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: D 大調中哪些音要升高？

Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-2 “The D major scale” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-2 “The D major scale” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: D major has two sharps, F sharp and C sharp. Both are high 2.
items.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-2 “The D major scale” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: D 大調有兩個升音：升 F 和升 C。兩者都是高 2 指。

items.source: Lightly Row is an old German children's song. It walks up and down the D major scale on the D and A strings.
items.context: Violin · Unit 4 · song vln-4-3 “Lightly Row” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 《輕輕划》是一首古老的德國兒歌，在 D 與 A 弦上沿著 D 大調音階上下移動。

items.context: Violin · Unit 4 · song vln-4-3 “Lightly Row” · step 2 (along) · title

items.source: Which finger plays the F sharps?
items.context: Violin · Unit 4 · song vln-4-3 “Lightly Row” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 升 F 用哪根手指？

items.source: First finger on the A string
items.context: Violin · Unit 4 · song vln-4-3 “Lightly Row” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: On the G string, first finger plays A, high second B, and third C. Same shape again. Raise your bow arm to its highest level.
items.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-4 “The G string” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: G 弦上，第一指拉 A，高位第二指拉 B，第三指拉 C。又是同樣的指型。把運弓手臂抬到最高的位置。

items.source: G, A, B, C. Swing your left elbow a little under the violin to reach.
items.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-4 “The G string” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: G、A、B、C。左手肘稍微往琴下方轉，幫助手指到位。

items.source: First-finger A on the G string, then the open A string. Same letter, an octave apart.
items.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-4 “The G string” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: G 弦第一指的 A，再拉 A 空弦。同音名，相差八度。

items.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-4 “The G string” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: G, A, B, C on the G string plus D, E, F sharp, G on the D string make G major. It's the first octave of a two-octave scale you'll finish in the next unit.
items.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-4 “The G string” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: G 弦的 G、A、B、C，加上 D 弦的 D、E、升 F、G，組成 G 大調。這是兩個八度音階的第一個八度，下一單元會完成另一半。

items.source: Up the G major scale. Same shape on both strings.
items.context: Violin · Unit 4 · lesson vln-4-4 “The G string” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 上行拉 G 大調音階。兩條弦使用同樣指型。

Violin · Unit 4 · song vln-4-5 “Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Beethoven wrote this tune for his Ninth Symphony in 1824. It moves mostly by step, so your fingers walk.
items.context: Violin · Unit 4 · song vln-4-5 “Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 貝多芬在 1824 年為第九號交響曲寫下這段旋律。它主要以級進移動，讓手指逐步行走。

items.source: Each line ends long, short, long: a dotted quarter, an eighth and a half note. A dot after a note adds half its length.
items.context: Violin · Unit 4 · song vln-4-5 “Ode to Joy” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 每句以長、短、長結束：附點四分音符、八分音符和二分音符。音符後的附點增加原音符一半的時值。

items.context: Violin · Unit 4 · song vln-4-6 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · title
Violin · Unit 4 · song vln-4-6 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 1 (explain) · title
items.translation: 你的第一首民間小提琴曲

items.source: This old American fiddle tune rides the rhythm you bowed on open strings: long, short-short, long, long. Fiddlers play it at jams everywhere.
items.context: Violin · Unit 4 · song vln-4-6 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 這首古老的美國小提琴曲，沿用你在空弦上拉過的節奏：長、短短、長、長。各地的民間小提琴樂手都會在合奏聚會中演奏它。

items.source: Which string does this tune never use?
items.context: Violin · Unit 4 · song vln-4-6 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 這首曲子完全不用哪條弦？

items.source: It lives on the D, A and E strings.
items.context: Violin · Unit 4 · song vln-4-6 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 它使用 D、A 和 E 弦。

items.source: Whole step, whole step, half step works on every string so far. Raise your bow arm for the low strings and let the octaves ring.
items.context: Violin · Unit 4 · challenge vln-4-7 “D and G checkup” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 目前每條弦都適用全音、全音、半音。拉低音弦時抬高手臂，讓八度音共鳴。

items.source: Two octave checks: G with open G, then A with open A.
items.context: Violin · Unit 4 · challenge vln-4-7 “D and G checkup” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 兩次八度核對：G 與 G 空弦，再用 A 與 A 空弦。

items.source: In D major, which finger plays C sharp?
items.context: Violin · Unit 4 · challenge vln-4-7 “D and G checkup” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: D 大調中，升 C 用哪根手指？
