Violin · Unit 5 “Low 2 and high 2” · title

items.source: Move second finger to change keys: G major in two octaves, A minor and fiddle tunes.
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 “Low 2 and high 2” · unit summary
items.translation: 移動第二指來換調：兩個八度的 G 大調、A 小調與民間小提琴曲。

items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-1 “Low 2” · title
Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-1 “Low 2” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Slide second finger back until it touches first. On the A string that's C natural, a half step below C sharp. Players call it low 2.
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-1 “Low 2” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 把第二指向後滑，直到靠住第一指。在 A 弦上，這是本位 C，比升 C 低半音。樂手稱它為低 2 指。

items.source: A, B, C, D. Second finger touches first; leave a gap before third.
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-1 “Low 2” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: A、B、C、D。第二指靠住第一指，與第三指之間留空隙。

items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-1 “Low 2” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction
items.translation: B，接著是高 2 指還是低 2 指？

items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-1 “Low 2” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-1 “Low 2” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-1 “Low 2” · step 4 (listen) · question or instruction

items.source: High 2, low 2, high 2, low 2. Move only your second finger.
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-1 “Low 2” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 高 2 指、低 2 指、高 2 指、低 2 指。只移動第二指。

items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-1 “Low 2” · step 6 (along) · title
items.translation: 先低 2 指，再高 2 指

items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-2 “G major, two octaves” · title
Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-2 “G major, two octaves” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: G major needs C natural on the A string and G natural on the E string, so second finger sits low there. On the G and D strings it stays high.
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-2 “G major, two octaves” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: G 大調需要 A 弦上的本位 C 與 E 弦上的本位 G，因此這兩條弦的第二指放低。在 G 與 D 弦上，第二指仍放高。

items.source: The A string in G major: second finger low, touching first.
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-2 “G major, two octaves” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: G 大調中的 A 弦：第二指放低，靠住第一指。

items.source: Now E, F sharp, G on the E string. Low 2 again.
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-2 “G major, two octaves” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 現在拉 E 弦的 E、升 F、G。又是低 2 指。

items.source: Where does second finger go on the E string in G major?
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-2 “G major, two octaves” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: G 大調中，E 弦第二指放哪裡？

items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-2 “G major, two octaves” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-2 “G major, two octaves” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-2 “G major, two octaves” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: G natural is a half step above F sharp, so second finger tucks right against first.
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-2 “G major, two octaves” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 本位 G 比升 F 高半音，所以第二指緊靠第一指。

items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-2 “G major, two octaves” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: Start on open G and climb to G on the E string: fifteen notes, two octaves. High 2 on the low strings, low 2 on the high ones.
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-2 “G major, two octaves” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 從 G 空弦開始，一直上行到 E 弦的 G：十五個音，兩個八度。低音弦用高 2 指，高音弦用低 2 指。

items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-3 “A minor” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A minor starts with first-finger A on the G string. Second finger is high on the G string for B, then low on the D string for F natural.
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-3 “A minor” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: A 小調從 G 弦第一指的 A 開始。G 弦第二指放高拉 B，接著 D 弦第二指放低拉本位 F。

items.source: A minor, up. High 2 on the G string, low 2 on the D string.
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-3 “A minor” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: A 小調，上行。G 弦用高 2 指，D 弦用低 2 指。

items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-3 “A minor” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 什麼讓這個音階成為小調？

items.source: Its third note is a half step lower
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-3 “A minor” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: It starts on a lower string
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-3 “A minor” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-3 “A minor” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A to C sounds dark; A to C sharp sounds bright. One half step changes the whole mood.
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-3 “A minor” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: A 到 C 聽起來暗沉，A 到升 C 聽起來明亮。只差半音，整個情緒就改變了。

items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · lesson vln-5-3 “A minor” · step 6 (along) · title
Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-4 “Minuet in G” · title
Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-4 “Minuet in G” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: This minuet comes from the notebook Bach gave his wife Anna Magdalena in 1725. It's now credited to Christian Petzold. Count three beats to a bar.
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-4 “Minuet in G” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 這首小步舞曲出自巴赫在 1725 年送給妻子 Anna Magdalena 的樂譜筆記本。如今歸功於 Christian Petzold。每小節數三拍。

items.source: Which C does the minuet use?
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-4 “Minuet in G” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 這首小步舞曲使用哪個 C？

items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-4 “Minuet in G” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-4 “Minuet in G” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: The minuet is in G major, so C is natural and second finger sits low on the A string.
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-4 “Minuet in G” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 小步舞曲是 G 大調，所以 C 是本位音，A 弦的第二指放低。

items.source: F sharp is high 2 on the D string: low on A, high on D.
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-4 “Minuet in G” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 升 F 是 D 弦的高 2 指：A 弦放低，D 弦放高。

items.source: The second half starts high: fourth finger reaches B on the E string. Then third, then low 2.
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-4 “Minuet in G” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 後半段從高音開始：第四指伸到 E 弦的 B，接著第三指，再接低 2 指。

items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-4 “Minuet in G” · arrangement · song section label (Intro, Verse 1 …) on a small chip
Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · title
Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 1 (explain) · title
items.translation: 高 2 指與低 2 指搭配

items.source: Old Joe Clark is an Appalachian fiddle tune. It's in A but uses G natural: high 2 for C sharp on the A string, low 2 for G on the E string.
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 《老喬克拉克》是一首阿帕拉契山區的小提琴曲。它以 A 為主音，但使用本位 G：A 弦以高 2 指拉升 C，E 弦以低 2 指拉 G。

items.source: E, F sharp, G, F sharp. Keep second finger low, touching first.
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: E、升 F、G、升 F。第二指保持低位，靠住第一指。

items.source: Which G does this tune use on the E string?
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 這首曲子在 E 弦上使用哪個 G？

items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: G natural instead of G sharp gives Old Joe Clark its old-time sound.
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 用本位 G 取代升 G，讓《老喬克拉克》帶有老式民間音樂的味道。

items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-6 “Soldier's Joy” · title
Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-6 “Soldier's Joy” · step 1 (explain) · title
items.translation: 來自 1700 年起的那個世紀的曲子

items.source: Soldier's Joy was printed in Scotland in the 1700s and is still played at dances across America. Its first part rocks on A, F sharp and D, the notes of a D major chord.
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-6 “Soldier's Joy” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 《士兵的喜悅》在 1700 年起的那個世紀於蘇格蘭出版，至今仍在美國各地舞會演奏。第一段圍繞 A、升 F 和 D 擺動，這些都是 D 大和弦的音。

items.source: Open A, high-2 F sharp on D, open D, F sharp. Rock your elbow between strings.
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-6 “Soldier's Joy” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: A 空弦、D 弦高 2 指的升 F、D 空弦、升 F。用手肘在琴弦之間擺動。

items.source: Which finger plays G on the E string?
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-6 “Soldier's Joy” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: E 弦的 G 用哪根手指？

items.source: Soldier's Joy is in D major, so G is natural: high 2 for F sharp on D, low 2 for G on E.
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-6 “Soldier's Joy” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 《士兵的喜悅》是 D 大調，所以 G 是本位音：D 弦用高 2 指拉升 F，E 弦用低 2 指拉 G。

items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · challenge vln-5-7 “Second finger checkup” · title
Violin · Unit 5 · challenge vln-5-7 “Second finger checkup” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Every key sets your second finger. Before you play, ask: high 2 or low 2, and on which string?
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · challenge vln-5-7 “Second finger checkup” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 每個調都決定第二指的位置。演奏前先問：高 2 指還是低 2 指？在哪條弦？

items.source: F sharp, then high 2 or low 2?
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · challenge vln-5-7 “Second finger checkup” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction
items.translation: 升 F，接著是高 2 指還是低 2 指？

items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · challenge vln-5-7 “Second finger checkup” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 5 · challenge vln-5-7 “Second finger checkup” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer

items.source: Low 2 and high 2 on the A string, then low 2 and high 2 on the E string.
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · challenge vln-5-7 “Second finger checkup” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: A 弦的低 2 指與高 2 指，再接 E 弦的低 2 指與高 2 指。

items.source: In A major, where does second finger sit on the A and E strings?
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · challenge vln-5-7 “Second finger checkup” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: A 大調中，A 與 E 弦的第二指放在哪裡？

items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · challenge vln-5-7 “Second finger checkup” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 5 · challenge vln-5-7 “Second finger checkup” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Low on A, high on E
items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · challenge vln-5-7 “Second finger checkup” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: A 弦放低，E 弦放高

items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · challenge vln-5-7 “Second finger checkup” · step 6 (along) · title
items.translation: 小步舞曲，第 1 至 4 小節

items.context: Violin · Unit 5 · challenge vln-5-7 “Second finger checkup” · step 7 (along) · title
Violin · Unit 6 “Expression” · title

items.source: Loud and soft, slurs, your fourth finger, a first step toward vibrato, and Ode to Joy complete.
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 “Expression” · unit summary
items.translation: 強與弱、連弓、第四指、揉弦的起步，以及完整的《歡樂頌》。

items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · title
Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Add arm weight, use more bow speed, and move the contact point closer to the bridge. Use all three together. For soft, do the opposite.
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 增加手臂重量、加快弓速，並把觸弦點移近琴橋。三者搭配使用。要弱奏，就反過來。

items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: Music marks loud with f, for forte, and soft with p, for piano. Growing louder is a crescendo; fading away is a diminuendo.
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 樂譜用 f 表示 forte，也就是強奏；用 p 表示 piano，也就是弱奏。逐漸變強是漸強，逐漸變弱是漸弱。

items.source: To play forte, where does the bow move?
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: 不用移動，只要用力擠握

items.source: Near the bridge the string takes more weight and speed, so it sounds louder without scratching.
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 靠近琴橋時，琴弦能承受更多重量與速度，因此聲音更響而不刮耳。

items.source: Each note twice: forte, then piano. Stay in tune while the volume changes.
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 每個音拉兩次：先強奏，再弱奏。音量改變時，音準仍要穩定。

items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · step 5 (along) · title
Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · step 6 (along) · title
Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-2 “Slurs” · title
Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-2 “Slurs” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A curved line over notes is a slur: play them all in one bow. Your left hand changes notes while the bow keeps moving.
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-2 “Slurs” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 音符上方的弧線是連奏線：裡面的音用同一弓演奏。左手換音，弓持續移動。

items.source: Slur A to B in one down-bow, then B to A in one up-bow.
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-2 “Slurs” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 用一次下弓連奏 A 到 B，再用一次上弓連奏 B 到 A。

items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-2 “Slurs” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Two notes in one bow means each gets half of it. Plan ahead and start a slur with enough bow left for both notes.
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-2 “Slurs” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 一弓兩個音，代表每個音各用一半弓長。事先規劃，開始連弓時，要留夠兩個音使用的弓。

items.source: What does a slur tell you?
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-2 “Slurs” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: Play the notes in one bow
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-2 “Slurs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-2 “Slurs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-2 “Slurs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-2 “Slurs” · step 5 (along) · title
Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-2 “Slurs” · step 6 (along) · title
Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-3 “Your fourth finger” · title
Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-3 “Your fourth finger” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Fourth finger reaches a whole step above third. On the D string that's A, the same note as the open A string. Keep the finger curved and let your hand lean toward it.
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-3 “Your fourth finger” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 第四指伸到比第三指高一個全音的位置。在 D 弦上就是 A，與 A 空弦同音。手指保持彎曲，讓手稍微靠向它。

items.source: Fourth-finger A on the D string, open A, then fourth finger again. Match them exactly.
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-3 “Your fourth finger” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: D 弦第四指的 A、A 空弦，再回第四指。讓兩者完全一致。

items.source: Why use fourth finger instead of an open string?
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-3 “Your fourth finger” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 為什麼用第四指代替空弦？

items.source: It avoids a string crossing and sounds warmer
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-3 “Your fourth finger” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: 能避免換弦，音色也更溫暖

items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-3 “Your fourth finger” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Open strings are out of tune
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-3 “Your fourth finger” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A fingered note keeps the line on one string and blends with the notes around it. Open strings ring brighter.
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-3 “Your fourth finger” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 按指的音讓樂句留在同一條弦，並與周圍的音色融合。空弦則更明亮。

items.source: Third-finger D, fourth-finger E on the A string, then open E. Listen for the match.
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-3 “Your fourth finger” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: A 弦第三指的 D、第四指的 E，再拉 E 空弦。聽聽是否一致。

items.source: D to A on one string
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-3 “Your fourth finger” · step 5 (along) · title
items.translation: 一條弦上的 D 到 A

items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-3 “Your fourth finger” · step 6 (along) · title
Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Amazing Grace is sung to an early American tune called New Britain. Its pairs of quick notes are slurs. Let the long notes sing with full, slow bows.
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 《奇異恩典》使用一首早期美國曲調，名叫《新不列顛》。成對的快音用連弓。長音則用飽滿、緩慢的弓來歌唱。

items.source: G to B and back crosses strings. Rock smoothly from the elbow.
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: G 到 B 再回來需要換弦。從手肘平順地擺動。

items.source: How do you bow a quick pair, like B to G?
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 像 B 到 G 這樣的一對快音，如何運弓？

items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: They're slurred, so they share one bow.
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 它們有連奏線，所以共用一弓。

items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 6 (along) · title
Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · title
Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Vibrato is a small, even wave in pitch that makes long notes glow. The fingertip rolls slightly back from the note and returns, again and again, moved by the hand and arm.
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 揉弦是小幅、均勻的音高波動，讓長音更有光彩。由手與手臂帶動，指尖從目標音稍微向後滾，再回來，反覆進行。

items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: Vibrato can't rescue a note that's out of tune; it only colors one that's centered. Most players add it once their fingers land in tune without searching.
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 揉弦不能挽救不準的音，只能為已經準確的音增色。多數樂手會等到手指不必搜尋就能按準，才加入揉弦。

items.source: When is a note ready for vibrato?
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 什麼時候適合為一個音加入揉弦？

items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: Set second finger on the A string. Keep the fingertip in place, soften the knuckle, and slowly rock your hand toward the scroll and back. Small and even. A teacher's eye helps here.
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 把第二指放在 A 弦。指尖留在原處，指關節放鬆，慢慢讓手朝琴頭方向擺，再回來。動作小而均勻。這時有老師觀察會很有幫助。

items.source: Now bow these without vibrato and center each one. That center is where vibrato starts.
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 現在不用揉弦拉這些音，把每個音拉準。這個準確的中心，就是揉弦的起點。

items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 6 (along) · title
Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-6 “Arkansas Traveler” · title
Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-6 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Arkansas Traveler was in print by 1847. Fiddlers slur its quickest notes in pairs, which gives the tune its skip. Start slow and keep the pairs even.
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-6 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 《阿肯色旅人》至遲在 1847 年已有出版版本。樂手把最快的音兩兩連弓，讓曲子有跳躍感。慢慢開始，讓每對音均勻。

items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-6 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 3 (along) · title

items.source: Why do fiddlers slur quick pairs?
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-6 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 為什麼民間小提琴樂手把成對快音用連弓？

items.source: It saves bow and adds a lilt
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-6 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: 節省弓長，也增添輕快感

items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-6 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: It keeps the strings in tune
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-6 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A, G, F sharp, A on the E string: third finger, low 2, first, third.
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-6 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: E 弦的 A、G、升 F、A：第三指、低 2 指、第一指、第三指。

items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · challenge vln-6-7 “Recital: Ode to Joy” · title
Violin · Unit 6 · challenge vln-6-7 “Recital: Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Put it all together: in-tune fingers, straight bows, slurs and dynamics. Start piano, grow through the middle, and finish forte.
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · challenge vln-6-7 “Recital: Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 把一切結合：準確的按指、筆直的運弓、連弓與強弱。以弱奏開始，中段漸強，以強奏結束。

items.source: Warm up: fourth finger against the open strings, A and then E.
items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · challenge vln-6-7 “Recital: Ode to Joy” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 暖身：用第四指對照空弦，先 A，再 E。

items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · challenge vln-6-7 “Recital: Ode to Joy” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 哪個記號表示逐漸變強？

items.context: Violin · Unit 6 · challenge vln-6-7 “Recital: Ode to Joy” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 6 · challenge vln-6-7 “Recital: Ode to Joy” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 6 · challenge vln-6-7 “Recital: Ode to Joy” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 6 · challenge vln-6-7 “Recital: Ode to Joy” · step 4 (along) · title
Violin · Unit 6 · challenge vln-6-7 “Recital: Ode to Joy” · step 5 (along) · title
Cello course · title

items.source: Sit, bow and play in tune, from open strings to The Swan
items.context: Cello course · course subtitle
items.translation: 從空弦到《天鵝》，學習坐姿、運弓與準確音高

items.context: Cello · Unit 1 “Hello, cello” · title

items.source: Sit, set the endpin, hold the bow, play the open strings and your first song.
items.context: Cello · Unit 1 “Hello, cello” · unit summary
items.translation: 坐好、調整尾柱、持弓，拉空弦並演奏第一首歌。

items.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-1 “Meet your cello” · title

items.source: From low to high the strings are C, G, D and A. C is the thickest and lowest. A is the thinnest and highest, and we call it string 1.
items.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-1 “Meet your cello” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 從低到高是 C、G、D、A 弦。C 最粗、最低。A 最細、最高，我們稱它為第 1 弦。

items.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-1 “Meet your cello” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: C is the thickest string and the lowest. Strings count from A (1) to C (4).
items.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-1 “Meet your cello” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: C 弦最粗，音也最低。弦從 A（1）數到 C（4）。

items.source: Pluck string 1, the A, and let it ring.
items.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-1 “Meet your cello” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 撥第 1 弦 A，讓它鳴響。

items.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-1 “Meet your cello” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise

items.source: Now the thickest string, the C. Let it rumble.
items.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-1 “Meet your cello” · step 7 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 現在撥最粗的 C 弦，讓低音隆隆響起。

items.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · title
Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Sit near the front edge of a chair, feet flat and knees apart, as if you could stand up easily. The cello rests between your knees.
items.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 坐在椅子的前緣附近，雙腳平放、雙膝分開，保持隨時能輕鬆站起的姿勢。大提琴靠在雙膝之間。

items.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: Pull out the endpin until the cello's top edge meets your chest at the breastbone and the C peg sits near your left ear. Tighten the screw. A rest or strap keeps it from sliding.
items.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 拉出尾柱，直到琴身上緣碰到胸骨附近，C 弦軸靠近左耳。旋緊螺絲，用防滑墊或固定帶避免尾柱滑動。

items.source: Where does the top edge of the cello touch you?
items.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 大提琴琴身上緣碰到身體哪裡？

items.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: The cello leans back against your chest, and your knees steady it lightly from the sides.
items.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 大提琴向後靠在胸前，雙膝從兩側輕輕穩住它。

items.source: Sitting tall, pluck D, then G. Keep your shoulders loose.
items.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 坐直，先撥 D，再撥 G。肩膀保持放鬆。

items.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: Bend your thumb and set its tip where the frog meets the stick, across from your middle finger. Drape all four fingers over the stick and let the hand hang heavy.
items.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 彎曲拇指，把指尖放在弓根與弓桿相接處，與中指相對。四指自然垂覆弓桿，讓手的重量沉下來。

items.source: Set the bow on the D string, halfway between bridge and fingerboard. Pull it slowly to the right.
items.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 把弓放在 D 弦上，位於琴橋與指板之間的中點，慢慢向右拉。

items.source: Now the A string. Move your whole arm to its level, then pull slowly.
items.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 現在拉 A 弦。整隻手臂移到對應高度，再慢慢拉。

items.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-4 “The open strings” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: From low to high: C, G, D, A. Each string is five letter names above the last, an interval called a fifth. Try: Cats Go Dancing Around.
items.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-4 “The open strings” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 從低到高：C、G、D、A。每條弦比前一條高五個音名字母的位置，這個音程叫五度。可以用英文口訣「Cats Go Dancing Around」的字首來記。

items.source: Your right arm sets which string the bow plays. Each string has its own arm level, like the steps of a stair. Move the whole arm, not just the hand.
items.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-4 “The open strings” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 右手臂決定弓拉哪條弦。每條弦有自己的手臂高度，像樓梯的階梯。移動整隻手臂，不只移動手。

items.source: Bow the C string, then G. Let your arm settle at each level.
items.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-4 “The open strings” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 先拉 C 弦，再拉 G 弦。讓手臂在各個高度穩定下來。

items.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-4 “The open strings” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-5 “Tune your cello” · title

items.source: Orchestras tune to A. Timbre shows how far each string is from its note in cents; 100 cents make a half step, the smallest step on a piano. Tune A, then D, G and C.
items.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-5 “Tune your cello” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 管弦樂團以 A 調音。Timbre 用音分顯示每條弦與目標音的差距；100 音分是一個半音，也就是鋼琴最小的音距。先調 A，再調 D、G 和 C。

items.source: Now D, G and C. Tune each one, then bow it and hold it.
items.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-5 “Tune your cello” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 現在是 D、G 和 C。每條調好後，用弓拉並保持穩定。

items.source: Sit tall with the endpin set, soft bow hold, bow halfway between bridge and fingerboard. Now play everything from this unit.
items.context: Cello · Unit 1 · challenge vc-1-6 “Open-string checkup” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 尾柱調好、坐直、持弓放鬆，弓放在琴橋與指板之間的中點。現在演奏這個單元學過的內容。

items.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb lives on the D string: open D, first finger a whole step up for E, third finger two whole steps up for F sharp. Pluck it first, then bow it.
items.context: Cello · Unit 1 · song vc-1-7 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 《瑪莉有隻小綿羊》在 D 弦上：D 空弦，第一指比空弦高一個全音是 E，第三指比空弦高兩個全音是升 F。先撥奏，再用弓拉。

items.source: First finger on the D string, a whole step up. That's E.
items.context: Cello · Unit 1 · song vc-1-7 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第一指按在 D 弦上，比空弦高一個全音。這就是 E。

items.source: Third finger, a whole step above your first. That's F sharp.
items.context: Cello · Unit 1 · song vc-1-7 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第三指比第一指高一個全音。這就是升 F。

items.source: F sharp, E, D, E, then F sharp three times.
items.context: Cello · Unit 1 · song vc-1-7 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 升 F、E、D、E，再拉三次升 F。

items.source: One slow down-bow, then one slow up-bow on D. Keep the sound even to the end.
items.context: Cello · Unit 2 · lesson vc-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 在 D 弦慢慢拉一次下弓，再拉一次上弓。直到結尾都保持聲音均勻。

items.context: Cello · Unit 2 · lesson vc-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 5 (along) · title
Cello · Unit 2 · lesson vc-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 3 (along) · title
items.translation: D 與 A 弦的四分音符

items.source: D, A, D, A. Let your arm rock between the two levels.
items.context: Cello · Unit 2 · lesson vc-2-3 “String crossings” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: D、A、D、A。讓手臂在兩個高度之間擺動。

items.context: Cello · Unit 2 · lesson vc-2-3 “String crossings” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Cello · Unit 2 · lesson vc-2-3 “String crossings” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Going from C to D skips the G string, so your arm makes a bigger move. Travel smoothly and don't let the middle string sound.
items.context: Cello · Unit 2 · lesson vc-2-3 “String crossings” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 從 C 到 D 會跨過 G 弦，所以手臂要移動更大的幅度。平順移動，不要讓中間的弦發聲。

items.context: Cello · Unit 3 “First position: D and A” · title
items.translation: 第一把位：D 與 A 弦

items.source: One finger per half step: play D major and your first melodies.
items.context: Cello · Unit 3 “First position: D and A” · unit summary
items.translation: 一指一半音：拉 D 大調與最初的旋律。

items.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-1 “First finger: E” · title
Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-1 “First finger: E” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: A half step is the smallest step in music. In first position your fingers sit a half step apart, starting a whole step (two half steps) above the open string. Thumb behind the neck, across from second finger.
items.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-1 “First finger: E” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 半音是音樂中的最小音距。第一把位中，手指彼此相隔半音，第一指從比空弦高一個全音（兩個半音）的位置開始。拇指放在琴頸後方，與第二指相對。

items.source: Open D, then E with your first finger. Hold E until it settles in tune.
items.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-1 “First finger: E” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: D 空弦，再用第一指按 E。延續 E，直到音準穩定。

items.source: Same finger on the A string: open A, then B.
items.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-1 “First finger: E” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: A 弦也用相同手指：A 空弦，再拉 B。

items.source: Open D, then E. How far apart?
items.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-1 “First finger: E” · step 6 (listen) · question or instruction
items.translation: D 空弦，再拉 E。相隔多遠？

items.source: First finger on D and A
items.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-1 “First finger: E” · step 7 (along) · title
items.translation: D 與 A 弦的第一指

items.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · title
Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Third finger plays F sharp, a whole step above E. Let second finger hover over its spot between 1 and 3, so your hand keeps its shape.
items.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 第三指拉升 F，比 E 高一個全音。讓第二指懸在 1、3 指之間自己的位置上，保持手型。

items.source: D, E, F sharp. Keep first finger down while third plays.
items.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: D、E、升 F。第三指按弦時，第一指仍留在弦上。

items.source: From E to the next note: what kind of step?
items.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction
items.translation: 從 E 到下一個音：是哪種音距？

items.source: Why does second finger stay over its spot?
items.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 為什麼第二指要留在自己位置的上方？

items.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Each finger owns a half step. Keeping all four in place makes every note land in the same spot each time.
items.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 每根手指負責一個半音。四指都保持位置，每次就能讓音落在同樣的地方。

items.source: Same fingers on the A string: open A, B, C sharp.
items.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: A 弦也用同樣手指：A 空弦、B、升 C。

items.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-3 “Fourth finger: G” · title
Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-3 “Fourth finger: G” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Fourth finger plays G, a half step above F sharp. D, E, F sharp, G is the first half of the D major scale: open, 1, 3, 4.
items.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-3 “Fourth finger: G” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 第四指拉 G，比升 F 高半音。D、E、升 F、G 是 D 大調音階的前半段：空弦、1、3、4 指。

items.source: D, E, F sharp, G: open, 1, 3, 4.
items.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-3 “Fourth finger: G” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

items.source: Fourth-finger G on the D string is an octave above the open G string: the same letter, eight notes higher. When it's in tune, the G string hums along.
items.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-3 “Fourth finger: G” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: D 弦第四指的 G 比 G 空弦高八度：音名相同，高八個音。音準確時，G 弦會跟著共鳴。

items.source: Fourth-finger G, open G, then fourth-finger G again. Listen for the ring.
items.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-3 “Fourth finger: G” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第四指的 G、G 空弦，再回到第四指的 G。聽共鳴。

items.source: Play D, E, F sharp, G on the D string, then A, B, C sharp, D on the A string. The same fingers twice: open, 1, 3, 4.
items.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-4 “The D major scale” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 先拉 D 弦的 D、E、升 F、G，再拉 A 弦的 A、B、升 C、D。同樣的指法用兩次：空弦、1、3、4 指。

items.source: Which fingers play D major on each string?
items.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-4 “The D major scale” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: D 大調在每條弦上使用哪些指法？

items.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-4 “The D major scale” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-4 “The D major scale” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-4 “The D major scale” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: This French melody from the 1700s uses only notes you've learned: D, E, F sharp, G on the D string, and A and B on the A string.
items.context: Cello · Unit 3 · song vc-3-5 “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 這首來自 1700 年起的那個世紀的法國旋律，只用你學過的音：D 弦的 D、E、升 F、G，以及 A 弦的 A 和 B。

items.source: Which finger plays B on the A string?
items.context: Cello · Unit 3 · song vc-3-5 “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: A 弦的 B 用哪根手指？

items.context: Cello · Unit 3 · song vc-3-6 “Lightly Row” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Cello · Unit 3 · song vc-3-6 “Lightly Row” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Cello · Unit 3 · song vc-3-6 “Lightly Row” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Cello · Unit 3 · challenge vc-3-7 “D and A checkup” · title
items.translation: D 與 A 弦檢查

items.context: Cello · Unit 3 · challenge vc-3-7 “D and A checkup” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Open, 1, 3, 4 on the D and A strings. Keep the hand's shape, land each note in tune, and let the octaves ring.
items.context: Cello · Unit 3 · challenge vc-3-7 “D and A checkup” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: D 與 A 弦上使用空弦、1、3、4 指。保持手型，每個音都按準，讓八度音共鳴。

items.source: Third finger to fourth: what kind of step?
items.context: Cello · Unit 3 · challenge vc-3-7 “D and A checkup” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction
items.translation: 第三指到第四指是哪種音距？

items.source: Two octave checks: G with open G, then fourth-finger D with open D.
items.context: Cello · Unit 3 · challenge vc-3-7 “D and A checkup” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 兩次八度核對：G 與 G 空弦，再用第四指的 D 與 D 空弦。

items.source: Which finger plays C sharp on the A string?
items.context: Cello · Unit 3 · challenge vc-3-7 “D and A checkup” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: A 弦的升 C 用哪根手指？

items.context: Cello · Unit 4 “G and C strings” · title

items.source: Two low strings, C major and G major scales, and three classic melodies.
items.context: Cello · Unit 4 “G and C strings” · unit summary
items.translation: 兩條低音弦、C 大調與 G 大調音階，以及三首經典旋律。

items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-1 “The G string” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: On the G string, first finger plays A, third finger B, and fourth finger C. Same spacing as on D. Let your arm settle at the G string level.
items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-1 “The G string” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: G 弦上，第一指拉 A，第三指拉 B，第四指拉 C。間距與 D 弦相同。讓手臂穩定在 G 弦高度。

items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-1 “The G string” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

items.source: G, A, B, C on the G string plus D, E, F sharp, G on the D string make the G major scale. Same fingers on both strings.
items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-1 “The G string” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: G 弦的 G、A、B、C，加上 D 弦的 D、E、升 F、G，組成 G 大調音階。兩條弦使用同樣指法。

items.source: Which finger plays C on the G string?
items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-1 “The G string” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: G 弦的 C 用哪根手指？

items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-1 “The G string” · step 6 (along) · title
Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-2 “The C string” · title
Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-2 “The C string” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: On the C string, first finger plays D, third finger E, and fourth finger F. The thick string needs a slow, heavy bow to speak.
items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-2 “The C string” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: C 弦上，第一指拉 D，第三指拉 E，第四指拉 F。粗弦需要較慢、帶重量的弓才能充分發聲。

items.source: C, D, E, F: open, 1, 3, 4. Give each note time to speak.
items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-2 “The C string” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: C、D、E、F：空弦、1、3、4 指。給每個音時間發聲。

items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-2 “The C string” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: C, D, E, F on the C string plus G, A, B, C on the G string is the C major scale. It has no sharps at all.
items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-2 “The C string” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: C 弦的 C、D、E、F，加上 G 弦的 G、A、B、C，就是 C 大調音階。完全沒有升音。

items.source: Up the C major scale. At the top, listen for C ringing with the open C string.
items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-2 “The C string” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 上行拉 C 大調音階。到最高音時，聽 C 是否與 C 空弦共鳴。

items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-2 “The C string” · step 6 (along) · title
Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · title
Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Second finger plays F natural on the D string, a half step below F sharp, and C natural on the A string. C major needs both.
items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 第二指在 D 弦拉本位 F，比升 F 低半音；在 A 弦則拉本位 C。C 大調兩者都需要。

items.source: D, E, F, G: open, 1, 2, 4. Second finger sits right next to first.
items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: D、E、F、G：空弦、1、2、4 指。第二指就在第一指旁邊。

items.source: E, then second finger or third?
items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction
items.translation: E，接著是第二指還是第三指？

items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer
Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer
Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: Cellists give each finger its own half step, so F takes second finger and F sharp takes third. A note just past the hand, like F sharp on the C string, needs an extension, a wider hand. This course picks keys that avoid it.
items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 大提琴每指各負責一個半音，所以 F 用第二指、升 F 用第三指。超出手型的音，例如 C 弦的升 F，需要擴張指距。本課程選擇的調性會避開它。

items.source: C major, second octave: second finger for F and for the top C.
items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: C 大調，第二個八度：F 和最高的 C 用第二指。

items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · step 7 (along) · title

items.source: Ode to Joy, an octave up
items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · song vc-4-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 7 (along) · title
Cello · Unit 4 · song vc-4-5 “Brahms' Lullaby” · title
Cello · Unit 4 · song vc-4-5 “Brahms' Lullaby” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Brahms wrote this lullaby in 1868. It rocks in three on the G and D strings. Use long, slow bows and let each phrase breathe.
items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · song vc-4-5 “Brahms' Lullaby” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 布拉姆斯在 1868 年寫下這首搖籃曲。它在 G 與 D 弦上以三拍搖曳。使用長而慢的弓，讓每個樂句呼吸。

items.source: G, F sharp, E: fingers 4, 3, 1. This is the lullaby's high point.
items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · song vc-4-5 “Brahms' Lullaby” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: G、升 F、E：4、3、1 指。這是搖籃曲的高點。

items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · song vc-4-6 “Au clair de la lune” · title
Cello · Unit 4 · song vc-4-6 “Au clair de la lune” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Au clair de la lune is a French folk song from the 1700s. It lives on the G and D strings, with C under your fourth finger.
items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · song vc-4-6 “Au clair de la lune” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 《月光下》是一首來自 1700 年起的那個世紀的法國民謠。它使用 G 與 D 弦，C 由第四指按住。

items.source: D, C, B, A, G: open D, then fingers 4, 3, 1 and open G.
items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · song vc-4-6 “Au clair de la lune” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: D、C、B、A、G：D 空弦，接著 4、3、1 指和 G 空弦。

items.source: Which notes in this tune are open strings?
items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · song vc-4-6 “Au clair de la lune” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 這首曲子中哪些音是空弦？

items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · song vc-4-6 “Au clair de la lune” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Cello · Unit 4 · song vc-4-6 “Au clair de la lune” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
Cello · Unit 4 · challenge vc-4-7 “Low strings checkup” · title
Cello · Unit 4 · challenge vc-4-7 “Low strings checkup” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Open, 1, 3, 4 on every string, with second finger for F and C natural. Slow, heavy bows on the low strings.
items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · challenge vc-4-7 “Low strings checkup” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 每條弦都用空弦、1、3、4 指，本位 F 和 C 則用第二指。低音弦要用較慢、帶重量的弓。

items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · challenge vc-4-7 “Low strings checkup” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction

items.source: Two octave checks: C with open C, then G with open G.
items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · challenge vc-4-7 “Low strings checkup” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 兩次八度核對：C 與 C 空弦，再用 G 與 G 空弦。

items.source: Which of these keys has no sharps?
items.context: Cello · Unit 4 · challenge vc-4-7 “Low strings checkup” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Cello · Unit 4 · challenge vc-4-7 “Low strings checkup” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Cello · Unit 4 · challenge vc-4-7 “Low strings checkup” · step 7 (along) · title
Cello · Unit 5 “Shifting basics” · title

items.source: Slide to fourth position, check it by ear, and play The Swan and Amazing Grace.
items.context: Cello · Unit 5 “Shifting basics” · unit summary
items.translation: 滑到第四把位，用耳朵核對，並演奏《天鵝》與《奇異恩典》。

items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · title
Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A shift moves your whole hand to a new place on the string. Lighten the finger, slide it along the string without lifting, and let your thumb travel with the hand.
items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 換把是把整隻手移到弦上的新位置。減輕手指壓力，不抬起，沿弦滑動，讓拇指跟著手一起移動。

items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: In fourth position, first finger plays D on the A string, the note fourth finger played in first position. Your thumb settles where the neck curves into the body.
items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 第四把位中，第一指在 A 弦拉 D，也就是第一把位第四指拉的音。拇指放在琴頸彎向琴身的地方。

items.source: B with first finger, then slide that finger up to D. Keep it light on the way.
items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第一指拉 B，再把同一指向上滑到 D。移動途中保持輕觸。

items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 換把時，什麼要一起移動？

items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Moving the hand as one unit keeps your finger spacing, so the next notes land in tune too.
items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 整隻手一起移動，能保持指距，讓接下來的音也準確到位。

items.source: Shift up, back, and up again on first finger. Land each note in tune.
items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 用第一指向上換把、回來、再向上。每個音都要落準。

items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · step 6 (along) · title
Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-2 “Fourth position on A” · title
Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-2 “Fourth position on A” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: In fourth position on the A string, first finger plays D, third finger E, and fourth finger F. Same frame as first position: one finger per half step.
items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-2 “Fourth position on A” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: A 弦第四把位中，第一指拉 D，第三指拉 E，第四指拉 F。與第一把位的框架相同：一指一半音。

items.source: D, E, F: fingers 1, 3, 4. Up here the notes sit a little closer together.
items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-2 “Fourth position on A” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: D、E、F：1、3、4 指。到了這裡，音的位置稍微靠近一點。

items.source: Open A, B, shift on first finger to D, then E with third.
items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-2 “Fourth position on A” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: A 空弦、B，第一指換把到 D，再用第三指拉 E。

items.source: In fourth position on the A string, which finger plays E?
items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-2 “Fourth position on A” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: A 弦第四把位中，哪根手指拉 E？

items.source: Up to fourth position and back
items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-2 “Fourth position on A” · step 6 (along) · title
Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-3 “Fourth position on D” · title

items.source: Check it with the open A
items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-3 “Fourth position on D” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: In fourth position on the D string, first finger plays G and third plays A, the same note as the open A string. Play them one after the other and match them.
items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-3 “Fourth position on D” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: D 弦第四把位中，第一指拉 G，第三指拉 A，與 A 空弦同音。先後演奏兩者，讓它們一致。

items.source: First-finger G, then third-finger A, both on the D string.
items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-3 “Fourth position on D” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第一指的 G，再接第三指的 A，都在 D 弦。

items.source: Fourth-position A, open A, fourth-position A. Make them one sound.
items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-3 “Fourth position on D” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第四把位的 A、A 空弦、第四把位的 A。讓它們聽起來是同一個音。

items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-3 “Fourth position on D” · step 4 (listen) · question or instruction
Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-3 “Fourth position on D” · step 4 (listen) · quiz answer
Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-3 “Fourth position on D” · step 4 (listen) · quiz answer
Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-3 “Fourth position on D” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: Play E with first finger in first position, then slide that finger up to G. That's three half steps, the same distance as B to D on the A string.
items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-3 “Fourth position on D” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 在第一把位用第一指拉 E，再把同一指向上滑到 G。相隔三個半音，與 A 弦的 B 到 D 距離相同。

items.source: First-finger E, then slide to first-finger G. Let the thumb travel too.
items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-3 “Fourth position on D” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第一指的 E，再滑到第一指的 G。拇指也一起移動。

items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-3 “Fourth position on D” · step 7 (along) · title
Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-4 “The Swan” · title
Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-4 “The Swan” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: The Swan comes from The Carnival of the Animals, written by Camille Saint-Saëns in 1886. This is its opening phrase, an octave lower and simplified.
items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-4 “The Swan” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 《天鵝》出自 Camille Saint-Saëns 在 1886 年創作的《動物狂歡節》。這裡是降低一個八度並簡化的開頭樂句。

items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-4 “The Swan” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: Long notes need slow bows. Keep the bow close to the bridge and spread it evenly, so each note lasts to its very end without fading.
items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-4 “The Swan” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 長音需要慢弓。弓靠近琴橋，均勻分配弓長，讓每個音延續到最後也不減弱。

items.source: G, F sharp, B: fourth and third finger on D, then third finger on G.
items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-4 “The Swan” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: G、升 F、B：D 弦第四指與第三指，再接 G 弦第三指。

items.source: How do you keep a long note from fading?
items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-4 “The Swan” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 如何讓長音不逐漸變弱？

items.context: Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-4 “The Swan” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-4 “The Swan” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-4 “The Swan” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
