items.source: Backward through the alphabet means lower notes: E, D, C, B.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-1 “The musical alphabet” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 沿字母表倒退，音就降低：E、D、C、B。

items.source: Play or sing C, D, E, climbing up the alphabet.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-1 “The musical alphabet” · step 7 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 彈出或唱出 C、D、E，沿字母表向上。

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-2 “Octaves” · title
Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-2 “Octaves” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Notes that share a letter sound alike even when one is higher. The distance from one C to the next C is an octave. The higher note vibrates exactly twice as fast.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-2 “Octaves” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 音名字母相同的音，即使一高一低，聽起來也相似。一個 C 到下一個 C 的距離是八度。較高的音振動速度正好是兩倍。

items.source: Do these two notes share a letter name?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-2 “Octaves” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction
items.translation: 這兩個音的音名字母相同嗎？

items.source: A4 vibrates 440 times a second. How fast does A5 vibrate?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-2 “Octaves” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: A4 每秒振動 440 次。A5 每秒振動幾次？

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-2 “Octaves” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-2 “Octaves” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-2 “Octaves” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: An octave up doubles the vibration: 440 becomes 880.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-2 “Octaves” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 高一個八度，振動頻率加倍：440 變成 880。

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-2 “Octaves” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: Notes carry a number that tells you which octave they're in. Middle C, near the center of a piano, is C4. The number goes up by one at every C.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-2 “Octaves” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 音名後的數字表示它屬於哪個八度。鋼琴中央附近的中央 C 是 C4。每到一個 C，數字就增加一。

items.source: Which note is just above B3?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-2 “Octaves” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-2 “Octaves” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-2 “Octaves” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-2 “Octaves” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Octave numbers change at C, so the next note up from B3 is C4.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-2 “Octaves” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 八度編號在 C 改變，所以 B3 往上的下一個音是 C4。

items.source: Play or sing middle C, then the C an octave higher.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-2 “Octaves” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 彈出或唱出中央 C，再演奏高八度的 C。

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-3 “The keyboard map” · title
Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-3 “The keyboard map” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A keyboard's black keys come in groups of two and three. They're your map. C is the white key just left of each group of two.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-3 “The keyboard map” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 鍵盤黑鍵分成兩個一組和三個一組，是你的地圖。每組兩個黑鍵左邊緊鄰的白鍵就是 C。

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-3 “The keyboard map” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: C sits just left of the group of two black keys.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-3 “The keyboard map” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: C 就在兩個黑鍵那一組的左邊。

items.source: F and the group of three
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-3 “The keyboard map” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: F is the white key just left of each group of three black keys. Find C and F first, and every other white key is a short count away.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-3 “The keyboard map” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 每組三個黑鍵左邊緊鄰的白鍵是 F。先找到 C 和 F，其他白鍵只要數幾步就能找到。

items.source: F sits just left of the group of three black keys.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-3 “The keyboard map” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: F 就在三個黑鍵那一組的左邊。

items.source: D sits between the two black keys of the pair.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-3 “The keyboard map” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: D 位於兩個黑鍵之間。

items.source: B is the white key just right of the group of three black keys.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-3 “The keyboard map” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: B 是三個黑鍵那一組右邊緊鄰的白鍵。

items.source: Play or sing F, G, A, starting from the F you just found.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-3 “The keyboard map” · step 7 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 從剛找到的 F 開始，彈出或唱出 F、G、A。

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-4 “Every white key” · title
Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-4 “Every white key” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: From C, the white keys run C, D, E, F, G, A, B, then C again. Seven white keys hold one of each letter.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-4 “Every white key” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 從 C 出發，白鍵依次是 C、D、E、F、G、A、B，再回 C。七個白鍵，每個字母各一個。

items.source: G sits between the first two black keys of the group of three.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-4 “Every white key” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: G 位於三個黑鍵那一組的前兩個黑鍵之間。

items.source: E is the white key just right of the group of two black keys.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-4 “Every white key” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: E 是兩個黑鍵那一組右邊緊鄰的白鍵。

items.source: A sits between the last two black keys of the group of three.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-4 “Every white key” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: A 位於三個黑鍵那一組的後兩個黑鍵之間。

items.source: How many white keys run from one C up to the next B?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-4 “Every white key” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 從一個 C 往上到下一個 B，共有幾個白鍵？

items.source: C, D, E, F, G, A, B: seven letters, seven white keys.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-4 “Every white key” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

items.source: Play or sing up the white keys from middle C to the next C.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · lesson thy-1-4 “Every white key” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 從中央 C 沿白鍵向上彈出或唱到下一個 C。

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · challenge thy-1-5 “Notes and letters challenge” · title
Music Theory · Unit 1 · challenge thy-1-5 “Notes and letters challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: The alphabet, octaves and the keyboard map, all together. Use the black-key groups to find your way.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · challenge thy-1-5 “Notes and letters challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 整合字母表、八度與鍵盤地圖。利用黑鍵分組找到方向。

items.source: Which two letters come right after E?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · challenge thy-1-5 “Notes and letters challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: E 之後緊接哪兩個字母？

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · challenge thy-1-5 “Notes and letters challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 1 · challenge thy-1-5 “Notes and letters challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 1 · challenge thy-1-5 “Notes and letters challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: E, F, G: forward through the alphabet.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · challenge thy-1-5 “Notes and letters challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

items.source: Middle C is C4. What's the C an octave above it?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · challenge thy-1-5 “Notes and letters challenge” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 中央 C 是 C4，高八度的 C 是什麼？

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · challenge thy-1-5 “Notes and letters challenge” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Each octave up adds one to the number.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · challenge thy-1-5 “Notes and letters challenge” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 每高一個八度，數字就加一。

items.source: Play or sing G, A, B, C. The alphabet wraps from G back to A.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 1 · challenge thy-1-5 “Notes and letters challenge” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 彈出或唱出 G、A、B、C。字母從 G 繞回 A。

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 “Sharps, flats and half steps” · title

items.source: The black keys, the smallest step, and notes with two names.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 “Sharps, flats and half steps” · unit summary
items.translation: 黑鍵、最小音距，以及有兩個名稱的音。

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-1 “Half steps” · title

items.source: A half step moves from one key to the very next, black or white, with nothing in between. It's the smallest distance on a keyboard and in most music.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-1 “Half steps” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 半音從一個鍵移到緊鄰的下一個鍵，無論黑白，中間沒有其他鍵。這是鍵盤與大多數音樂中的最小音距。

items.source: What is a half step above E?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-1 “Half steps” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-1 “Half steps” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: E and F have no black key between them.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-1 “Half steps” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: E 和 F 之間沒有黑鍵。

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-1 “Half steps” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Look for the gaps with no black key: E to F and B to C. These white keys sit right next to each other, so they're only a half step apart.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-1 “Half steps” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 找沒有黑鍵的間隔：E 到 F、B 到 C。這些白鍵直接相鄰，所以只差半音。

items.source: Which pair of white keys is a half step apart?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-1 “Half steps” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-1 “Half steps” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-1 “Half steps” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-1 “Half steps” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: B and C have no black key between them.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-1 “Half steps” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: B 和 C 之間沒有黑鍵。

items.source: How many half steps from C up to E?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-1 “Half steps” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: C 向上到 E 有幾個半音？

items.source: C, C♯, D, D♯, E: four moves of one key each.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-1 “Half steps” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

items.source: Play or sing the two white-key half steps: E to F, then B to C.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-1 “Half steps” · step 7 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 彈出或唱出兩組白鍵半音：E 到 F，再 B 到 C。

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-2 “Sharps and flats” · title
Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-2 “Sharps and flats” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A sharp (♯) raises a note by a half step. A flat (♭) lowers it by a half step. The black key just above C is C♯; the one just below D is D♭.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-2 “Sharps and flats” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 升記號（♯）把音升高半音，降記號（♭）把音降低半音。C 正上方的黑鍵是 C♯，D 正下方的黑鍵是 D♭。

items.source: What does a sharp do to a note?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-2 “Sharps and flats” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 升記號對音有什麼作用？

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-2 “Sharps and flats” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-2 “Sharps and flats” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-2 “Sharps and flats” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: This black key sits just above F. What's its sharp name?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-2 “Sharps and flats” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 這個黑鍵在 F 正上方，它的升音名稱是什麼？

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-2 “Sharps and flats” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-2 “Sharps and flats” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Raise F by a half step and you get F♯.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-2 “Sharps and flats” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 把 F 升高半音，就是 F♯。

items.source: The same key sits just below G. What's its flat name?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-2 “Sharps and flats” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 同一個鍵在 G 正下方，它的降音名稱是什麼？

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-2 “Sharps and flats” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-2 “Sharps and flats” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-2 “Sharps and flats” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Lower G by a half step and you get G♭.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-2 “Sharps and flats” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 把 G 降低半音，就是 G♭。

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-2 “Sharps and flats” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: Each black key can be named from the white key below it, with a sharp, or the white key above it, with a flat. C♯ and D♭ are the same key.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-2 “Sharps and flats” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 每個黑鍵都能依下方白鍵加升記號命名，或依上方白鍵加降記號命名。C♯ 和 D♭ 是同一個鍵。

items.source: What is a half step below B?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-2 “Sharps and flats” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-2 “Sharps and flats” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-2 “Sharps and flats” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Lower B by a half step and you get B♭.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-2 “Sharps and flats” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 把 B 降低半音，就是 B♭。

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-2 “Sharps and flats” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-2 “Sharps and flats” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-2 “Sharps and flats” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: It's the right-hand key of the pair, just above D: D♯.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-2 “Sharps and flats” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 它是兩個黑鍵那一組的右邊那個，在 D 正上方：D♯。

items.source: Play or sing C, C♯, D: two half steps up.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-2 “Sharps and flats” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 彈出或唱出 C、C♯、D：向上兩個半音。

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-3 “Whole steps” · title
Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-3 “Whole steps” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A whole step equals two half steps: it skips exactly one key. C to D is a whole step, with C♯ in between. E to F♯ is too.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-3 “Whole steps” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 一個全音等於兩個半音，正好跳過一個鍵。C 到 D 是全音，中間是 C♯。E 到 F♯ 也是。

items.source: What is a whole step above C?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-3 “Whole steps” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: C to D skips one key, C♯.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-3 “Whole steps” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: C 到 D 跳過一個鍵，C♯。

items.source: What is a whole step above E?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-3 “Whole steps” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: E to F is only a half step, so a whole step up is F♯.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-3 “Whole steps” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: E 到 F 只有半音，所以向上全音是 F♯。

items.source: What is a whole step above B?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-3 “Whole steps” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: B to C is a half step, so a whole step up is C♯.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-3 “Whole steps” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: B 到 C 是半音，所以向上全音是 C♯。

items.source: What is a whole step below F?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-3 “Whole steps” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction
Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-3 “Whole steps” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: F down to E is a half step; one more key down is E♭.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-3 “Whole steps” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: F 向下到 E 是半音，再往下一個鍵就是 E♭。

items.source: Play or sing two whole steps up from E: E, F♯, G♯.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-3 “Whole steps” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 從 E 向上彈出或唱出兩個全音：E、F♯、G♯。

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-4 “One key, two names” · title
Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-4 “One key, two names” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Two names for the same pitch are called enharmonic. C♯ and D♭ are one key with two names. Which name you use depends on the key you're in.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-4 “One key, two names” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 同音高的兩個名稱稱為等音。C♯ 和 D♭ 是同一個鍵的兩個名稱。使用哪個名稱，取決於所在的調性。

items.source: Which pair names the same key?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-4 “One key, two names” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 哪一對名稱表示同一個鍵？

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-4 “One key, two names” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-4 “One key, two names” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-4 “One key, two names” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: C♯ is a half step above C; D♭ is a half step below D. Same key.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-4 “One key, two names” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: C♯ 比 C 高半音，D♭ 比 D 低半音。它們是同一個鍵。

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-4 “One key, two names” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: G♯ 的另一個名稱是什麼？

items.source: G♯ and A♭ are the same black key.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-4 “One key, two names” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: G♯ 和 A♭ 是同一個黑鍵。

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-4 “One key, two names” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: White keys can have sharp or flat names as well. E and F are a half step apart, so E♯ is the same key as F, and F♭ is the same key as E.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-4 “One key, two names” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 白鍵也能有升音或降音名稱。E 與 F 相差半音，所以 E♯ 與 F 是同一鍵，F♭ 與 E 是同一鍵。

items.source: E♯ is played on which key?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-4 “One key, two names” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: E♯ is a half step above E, which is F.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-4 “One key, two names” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: E♯ 比 E 高半音，也就是 F。

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-4 “One key, two names” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: C 的另一個名稱是什麼？

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-4 “One key, two names” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-4 “One key, two names” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: B♯ is a half step above B, which is C.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-4 “One key, two names” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: B♯ 比 B 高半音，也就是 C。

items.source: The black key between F and G is F♯. What's its other name?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-4 “One key, two names” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: F 和 G 之間的黑鍵是 F♯，另一個名稱是什麼？

items.source: Play or sing B♭, C, D. B♭ is the same key as A♯.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · lesson thy-2-4 “One key, two names” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 彈出或唱出 B♭、C、D。B♭ 與 A♯ 是同一個鍵。

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · challenge thy-2-5 “Sharps and flats challenge” · title
Music Theory · Unit 2 · challenge thy-2-5 “Sharps and flats challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Half steps, whole steps, sharps, flats and two-name notes, all mixed together. Picture the keyboard as you answer.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · challenge thy-2-5 “Sharps and flats challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 半音、全音、升音、降音與等音混合。回答時，在腦海想像鍵盤。

items.source: What is a half step above B?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · challenge thy-2-5 “Sharps and flats challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: What is a whole step above A?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · challenge thy-2-5 “Sharps and flats challenge” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: A to B skips one key, A♯.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · challenge thy-2-5 “Sharps and flats challenge” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: A 到 B 跳過一個鍵，A♯。

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · challenge thy-2-5 “Sharps and flats challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: E♭ 的另一個名稱是什麼？

items.source: E♭ and D♯ are the same black key.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · challenge thy-2-5 “Sharps and flats challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: E♭ 和 D♯ 是同一個黑鍵。

items.source: It's the top key of the group of three, just below B: A♯, also called B♭.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · challenge thy-2-5 “Sharps and flats challenge” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 它是三個黑鍵那一組最高的鍵，在 B 正下方：A♯，也叫 B♭。

items.source: What is a whole step below D?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · challenge thy-2-5 “Sharps and flats challenge” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: D to C skips one key, C♯.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · challenge thy-2-5 “Sharps and flats challenge” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: D 到 C 跳過一個鍵，C♯。

items.source: Play or sing D, E, F♯, G: whole, whole, then half.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 2 · challenge thy-2-5 “Sharps and flats challenge” · step 9 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 彈出或唱出 D、E、F♯、G：全音、全音，再半音。

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 “Reading the staff” · title

items.source: Treble clef lines and spaces, ledger lines, and a first look at bass clef.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 “Reading the staff” · unit summary
items.translation: 高音譜號的線與間、加線，以及低音譜號入門。

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-1 “Lines and spaces” · title
Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-1 “Lines and spaces” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Music is written on a staff: five lines with four spaces between them. Notes sit on a line or in a space. The higher a note sits, the higher it sounds.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-1 “Lines and spaces” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 音樂寫在五線譜上：五條線，中間四個間。音符可在線上或間內，位置越高，聲音越高。

items.source: How many lines does a staff have?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-1 “Lines and spaces” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: Five lines, with four spaces between them.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-1 “Lines and spaces” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-1 “Lines and spaces” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: It sits higher on the staff, so it sounds higher.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-1 “Lines and spaces” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 它在譜上的位置較高，所以聲音較高。

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-1 “Lines and spaces” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: Moving up one letter moves from a line to the next space, or from a space to the next line. Notes on neighboring lines are two letters apart.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-1 “Lines and spaces” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 音名向上一個字母，就從線移到下一個間，或從間移到下一條線。相鄰兩條線上的音，相隔兩個字母步距。

items.source: A note on a line moves up one letter. Where does it land?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-1 “Lines and spaces” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 線上的音向上一個字母，會落在哪裡？

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-1 “Lines and spaces” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-1 “Lines and spaces” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-1 “Lines and spaces” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Letters alternate: line, space, line, space.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-1 “Lines and spaces” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 字母交替排列：線、間、線、間。

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-2 “Treble clef lines” · title
Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-2 “Treble clef lines” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: The treble clef, or G clef, curls around the second line from the bottom. That line is the G above middle C. Higher instruments and voices read it.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-2 “Treble clef lines” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 高音譜號也叫 G 譜號，捲曲處圍繞由下數第二條線。那條線是中央 C 上方的 G。高音樂器與人聲使用它。

items.source: Which note is on the second line of the treble staff?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-2 “Treble clef lines” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 高音譜表第二條線是哪個音？

items.source: The treble clef curls around that line to mark G.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-2 “Treble clef lines” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 高音譜號圍繞那條線，標示 G。

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-2 “Treble clef lines” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: From bottom to top, the treble staff's lines are E, G, B, D, F. Remember them as Every Good Boy Does Fine.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-2 “Treble clef lines” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 高音譜表的線由下到上是 E、G、B、D、F。可用英文口訣「Every Good Boy Does Fine」的字首記憶。

items.source: The bottom line is E, the Every of Every Good Boy Does Fine.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-2 “Treble clef lines” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 最下面的線是 E，對應「Every Good Boy Does Fine」的 Every。

items.source: The middle line is B, the Boy of Every Good Boy Does Fine.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-2 “Treble clef lines” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 中間的線是 B，對應「Every Good Boy Does Fine」的 Boy。

items.source: The top line is F, the Fine of Every Good Boy Does Fine.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-2 “Treble clef lines” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 最上面的線是 F，對應「Every Good Boy Does Fine」的 Fine。

items.source: The fourth line up is D, the Does of Every Good Boy Does Fine.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-2 “Treble clef lines” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 由下數第四條線是 D，對應「Every Good Boy Does Fine」的 Does。

items.source: Play or sing the bottom three lines: E, G, B.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-2 “Treble clef lines” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 彈出或唱出最下面三條線的音：E、G、B。

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · title
Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: The four spaces of the treble staff spell a word from bottom to top: F, A, C, E. The spaces spell FACE.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 高音譜表的四個間由下到上拼成一個英文單字：F、A、C、E，也就是 FACE。

items.source: The bottom space is F, the first letter of FACE.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 最下面的間是 F，FACE 的第一個字母。

items.source: The third space up is C: F, A, C.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 由下數第三個間是 C：F、A、C。

items.source: The second space up is A: F, A.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 由下數第二個間是 A：F、A。

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: Put them together and the staff climbs E, F, G, A, B, C, D, E, F: line, space, line, space, all the way up.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 合起來，譜表向上是 E、F、G、A、B、C、D、E、F：線、間、線、間，一路往上。

items.source: The top space is E, the last letter of FACE.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 最上面的間是 E，FACE 的最後一個字母。

items.source: The second line up is G, where the treble clef curls.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 由下數第二條線是 G，高音譜號捲曲圍繞的地方。

items.source: Play or sing the spaces from bottom to top: F, A, C, E.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 由下到上彈出或唱出間內的音：F、A、C、E。

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-4 “Ledger lines and middle C” · title
Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-4 “Ledger lines and middle C” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: When a note goes above or below the staff, short extra lines called ledger lines extend it. Middle C sits on one ledger line just below the treble staff.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-4 “Ledger lines and middle C” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 音符超出五線譜上方或下方時，用短短的加線延伸譜表。中央 C 位於高音譜表下方的第一條加線上。

items.source: One ledger line below the treble staff is middle C.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-4 “Ledger lines and middle C” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 高音譜表下方第一條加線是中央 C。

items.source: D hangs in the space just below the bottom line.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-4 “Ledger lines and middle C” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: D 位於最下面一條線下方的間。

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-4 “Ledger lines and middle C” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: Above the top line, the pattern keeps going. G sits just above the top line, and A sits on the first ledger line above.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-4 “Ledger lines and middle C” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 超過最上面的線，規律繼續。G 在最上面一條線正上方的間，A 在上方第一條加線上。

items.source: One ledger line above the treble staff is A.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-4 “Ledger lines and middle C” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 高音譜表上方第一條加線是 A。

items.source: Count down: middle C on the first ledger line, B below it, A on the second ledger line.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-4 “Ledger lines and middle C” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 往下數：第一條下加線是中央 C，下方是 B，第二條下加線是 A。

items.source: Play or sing middle C, then D and E, climbing from the ledger line onto the staff.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-4 “Ledger lines and middle C” · step 7 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 彈出或唱出中央 C，再到 D、E，從加線向上走進譜表。

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · title
Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Low instruments and voices read the bass clef, or F clef. Its two dots surround the fourth line up, marking the F below middle C.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 低音樂器與人聲使用低音譜號，也叫 F 譜號。兩個點夾著由下數第四條線，標示中央 C 下方的 F。

items.source: Which note do the bass clef's dots mark?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 低音譜號的兩個點標示哪個音？

items.source: The bass clef is the F clef: its dots frame the F line.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 低音譜號就是 F 譜號：兩個點夾著 F 的線。

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: The bass staff's lines, bottom to top, are G, B, D, F, A: Good Boys Do Fine Always. The spaces are A, C, E, G: All Cows Eat Grass.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 低音譜表的線由下到上是 G、B、D、F、A，可用「Good Boys Do Fine Always」記憶。間是 A、C、E、G，可用「All Cows Eat Grass」記憶。

items.source: The bottom line of the bass staff is G, the Good of Good Boys Do Fine Always.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 低音譜表最下面的線是 G，對應「Good Boys Do Fine Always」的 Good。

items.source: The second space up is C: All Cows.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 由下數第二個間是 C：All Cows。

items.source: The top line of the bass staff is A, the Always of Good Boys Do Fine Always.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 低音譜表最上面的線是 A，對應「Good Boys Do Fine Always」的 Always。

items.source: Where is middle C in bass clef?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 低音譜號中的中央 C 在哪裡？

items.source: On a ledger line above the staff
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Middle C sits one ledger line above the bass staff, and one below the treble staff.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 中央 C 在低音譜表上方第一條加線，也在高音譜表下方第一條加線。

items.source: Play or sing the bass clef spaces: A, C, E, G.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 彈出或唱出低音譜號間內的音：A、C、E、G。

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · challenge thy-3-6 “Staff reading challenge” · title
Music Theory · Unit 3 · challenge thy-3-6 “Staff reading challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Lines, spaces, ledger lines and both clefs. Use your memory sentences, then try to recognize each note at a glance.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · challenge thy-3-6 “Staff reading challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 線、間、加線與兩種譜號。先用口訣，再試著一眼認出每個音。

items.source: The third space up in bass clef is E: All Cows Eat.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · challenge thy-3-6 “Staff reading challenge” · step 8 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 低音譜號由下數第三個間是 E：All Cows Eat。

items.source: Play or sing middle C, then E, G, and the C in the third space.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · challenge thy-3-6 “Staff reading challenge” · step 9 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 彈出或唱出中央 C，再到 E、G，以及第三個間的 C。

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 “Rhythm and time” · title

items.source: Note values from whole to sixteenth, dots and rests, and the meters 4/4, 3/4 and 6/8.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 “Rhythm and time” · unit summary
items.translation: 從全音符到十六分音符的時值、附點與休止，以及 4/4、3/4、6/8 拍。

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · title
Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: The beat is the steady pulse you tap your foot to. Beats are grouped into bars, also called measures. In most music, each bar holds four beats.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 拍子是你用腳跟著打的穩定脈動。拍子分組成小節，英文稱 bar 或 measure。大多數音樂每小節有四拍。

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Count each bar out loud: 1, 2, 3, 4. Beat 1, the downbeat, usually feels strongest. Lean into it a little.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 每小節大聲數：1、2、3、4。第 1 拍是強拍，通常感覺最強，稍微強調它。

items.source: What's another word for a bar?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 英文 bar 的另一個說法是什麼？

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Bar and measure mean the same thing.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Bar 和 measure 都表示小節。

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Beat 1, the downbeat, starts each bar.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 第 1 拍是強拍，也是每小節的開始。

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · title
items.translation: 全音符、二分音符與四分音符

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A note's shape tells you how long it lasts. In a four-beat bar, a whole note lasts all four beats, a half note two, and a quarter note one.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 音符形狀告訴你它持續多久。在四拍的小節中，全音符持續四拍，二分音符兩拍，四分音符一拍。

items.source: How many beats does a half note last?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: Two half notes fill a four-beat bar.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 兩個二分音符填滿四拍的一小節。

items.source: How many quarter notes fill a bar of four beats?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 四拍的一小節能容納幾個四分音符？

items.source: A quarter note lasts one beat, so four fill the bar.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 四分音符持續一拍，所以四個填滿一小節。

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A whole note lasts four beats, a half note two, a quarter note one.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 全音符四拍，二分音符兩拍，四分音符一拍。

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 6 (explain) · title

items.source: A bar can mix values, as long as they add up. A half note plus two quarter notes fills four beats: 2 + 1 + 1.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 只要總和正確，一小節可以混合時值。二分音符加兩個四分音符，共四拍：2 + 1 + 1。

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-3 “Eighth and sixteenth notes” · title
items.translation: 八分音符與十六分音符

items.source: An eighth note lasts half a beat, so two fit in each beat. Count them 1 and 2 and 3 and 4 and, saying and between the beats.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-3 “Eighth and sixteenth notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 八分音符持續半拍，每拍容納兩個。數 1 又 2 又 3 又 4 又，在拍間說「又」。

items.source: An eighth note lasts half a beat.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-3 “Eighth and sixteenth notes” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

items.source: A sixteenth note lasts a quarter of a beat, so four fit in each beat. Count them 1 e and a, 2 e and a.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-3 “Eighth and sixteenth notes” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 十六分音符持續四分之一拍，每拍容納四個。數 1 e and a、2 e and a。

items.source: How many sixteenth notes equal one quarter note?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-3 “Eighth and sixteenth notes” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 幾個十六分音符等於一個四分音符？

items.source: A quarter note is one beat, and four sixteenths fit in a beat.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-3 “Eighth and sixteenth notes” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 四分音符是一拍，而一拍容納四個十六分音符。

items.source: How many eighth notes fill a bar of four beats?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-3 “Eighth and sixteenth notes” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 四拍的一小節能容納幾個八分音符？

items.source: Two per beat, four beats: eight eighth notes.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-3 “Eighth and sixteenth notes” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 每拍兩個，共四拍：八個八分音符。

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · title
Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A dot after a note adds half its value. A half note lasts two beats, so a dotted half lasts three. A dotted quarter lasts one and a half.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 音符後的附點增加原時值的一半。二分音符兩拍，所以附點二分音符三拍。附點四分音符一拍半。

items.source: Half of two is one, so the dot adds one beat: 2 + 1 = 3.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 二的一半是一，所以附點增加一拍：2 + 1 = 3。

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: A rest is a measured silence. Each note value has a matching rest: a quarter rest lasts one beat, a half rest two. Keep counting through them.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 休止是有時值的安靜。每種音符都有對應休止符：四分休止符一拍，二分休止符兩拍。休止時繼續數拍。

items.source: A quarter is one beat; the dot adds half of that.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 四分音符是一拍，附點增加它的一半。

items.source: A four-beat bar has a half note and a quarter note. What fills the gap?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 四拍小節裡已有二分音符和四分音符，還差什麼？

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: 2 + 1 = 3, so one beat is left: a quarter rest.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · title
Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: The two stacked numbers at the start of a piece are the time signature. The top number counts beats per bar. The bottom shows which note gets one beat: 4 means a quarter note.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 樂曲開頭上下排列的兩個數字就是拍號。上方表示每小節幾拍，下方表示哪種音符算一拍：4 代表四分音符。

items.source: In 4/4, how many quarter-note beats are in a bar?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 4/4 拍每小節有幾個四分音符拍？

items.source: The top 4 means four beats; the bottom 4 makes each one a quarter note.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 上方的 4 表示四拍，下方的 4 表示每拍是四分音符。

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: In 3/4, each bar holds three quarter-note beats. Count 1, 2, 3, with the weight on 1. It's the lilt of a waltz.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 3/4 拍每小節有三個四分音符拍。數 1、2、3，重心放在 1。這就是圓舞曲的搖曳感。

items.source: Which time signature is a waltz usually in?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 圓舞曲通常是哪種拍號？

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: In 6/8, each bar holds six eighth notes in two groups of three. It feels like two big beats, each split in three: 1 2 3, 4 5 6.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 6/8 拍每小節有六個八分音符，分成兩組，每組三個。感覺是兩個大拍，每拍再分三份：1 2 3、4 5 6。

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Two beats, each split in three
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Three beats, each split in two
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: The eighths group 1 2 3, 4 5 6, so you feel two strong pulses per bar.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 八分音符分成 1 2 3、4 5 6，所以每小節感受兩個強脈動。

items.source: In 3/4, which single note fills a whole bar?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 3/4 拍中，哪個單一音符能填滿一小節？

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Three beats: a half note (2) plus its dot (1).
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 4 · challenge thy-4-6 “Rhythm challenge” · title
Music Theory · Unit 4 · challenge thy-4-6 “Rhythm challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Note values, dots, rests and time signatures together. Count out loud as you tap; your voice keeps your hands honest.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · challenge thy-4-6 “Rhythm challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 整合音符時值、附點、休止與拍號。邊敲邊大聲數，讓聲音幫手維持準確。

items.source: How many beats does a whole note last in 4/4?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · challenge thy-4-6 “Rhythm challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: How many sixteenth notes fit in one beat?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · challenge thy-4-6 “Rhythm challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 一拍能容納幾個十六分音符？

items.source: What does a dot add to a note?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · challenge thy-4-6 “Rhythm challenge” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
Music Theory · Unit 4 · challenge thy-4-6 “Rhythm challenge” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 4 · challenge thy-4-6 “Rhythm challenge” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A bar of 3/4 has a quarter note and a quarter rest. What's missing?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · challenge thy-4-6 “Rhythm challenge” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 3/4 小節已有四分音符與四分休止符，還缺什麼？

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · challenge thy-4-6 “Rhythm challenge” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: 3/4 holds three beats; 1 + 1 = 2, so one beat remains.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · challenge thy-4-6 “Rhythm challenge” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 3/4 拍共有三拍；1 + 1 = 2，所以還剩一拍。

items.source: How many eighth notes are in a bar of 6/8?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · challenge thy-4-6 “Rhythm challenge” · step 8 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 一小節 6/8 拍有幾個八分音符？

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 “Major scales and keys” · title

items.source: The whole-and-half-step recipe, four major keys, and their key signatures.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 “Major scales and keys” · unit summary
items.translation: 全音半音公式、四個大調，以及它們的調號。

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A scale is a set of notes climbing in order from a home note to the same note an octave up. C major uses only white keys: C, D, E, F, G, A, B, C.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 音階是一組音，從主音依序上行，到高八度的同名音。C 大調只用白鍵：C、D、E、F、G、A、B、C。

items.source: How many different letters are in a major scale?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 大調音階有幾個不同字母？

items.source: Seven letters, then the first one returns an octave higher.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 七個字母，再以高八度的第一個音名結尾。

items.source: Is this scale going up or down?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction
items.translation: 這個音階是上行還是下行？

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: In C major, most neighbors are a whole step apart. Only E to F and B to C are half steps. That uneven spacing gives the scale its sound.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: C 大調中，多數相鄰音相隔全音。只有 E 到 F、B 到 C 是半音。這種不均等間距形成它的聲音。

items.source: In C major, which steps are half steps?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: C 大調中，哪些音之間是半音？

items.source: C to D and F to G
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: C 到 D、F 到 G

items.source: E to F and B to C
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: E 到 F、B 到 C

items.source: D to E and A to B
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: D 到 E、A 到 B

items.source: E and F, and B and C, have no black key between them.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: E 與 F、B 與 C 之間都沒有黑鍵。

items.source: What's the home note of C major?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: C 大調的主音是什麼？

items.source: The home note, called the tonic, gives the scale its name.

items.translation: 彈出或唱出 D 大調前四個音：全音、全音、半音。

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-3 “G major” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Start on G and follow the recipe: G, A, B, C, D, E, then a whole step to F♯ and a half step home to G. G major has one sharp: F♯.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-3 “G major” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 從 G 按公式走：G、A、B、C、D、E，再全音到 F♯，半音回 G。G 大調只有一個升音：F♯。

items.source: Why does G major need F♯ instead of F?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-3 “G major” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 為什麼 G 大調需要 F♯ 而不是 F？

items.source: F is too low to sing
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-3 “G major” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: 因為 F 太低，唱不出來

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-3 “G major” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: E to F is only a half step
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-3 “G major” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: 因為 E 到 F 只有半音

items.source: The recipe needs a whole step from note 6 to 7, then a half step from 7 up to G.

items.translation: 公式需要第 6 到 7 音是全音，再由第 7 音向上半音回 G。

items.translation: G 大調第七個音是 F♯。

items.source: From D, the recipe gives D, E, F♯, G, A, B, C♯, D. D major has two sharps: F♯ and C♯.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-4 “D major and F major” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 從 D 按公式走，得到 D、E、F♯、G、A、B、C♯、D。D 大調有兩個升音：F♯ 和 C♯。

items.source: Which two sharps are in D major?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-4 “D major and F major” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: D 大調有哪兩個升音？

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-4 “D major and F major” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-4 “D major and F major” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-4 “D major and F major” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Following the recipe from D lands on F♯ as note 3 and C♯ as note 7.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-4 “D major and F major” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 從 D 按公式走，第 3 音是 F♯，第 7 音是 C♯。

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-4 “D major and F major” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: From F, the recipe needs a half step from A to the fourth note, so it's B♭, not B. F major: F, G, A, B♭, C, D, E, F. One flat: B♭.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-4 “D major and F major” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 從 F 出發，公式要求 A 到第四個音是半音，所以是 B♭，不是 B。F 大調：F、G、A、B♭、C、D、E、F。只有一個降音：B♭。

items.source: Which note is in F major?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-4 “D major and F major” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 哪個音屬於 F 大調？

items.source: F major's fourth note is B♭, a half step above A.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-4 “D major and F major” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: F 大調第四個音是 B♭，比 A 高半音。

Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-4 “D major and F major” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: D major has F♯ and C♯.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-4 “D major and F major” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: D 大調有 F♯ 和 C♯。

items.source: Play or sing up F major from F to C. The fourth note is B♭.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-4 “D major and F major” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 沿 F 大調從 F 向上彈出或唱到 C。第四個音是 B♭。

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-5 “Key signatures” · title

items.source: Rather than writing F♯ every time, music in G major puts one sharp at the start of each line. That's the key signature: it lists the notes that are always sharp or flat.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-5 “Key signatures” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: G 大調樂譜不必每次寫 F♯，而是在每行開頭放一個升記號。這就是調號，列出固定升高或降低的音。

items.source: A key signature has one sharp, F♯. Which major key is it?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-5 “Key signatures” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 調號有一個升音 F♯，是哪個大調？

items.source: G major is the major key with just F♯.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-5 “Key signatures” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 只有 F♯ 的大調是 G 大調。

items.source: A key signature has one flat, B♭. Which major key is it?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-5 “Key signatures” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 調號有一個降音 B♭，是哪個大調？

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-5 “Key signatures” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: F major is the major key with just B♭.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-5 “Key signatures” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 只有 B♭ 的大調是 F 大調。

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-5 “Key signatures” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: Sharps always appear in the same order: F♯, C♯, G♯, and so on. The last sharp is a half step below the key's name. One sharp, F♯: G major.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-5 “Key signatures” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 升音總按固定順序出現：F♯、C♯、G♯，依此類推。最後一個升音比調名低半音。一個升音 F♯，就是 G 大調。

items.source: A key signature has two sharps, F♯ and C♯. Which major key is it?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-5 “Key signatures” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 調號有 F♯、C♯ 兩個升音，是哪個大調？

items.source: The last sharp, C♯, is a half step below D.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-5 “Key signatures” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 最後的升音 C♯ 比 D 低半音。

items.source: Which major key has no sharps or flats?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-5 “Key signatures” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.translation: 調號標示 B♭，哪些 B 要彈成 B♭？

items.source: A key signature applies to every B in every octave, unless the music marks otherwise.

items.translation: 除非樂譜另有標記，調號適用於每個八度的所有 B。

items.source: An interval's number comes from counting letter names, including both ends. C up to E counts C, D, E: three letters, so it's a third.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-1 “Counting interval numbers” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 音程度數由音名字母數量決定，兩端都要算。C 向上到 E，數 C、D、E，共三個字母，所以是三度。

items.source: C up to G is a...

items.translation: C 向上到 G 是……

items.source: Sharps and flats don't change an interval's number. C to E♭ and C to E are both thirds: C, D, E either way. They differ in size, which comes next.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-1 “Counting interval numbers” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 升降記號不改變音程度數。C 到 E♭ 與 C 到 E 都是三度，兩者都數 C、D、E。它們的大小不同，接著會學。

items.source: F up to D is a...
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-1 “Counting interval numbers” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: F 向上到 D 是……

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-1 “Counting interval numbers” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-1 “Counting interval numbers” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: A 向上到 E♭ 是……

items.source: A, B, C, D, E: five letters. The flat doesn't change the count.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-1 “Counting interval numbers” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: A、B、C、D、E：五個字母。降記號不改變度數。

items.source: G up to the next G is a...
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-1 “Counting interval numbers” · step 8 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: G 向上到下一個 G 是……

Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-1 “Counting interval numbers” · step 8 (quiz) · quiz answer

Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-2 “Thirds by size” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Two intervals with the same number can differ in size. To measure exactly, count half steps. C up to E is four; C up to E♭ is three.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-2 “Thirds by size” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 度數相同的音程，大小可能不同。要精確衡量，就數半音。C 向上到 E 是四個，C 向上到 E♭ 是三個。

items.source: How many half steps from D up to F?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-2 “Thirds by size” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: D 向上到 F 有幾個半音？

items.source: D, D♯, E, F: three moves.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-2 “Thirds by size” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

items.source: A third of four half steps is a major third, like C to E. A third of three is a minor third, like C to E♭ or A to C.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-2 “Thirds by size” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 四個半音的三度是大三度，例如 C 到 E。三個半音的三度是小三度，例如 C 到 E♭ 或 A 到 C。

items.source: E up to G♯ is a...
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-2 “Thirds by size” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: E 向上到 G♯ 是……

items.source: E to G♯ spans four half steps.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-2 “Thirds by size” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: E 到 G♯ 跨四個半音。

items.source: A up to C is a...
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-2 “Thirds by size” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: A 向上到 C 是……

items.source: A to C spans three half steps.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-2 “Thirds by size” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: A 到 C 跨三個半音。

items.source: G up to B♭ is a...
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-2 “Thirds by size” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: G 向上到 B♭ 是……

items.source: G to B♭ spans three half steps.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-2 “Thirds by size” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: G 到 B♭ 跨三個半音。

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-3 “Perfect intervals” · title

items.source: Unisons, fourths, fifths and octaves are called perfect. A perfect fourth spans five half steps, a perfect fifth seven, and an octave twelve.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-3 “Perfect intervals” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 同度、四度、五度與八度使用「完全」這個名稱。完全四度跨五個半音，完全五度七個，八度十二個。

items.source: How many half steps are in a perfect fifth?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-3 “Perfect intervals” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: C up to G: seven half steps.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-3 “Perfect intervals” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: C 向上到 G：七個半音。

items.source: C up to F is a...
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-3 “Perfect intervals” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: C 向上到 F 是……

items.source: C to F spans five half steps.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-3 “Perfect intervals” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: C 到 F 跨五個半音。

items.source: Watch out for B and F
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-3 “Perfect intervals” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: Most white-key fifths are perfect, but B up to F spans only six half steps. It's called a diminished fifth. When in doubt, count half steps.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-3 “Perfect intervals” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 大多數白鍵五度都是完全五度，但 B 向上到 F 只有六個半音，稱為減五度。不確定時，就數半音。

items.source: Which of these fifths is smaller than perfect?
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-3 “Perfect intervals” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 以下哪個五度比完全五度小？

Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-3 “Perfect intervals” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-3 “Perfect intervals” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: B to F spans six half steps; a perfect fifth needs seven.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-3 “Perfect intervals” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: B 到 F 跨六個半音；完全五度需要七個。

items.source: A up to D is a...
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-3 “Perfect intervals” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: A 向上到 D 是……

items.source: A, B, C, D: four letters, five half steps.

Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-4 “Seconds, sixths and sevenths” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Seconds, thirds, sixths and sevenths come in major and minor sizes. Minor is always one half step smaller than major.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-4 “Seconds, sixths and sevenths” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 二度、三度、六度與七度都有大、小兩種大小。小音程總比對應的大音程小半音。

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-4 “Seconds, sixths and sevenths” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: Minor second 1, major second 2. Minor third 3, major third 4. Minor sixth 8, major sixth 9. Minor seventh 10, major seventh 11.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-4 “Seconds, sixths and sevenths” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 小二度 1，大二度 2。小三度 3，大三度 4。小六度 8，大六度 9。小七度 10，大七度 11。

items.source: C up to A is a...
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-4 “Seconds, sixths and sevenths” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: C 向上到 A 是……

items.source: C to A spans nine half steps.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-4 “Seconds, sixths and sevenths” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: C 到 A 跨九個半音。

items.source: C up to B♭ is a...
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-4 “Seconds, sixths and sevenths” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: C 向上到 B♭ 是……

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-4 “Seconds, sixths and sevenths” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-4 “Seconds, sixths and sevenths” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: C to B♭ spans ten half steps.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-4 “Seconds, sixths and sevenths” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: C 到 B♭ 跨十個半音。

items.source: E to F is a single half step.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-4 “Seconds, sixths and sevenths” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: E 到 F 只有一個半音。

items.source: One half step short of an octave.

items.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-4 “Seconds, sixths and sevenths” · step 8 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: E 向上到 C 是……

items.source: E, F, G, A, B, C makes a sixth. It spans eight half steps, so it's minor.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-4 “Seconds, sixths and sevenths” · step 8 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: E、F、G、A、B、C 組成六度。相隔八個半音，所以是小六度。

Music Theory · Unit 6 · challenge thy-6-5 “Intervals challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Count letters for the number. Count half steps for the size. Together they name any interval.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · challenge thy-6-5 “Intervals challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 數字母決定度數，數半音決定大小。兩者一起，就能命名音程。

items.source: F up to A is a...
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · challenge thy-6-5 “Intervals challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: F 向上到 A 是……

items.source: F, G, A is a third, and four half steps makes it major.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · challenge thy-6-5 “Intervals challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: F、G、A 是三度，四個半音使它成為大三度。

items.source: D up to A is a...
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · challenge thy-6-5 “Intervals challenge” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: D 向上到 A 是……

items.source: D to A spans seven half steps.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · challenge thy-6-5 “Intervals challenge” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: D 到 A 跨七個半音。

items.source: B up to D is a...
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · challenge thy-6-5 “Intervals challenge” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: B 向上到 D 是……

items.source: B, C, D is a third of three half steps: minor.
items.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · challenge thy-6-5 “Intervals challenge” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: B、C、D 是三個半音的三度：小三度。

items.source: How many half steps are in a major sixth?

Music Theory · Unit 6 · challenge thy-6-5 “Intervals challenge” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
