items.source: Back down from C to C. Keep each lower note bright so it doesn't sag flat.
items.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-3 “The major scale” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 從 C 往下回 C。每個較低的音仍保持明亮，避免下沉偏低。

items.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-3 “The major scale” · step 6 (along) · title
Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-4 “Five-note patterns” · title
Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-4 “Five-note patterns” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Short patterns like do-re-mi-re-do build accuracy fast. Sing one, then start it a step higher and let the scale guide you.
items.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-4 “Five-note patterns” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Do-re-mi-re-do 這類短音型能迅速建立準確度。唱一次，再從高一級的音開始，讓音階引導你。

items.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-4 “Five-note patterns” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-4 “Five-note patterns” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction
Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-4 “Five-note patterns” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-4 “Five-note patterns” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-4 “Five-note patterns” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer

items.source: Do up to sol and back: C to G to C.
items.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-4 “Five-note patterns” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Do 向上到 sol 再回來：C 到 G 再到 C。

items.source: Sing C-D-E-D-C, then the same shape one step higher. What's the top note now?
items.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-4 “Five-note patterns” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 先唱 C-D-E-D-C，再把同一音型提高一級。現在最高音是什麼？

items.source: One step higher, the shape becomes D, E, F, E, D.
items.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-4 “Five-note patterns” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 提高一級後，音型是 D、E、F、E、D。

items.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-4 “Five-note patterns” · step 6 (along) · title
Singing · Unit 3 · challenge voc-3-5 “Scale check” · title

items.source: Breathe low before each scale, keep the top light, and keep lower notes bright on the way down.
items.context: Singing · Unit 3 · challenge voc-3-5 “Scale check” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 每次音階前低位吸氣，高音保持輕盈，下行時低音保持明亮。

items.source: How many notes are in a major scale, do to do?
items.context: Singing · Unit 3 · challenge voc-3-5 “Scale check” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 大調音階從 do 到 do 有幾個音？

items.source: Do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, ti, do: eight notes, with do at both ends.
items.context: Singing · Unit 3 · challenge voc-3-5 “Scale check” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Singing · Unit 3 · challenge voc-3-5 “Scale check” · step 5 (listen) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 3 · challenge voc-3-5 “Scale check” · step 7 (along) · title
Singing · Unit 4 “Intervals you can sing” · title

items.source: Leap by thirds, fifths and octaves, and land in tune.
items.context: Singing · Unit 4 “Intervals you can sing” · unit summary
items.translation: 跳三度、五度與八度，準確落在音高上。

items.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-1 “Thirds” · title
Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-1 “Thirds” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: An interval is the distance between two notes. Skip one scale step and you get a third, like do to mi. Hear mi in your head before you leave do.
items.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-1 “Thirds” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 音程是兩個音之間的距離。跳過一級音階就是三度，例如 do 到 mi。離開 do 之前，先在腦海聽到 mi。

items.source: Do to mi and back: C, E, C.
items.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-1 “Thirds” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Do 到 mi 再回來：C、E、C。

items.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-1 “Thirds” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction
Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-1 “Thirds” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-1 “Thirds” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-1 “Thirds” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-1 “Thirds” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-1 “Thirds” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: C to E skips over D, so it spans three scale notes: a third.
items.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-1 “Thirds” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: C 到 E 跳過 D，包含三個音階音，所以是三度。

items.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-1 “Thirds” · step 6 (along) · title
Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-2 “Fifths” · title
Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-2 “Fifths” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Do to sol spans five scale notes, a fifth. It sounds open and strong. Picture the steps in between, then jump straight to sol.
items.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-2 “Fifths” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Do 到 sol 包含五個音階音，是五度，聽起來開闊有力。想像中間各級，再直接跳到 sol。

items.source: Do to sol and back: C, G, C.
items.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-2 “Fifths” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Do 到 sol 再回來：C、G、C。

items.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-2 “Fifths” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction

items.source: Do, mi, sol: two thirds stack up to a fifth.
items.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-2 “Fifths” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

items.source: Counting both ends, how many scale notes from do to sol?
items.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-2 “Fifths” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 兩端都算，do 到 sol 有幾個音階音？

items.source: Do, re, mi, fa, sol: five notes, so it's a fifth.
items.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-2 “Fifths” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-2 “Fifths” · step 7 (along) · title
Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-3 “The octave” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: An octave leaps from do to the next do, eight scale notes up. The two notes share a name and blend so well they almost sound like one.
items.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-3 “The octave” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 八度從 do 跳到下一個 do，向上包含八個音階音。兩者音名相同，融合得幾乎像同一個音。

items.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-3 “The octave” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction
Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-3 “The octave” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Before an octave leap, breathe low and keep your chin level. Think of the top note as light and easy, not a stretch upward.
items.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-3 “The octave” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 跳八度前，低位呼吸，下巴保持水平。把高音想成輕鬆輕盈的音，不是用力往上伸。

items.source: C, then G, then the high C. Use the G as a stepping stone.
items.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-3 “The octave” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: C，再 G，再高音 C。把 G 當作中途踏腳石。

items.source: Why do the two notes of an octave blend so well?
items.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-3 “The octave” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 為什麼八度的兩個音這麼融合？

items.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-3 “The octave” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: The top one vibrates twice as fast
items.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-3 “The octave” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: 因為上面的音振動速度是兩倍

items.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-3 “The octave” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: The top note vibrates exactly twice as fast as the bottom one, so their waves line up.
items.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-3 “The octave” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 上面的音振動速度正好是下面的兩倍，因此波形能對齊。

items.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-3 “The octave” · step 7 (along) · title
Singing · Unit 4 · challenge voc-4-4 “Leaps and landings” · title

items.source: Hear each leap in your head before you sing it. Land lightly on the top note, then step home.
items.context: Singing · Unit 4 · challenge voc-4-4 “Leaps and landings” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 每次跳進前，先在腦海聽見。輕盈落在高音上，再逐步回家。

items.context: Singing · Unit 4 · challenge voc-4-4 “Leaps and landings” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

items.source: High do, sol, mi, do: back down.
items.context: Singing · Unit 4 · challenge voc-4-4 “Leaps and landings” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

items.source: What is the interval from do to the next do?
items.context: Singing · Unit 4 · challenge voc-4-4 “Leaps and landings” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Do 到下一個 do 是什麼音程？

items.context: Singing · Unit 4 · challenge voc-4-4 “Leaps and landings” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 4 · challenge voc-4-4 “Leaps and landings” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Do to the next do spans eight scale notes: an octave.
items.context: Singing · Unit 4 · challenge voc-4-4 “Leaps and landings” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Do 到下一個 do 包含八個音階音：八度。

items.source: Five public-domain tunes, melody only, at an easy pace.
items.context: Singing · Unit 5 “Melodies” · unit summary
items.translation: 五首公有領域曲調，只唱旋律，速度輕鬆。

items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-1 “Twinkle Twinkle Little Star” · title
Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-1 “Twinkle Twinkle Little Star” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: This traditional melody leaps up, then steps back down home. Sing it on "loo" and give each repeated note a fresh start.
items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-1 “Twinkle Twinkle Little Star” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 這首傳統旋律先向上跳，再逐步回家。用「loo」唱，每個重複音都重新起音。

items.source: The opening leap: C up to G, step to A, back to G.
items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-1 “Twinkle Twinkle Little Star” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 開頭跳進：C 向上到 G，再級進到 A，回 G。

items.source: The middle phrase: does it go up or down?
items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-1 “Twinkle Twinkle Little Star” · step 4 (listen) · question or instruction
items.translation: 中間樂句往上還是往下？

items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-1 “Twinkle Twinkle Little Star” · step 5 (along) · title
Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: This melody from Beethoven's Ninth Symphony moves almost entirely by step. Keep it smooth and even, like walking up and down a staircase.
items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 這段出自貝多芬第九號交響曲的旋律，幾乎全以級進移動。保持平順均勻，像上下樓梯。

items.source: The five notes the tune lives on: F up to C.
items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 旋律使用的五個音：F 向上到 C。

items.source: The first phrase ends with a dotted note. How does it feel?
items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 第一樂句結尾有附點音符，感覺如何？

items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: The dotted note is held longer, then a short note leads into the last one.
items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 附點音延續較長，再用一個短音引到最後的音。

items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-3 “Auld Lang Syne” · title
Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-3 “Auld Lang Syne” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: This traditional Scottish melody starts with a pickup, a note before the first full bar. Sing it lightly, then lean on the next note.
items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-3 “Auld Lang Syne” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 這首傳統蘇格蘭旋律以弱起開始，也就是第一個完整小節之前的音。輕輕唱它，再強調下一個音。

items.source: The climb in the third bar: F, A, C, up to D.
items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-3 “Auld Lang Syne” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第三小節的上行：F、A、C，再上到 D。

items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-3 “Auld Lang Syne” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: The loudest note of a song
items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-3 “Auld Lang Syne” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-3 “Auld Lang Syne” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A note before the first full bar
items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-3 “Auld Lang Syne” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: 第一個完整小節之前的音

items.source: A pickup leads into beat 1 of the first full bar.
items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-3 “Auld Lang Syne” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 弱起引向第一個完整小節的第 1 拍。

items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-3 “Auld Lang Syne” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)

items.source: This American hymn tune from the early 1800s is in 3/4: count 1, 2, 3. Long notes often turn into a quick pair, so keep the pair light.
items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 這首美國聖詩曲調出自 1800 年起的世紀初期，採 3/4 拍：數 1、2、3。長音常接一對快音，快音要輕盈。

items.source: The quick turn: F, up to A, back to F.
items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 快速轉折：F，向上到 A，再回 F。

items.source: How many beats are in each bar of this hymn?
items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: It's in 3/4: three beats per bar, with the weight on 1.
items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 它是 3/4 拍，每小節三拍，重心在 1。

items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-5 “Shenandoah” · title
Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-5 “Shenandoah” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: This American folk song from the 1800s moves slowly, with wide leaps. Breathe at each rest, and hear every leap before you sing it.
items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-5 “Shenandoah” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 這首出自 1800 年起那個世紀的美國民謠速度慢、跳進大。每次休止換氣，每次跳進都先在腦海聽見再唱。

items.source: The opening leap: low G up to C. Any octave counts.
items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-5 “Shenandoah” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 開頭跳進：低音 G 向上到 C，任何八度都算。

items.source: The big leap: G up to high C, then step down.
items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-5 “Shenandoah” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 大跳進：G 向上到高音 C，再逐步下行。

items.source: Where should you breathe in this song?
items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-5 “Shenandoah” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-5 “Shenandoah” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Never; sing it in one breath
items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-5 “Shenandoah” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: 完全不換氣，一口氣唱完

items.source: The rests mark the ends of phrases. Breathe there so each line has full support.
items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-5 “Shenandoah” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 休止標示樂句結尾。在那裡換氣，讓每句都有充分支撐。

items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-5 “Shenandoah” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
Singing · Unit 5 · challenge voc-5-6 “Medley” · title

items.source: Five tunes back to back, one phrase each. Breathe at every rest, and give repeated notes a fresh start.
items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · challenge voc-5-6 “Medley” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 五首曲子接著唱，每首一個樂句。每次休止換氣，重複音重新起音。

items.source: Which of these songs is in 3/4?
items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · challenge voc-5-6 “Medley” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: Amazing Grace counts 1, 2, 3 in every bar.
items.context: Singing · Unit 5 · challenge voc-5-6 “Medley” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Singing · Unit 6 “Control” · title

items.source: Hold notes steady, shape loud and soft, and warm up well.
items.context: Singing · Unit 6 “Control” · unit summary
items.translation: 穩定延音、塑造強弱，並好好暖嗓。

items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · title
Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Pitch drifts when the air behind it changes. Keep a low, even breath and watch the note stay centered from start to finish.
items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 支撐聲音的氣息改變時，音高會飄移。保持低位、均勻的氣息，觀察音從頭到尾維持準確。

items.source: Hold G and keep it centered.
items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Notes often sag flat as your air runs out. Stop a little before you're empty, then take a fresh low breath.
items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 氣快用完時，音常會下沉偏低。在用盡前稍早結束，再重新低位吸氣。

items.source: Your long notes go flat at the end. What helps?
items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 長音結尾偏低，什麼有幫助？

items.source: End the note sooner and breathe
items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Pitch sags when you run low on air. Ending a bit early keeps the whole note in tune.
items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 氣不足時音高容易下沉。稍早結束，能讓整個音維持準確。

items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · step 5 (along) · title
Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · step 6 (along) · title
Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · title

items.source: Vibrato is a gentle, regular wave in pitch, around five to seven times a second. It grows out of a relaxed throat and steady breath, not out of shaking.
items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 歌唱顫音是溫和、規律的音高波動，每秒約五到七次。它來自放鬆的喉嚨與穩定氣息，不是刻意搖動。

items.source: Where does healthy vibrato come from?
items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A relaxed throat and steady breath
items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: 放鬆的喉嚨與穩定氣息

items.source: Vibrato appears when the voice is free and supported. Forcing it from the jaw or belly makes a wobble.
items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 聲音自由且有支撐時，顫音會出現。用下顎或腹部硬做，反而造成晃動。

items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Learn to hold a straight, steady note before you chase vibrato. When your voice is relaxed and supported, vibrato often appears on its own.
items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 追求顫音之前，先學會維持平直、穩定的音。聲音放鬆且有支撐時，顫音往往自然出現。

items.source: A straight, steady A. No wave, just a clear line.
items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 平直、穩定的 A。沒有波動，只有清晰的直線。

items.source: What's the best first goal for a new singer?
items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 初學歌唱，最好的第一個目標是什麼？

items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A steady tone is the foundation. Vibrato that grows from it sounds natural.
items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 穩定音是基礎，從中自然生出的顫音才好聽。

items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 6 (along) · title
Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-3 “Loud and soft” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Dynamics are how loud or soft you sing. Get louder with more breath energy, not by squeezing your throat. The pitch should stay put.
items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-3 “Loud and soft” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 力度是歌唱的強弱。用更多氣息能量增加音量，不要擠喉嚨。音高應保持不變。

items.source: Sing E softly, then louder on the same pitch.
items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-3 “Loud and soft” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 輕唱 E，再在同一音高唱響一點。

items.source: As you get louder, what can happen to pitch?
items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-3 “Loud and soft” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 音量變大時，音高可能怎樣？

items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-3 “Loud and soft” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-3 “Loud and soft” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-3 “Loud and soft” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Extra push tends to raise the pitch, and very soft notes can sag flat. Watch the note either way.
items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-3 “Loud and soft” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 額外用力容易讓音高升高，太輕的音可能下沉偏低。兩種情況都要留意音高。

items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-3 “Loud and soft” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: A swell grows from soft to louder and back on one breath. Start quietly, grow gently, then fade, all on the same pitch.
items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-3 “Loud and soft” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 一次呼吸中，聲音從輕變響再變輕。輕聲開始，溫和增強，再減弱，全程同一音高。

items.source: Swell on G: soft, louder, soft. Keep it centered.
items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-3 “Loud and soft” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 在 G 上漸強漸弱：輕、響、輕。保持準確。

items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-3 “Loud and soft” · step 6 (along) · title
Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-4 “Your warm-up routine” · title
Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-4 “Your warm-up routine” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: A short warm-up eases your voice in: breathe low, hum, lip trill, then sing a scale. Start in the middle of your range and stay comfortable.
items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-4 “Your warm-up routine” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 短暫暖嗓讓聲音漸入狀態：低位呼吸、哼鳴、唇顫音，再唱音階。從音域中段開始，保持舒服。

items.source: Your voice feels tired after practice. What's best?
items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-4 “Your warm-up routine” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 練習後聲音疲累，最好怎麼做？

items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-4 “Your warm-up routine” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-4 “Your warm-up routine” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Rest helps a tired voice recover. If hoarseness lingers for a few weeks, check with a doctor.
items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-4 “Your warm-up routine” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 休息能幫疲累的聲音恢復。如果沙啞持續幾週，請向醫師諮詢。

items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · challenge voc-6-5 “Control check” · title

items.source: Warm up first. Then hold each note steady, shape it soft and loud, and breathe before you run out.
items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · challenge voc-6-5 “Control check” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 先暖嗓，再穩定延續每個音，塑造強弱，氣用盡前換氣。

items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · challenge voc-6-5 “Control check” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Singing · Unit 6 · challenge voc-6-5 “Control check” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 6 · challenge voc-6-5 “Control check” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 6 · challenge voc-6-5 “Control check” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Vibrato is a gentle, even wave around the note, a few times a second.
items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · challenge voc-6-5 “Control check” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 顫音是在音高周圍溫和、均勻的波動，每秒幾次。

items.source: To sing louder, what do you add?
items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · challenge voc-6-5 “Control check” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 想唱響一點，應增加什麼？

items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · challenge voc-6-5 “Control check” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 6 · challenge voc-6-5 “Control check” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 6 · challenge voc-6-5 “Control check” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Breath energy makes a bigger sound without strain.
items.context: Singing · Unit 6 · challenge voc-6-5 “Control check” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 氣息能量讓聲音更大，而不吃力。

items.source: Play the melody, or strum the chords and sing
items.context: Songs course · course subtitle
items.translation: 彈旋律，或刷和弦並歌唱

items.context: Songs · Unit 1 “First songs” · title

items.source: Six famous tunes, one note at a time, on the top strings. Slow tempos, big wins.
items.context: Songs · Unit 1 “First songs” · unit summary
items.translation: 六首著名旋律，在高音弦上逐音彈。慢速練習，收穫滿滿。

items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-mary “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: In 1877, Thomas Edison recited this rhyme to test his new phonograph. The tune uses C and D on string 2, then open E, and G at fret 3 on string 1.
items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-mary “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 1877 年，Thomas Edison 朗誦這首童謠來測試新留聲機。旋律使用第 2 弦的 C、D，再接 E 空弦與第 1 弦第 3 品的 G。

items.source: E D C D E E E: open string 1, then string 2 at frets 3 and 1, and back.
items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-mary “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: E D C D E E E：第 1 弦空弦，再彈第 2 弦第 3、1 品，然後回來。

items.source: D D D at fret 3 on string 2. Then open E, and G at fret 3 on string 1.
items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-mary “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第 2 弦第 3 品的 D D D，再彈 E 空弦和第 1 弦第 3 品的 G。

items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-twinkle “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: This melody was first printed in France in 1761, and Mozart later wrote twelve variations on it. It leaps up, then steps down across strings 2 and 3.
items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-twinkle “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 這段旋律於 1761 年首次在法國出版，莫札特後來為它寫了十二段變奏。它先上跳，再跨第 2、3 弦逐步下降。

items.source: Open G, a leap up to D at fret 3 on string 2, open E, and back to D.
items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-twinkle “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: G 空弦，向上跳到第 2 弦第 3 品的 D，再 E 空弦，回 D。

items.source: Step down in pairs: C at fret 1, open B, A at fret 2 on string 3, open G.
items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-twinkle “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 成對向下級進：第 1 品的 C、B 空弦、第 3 弦第 2 品的 A、G 空弦。

items.source: Which other song uses this same tune?
items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-twinkle “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 還有哪首歌使用同一旋律？

items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-twinkle “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Songs · Unit 1 · song song-twinkle “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Songs · Unit 1 · song song-twinkle “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: The alphabet song and Baa, Baa, Black Sheep both borrow this French melody.
items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-twinkle “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 《字母歌》和《咩咩黑羊》都借用這段法國旋律。

items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-twinkle “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 5 (along) · title
Songs · Unit 1 · song song-ode-to-joy “Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Beethoven finished his Ninth Symphony in 1824, and this melody is now the anthem of the European Union. Here you'll play the whole tune, middle section included.
items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-ode-to-joy “Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 貝多芬於 1824 年完成第九號交響曲，這段旋律如今也是歐盟盟歌。這裡演奏完整曲調，包括中段。

items.source: The opening: E E F G G F E D, one step at a time.
items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-ode-to-joy “Ode to Joy” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 開頭：E E F G G F E D，一步一步移動。

items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-ode-to-joy “Ode to Joy” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: In the middle section, E and F share a single beat. Count one, two-and, three, four, and play E on two and F on the and.
items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-ode-to-joy “Ode to Joy” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 中段裡，E 和 F 共用一拍。數一、二又、三、四，在二彈 E，在「又」彈 F。

items.source: The middle: quick E F pairs on string 1, then down to open G on string 3.
items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-ode-to-joy “Ode to Joy” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 中段：第 1 弦快速的 E F 音組，再下降到第 3 弦 G 空弦。

items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-ode-to-joy “Ode to Joy” · step 6 (along) · title
Songs · Unit 1 · song song-frere-jacques “Frère Jacques” · title
Songs · Unit 1 · song song-frere-jacques “Frère Jacques” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Frère Jacques is a French round, first printed around 1780: a second player starts the same tune two bars later, and the parts fit together.
items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-frere-jacques “Frère Jacques” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 《雅克弟兄》是法國輪唱曲，約於 1780 年首次出版：第二位演奏者晚兩小節開始同一旋律，聲部就能互相配合。

items.source: In a round, the second player…
items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-frere-jacques “Frère Jacques” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
Songs · Unit 1 · song song-frere-jacques “Frère Jacques” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Songs · Unit 1 · song song-frere-jacques “Frère Jacques” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Songs · Unit 1 · song song-frere-jacques “Frère Jacques” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Everyone plays the same melody, each starting a little later. The phrases are built to fit on top of each other.
items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-frere-jacques “Frère Jacques” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 每人都演奏同一旋律，各自稍晚開始。樂句設計成可以彼此疊合。

items.source: The quick part: D E D C on strings 2 and 1, then B and G.
items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-frere-jacques “Frère Jacques” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 快速段：第 2、1 弦的 D E D C，再 B 和 G。

items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-frere-jacques “Frère Jacques” · step 4 (along) · title

items.source: The ending dips from open G to open D on string 4, then comes back.
items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-frere-jacques “Frère Jacques” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 結尾從 G 空弦降到第 4 弦 D 空弦，再回來。

items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-frere-jacques “Frère Jacques” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
Songs · Unit 1 · song song-jingle-bells “Jingle Bells” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: James Lord Pierpont published this song in 1857 as One Horse Open Sleigh. You'll play its famous chorus, all on strings 1 and 2.
items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-jingle-bells “Jingle Bells” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: James Lord Pierpont 在 1857 年以《單馬敞篷雪橇》為題出版這首歌。你將演奏著名副歌，全在第 1、2 弦上。

items.source: Open E, G at fret 3, down to C and D on string 2, then home to E.
items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-jingle-bells “Jingle Bells” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: E 空弦、第 3 品的 G，向下到第 2 弦的 C、D，再回 E。

items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-jingle-bells “Jingle Bells” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: In that phrase, C rings for a beat and a half and D slips in on the and of four. Count one, two, three, four-and.
items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-jingle-bells “Jingle Bells” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 這個樂句中，C 持續一拍半，D 在第四拍的「又」進入。數一、二、三、四又。

items.source: The second line sits on F at fret 1, then settles onto open E.
items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-jingle-bells “Jingle Bells” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第二句停留在第 1 品的 F，再落回 E 空弦。

items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-jingle-bells “Jingle Bells” · arrangement · song section label (Intro, Verse 1 …) on a small chip
Songs · Unit 1 · song song-jingle-bells “Jingle Bells” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)

items.source: This traditional spiritual became a jazz standard after Louis Armstrong recorded it in 1938. It uses C, D, E, F and G on strings 2 and 1.
items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-saints “When the Saints Go Marching In” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 這首傳統靈歌在 Louis Armstrong 於 1938 年錄製後，成為爵士標準曲。它使用第 2、1 弦的 C、D、E、F、G。

items.source: The opening: C on string 2, then E, F and G climbing string 1.
items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-saints “When the Saints Go Marching In” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 開頭：第 2 弦的 C，再沿第 1 弦上行 E、F、G。

items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · challenge song-medley-first-songs “First songs medley” · title
Songs · Unit 1 · challenge song-medley-first-songs “First songs medley” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: No new notes here: all six tunes from this unit, each a little faster than before. Name the opening by ear, then play.
items.context: Songs · Unit 1 · challenge song-medley-first-songs “First songs medley” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 沒有新音：這個單元的六首旋律，每首比之前稍快。先用耳朵辨認開頭，再演奏。

items.context: Songs · Unit 2 “Folk favorites” · title

items.source: Campfire songs and a sea song, with easy chords to strum on the simplest ones.
items.context: Songs · Unit 2 “Folk favorites” · unit summary
items.translation: 營火歌曲與一首海上歌謠，最簡單的曲子可用輕鬆和弦刷弦。

items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-oh-susanna “Oh! Susanna” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Stephen Foster published this song in 1848, and gold seekers heading to California made it their anthem. The verse sits on strings 3, 2 and 1.
items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-oh-susanna “Oh! Susanna” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Stephen Foster 在 1848 年出版這首歌，前往加州的淘金者把它當作代表歌曲。主歌使用第 3、2、1 弦。

items.source: Open B, D at fret 3, open E, then back down to open G and A at fret 2.
items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-oh-susanna “Oh! Susanna” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: B 空弦、第 3 品的 D、E 空弦，再下到 G 空弦與第 2 品的 A。

items.source: The last bar: B B A A, then home to open G.
items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-oh-susanna “Oh! Susanna” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 最後一小節：B B A A，再回 G 空弦。

items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-oh-susanna “Oh! Susanna” · step 6 (explain) · title

items.source: G sounds like home, and D7 pulls back toward it. The verse is three bars of G, one of D7, two of G, then D7 and G.
items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-oh-susanna “Oh! Susanna” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: G 像家，D7 則引回它。主歌是三小節 G、一小節 D7、兩小節 G，再 D7 與 G。

items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-camptown-races “Camptown Races” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Stephen Foster wrote this racing song in 1850, two years after Oh! Susanna. It uses the same notes and the same two chords.
items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-camptown-races “Camptown Races” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Stephen Foster 在 1850 年寫下這首賽馬歌，比《噢！蘇珊娜》晚兩年。它使用相同音符與相同兩個和弦。

items.source: D D B D, up to open E, then D and B. Strings 2 and 1.
items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-camptown-races “Camptown Races” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: D D B D，上到 E 空弦，再 D 和 B。使用第 2、1 弦。

items.source: Twice in the first line, a quick B leads into an A that rings for three beats. Pick the A once and let it ring.
items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-camptown-races “Camptown Races” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 第一句有兩次，快速的 B 引入持續三拍的 A。A 只撥一次，讓它延續。

items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-old-macdonald “Old MacDonald Had a Farm” · title
Songs · Unit 2 · song song-old-macdonald “Old MacDonald Had a Farm” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: This farmyard song was first printed in 1917, but people sang versions of it long before. Its tune reaches down to D and E on string 4.
items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-old-macdonald “Old MacDonald Had a Farm” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 這首農場歌於 1917 年首次出版，但人們早已傳唱不同版本。旋律向下延伸到第 4 弦的 D 和 E。

items.source: Open G three times, down to open D, E at fret 2 on string 4, back to D.
items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-old-macdonald “Old MacDonald Had a Farm” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: G 空弦三次，下到 D 空弦、第 4 弦第 2 品的 E，再回 D。

items.source: Then up: open B twice, A at fret 2 on string 3, and home to open G.
items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-old-macdonald “Old MacDonald Had a Farm” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 再向上：B 空弦兩次、第 3 弦第 2 品的 A，回到 G 空弦。

items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-old-macdonald “Old MacDonald Had a Farm” · step 6 (explain) · title

items.source: Here each chord lasts two beats, so the strum counts one, two. The order is G, G, C, G, then G, D7, G, G. Change early.
items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-old-macdonald “Old MacDonald Had a Farm” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 這裡每個和弦持續兩拍，所以刷弦數一、二。順序是 G、G、C、G，再 G、D7、G、G。提早準備換和弦。

items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-old-macdonald “Old MacDonald Had a Farm” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
Songs · Unit 2 · song song-yankee-doodle “Yankee Doodle” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: British soldiers first sang this tune to mock American colonists. By the end of the Revolution, the Americans had made it their own.
items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-yankee-doodle “Yankee Doodle” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 英軍起初唱這首曲子嘲笑美洲殖民者。到了革命結束時，美國人已把它變成自己的歌。

items.source: C C D E, C E D, then a drop to open G on string 3.
items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-yankee-doodle “Yankee Doodle” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: C C D E，C E D，再降到第 3 弦 G 空弦。

items.source: The first half ends on B. How does that feel?
items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-yankee-doodle “Yankee Doodle” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 前半段在 B 結束，感覺如何？

items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-yankee-doodle “Yankee Doodle” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: B sits just below C and leans toward it. The second half answers by landing on C.
items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-yankee-doodle “Yankee Doodle” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: B 在 C 正下方，傾向 C。後半段落在 C 作出回答。

items.source: The last line: down from F on string 1, dip to open G, then climb back to C.
items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-yankee-doodle “Yankee Doodle” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 最後一句：從第 1 弦 F 向下，降到 G 空弦，再上到 C。

items.source: The chorus sits low: A at fret 2 on string 3, open B, then F and E on string 4 and C on string 5.
items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-yankee-doodle “Yankee Doodle” · step 7 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 副歌位置較低：第 3 弦第 2 品的 A、B 空弦，再第 4 弦的 F、E 與第 5 弦的 C。

items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-yankee-doodle “Yankee Doodle” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
Songs · Unit 2 · song song-aura-lee “Aura Lee” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: George Poulton published this ballad in 1861. Nearly a century later, its melody became the tune of Love Me Tender.
items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-aura-lee “Aura Lee” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: George Poulton 在 1861 年出版這首抒情歌。近一世紀後，旋律成為《溫柔地愛我》的曲調。

items.source: Up to C, down to open B and back, then D, a dip to A, and D again.
items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-aura-lee “Aura Lee” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 上到 C，下到 B 空弦再回來，接著 D、降到 A，再回 D。

items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-aura-lee “Aura Lee” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: Aura Lee is a slow ballad. Keep each finger down until the next note sounds, so the notes join smoothly.
items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-aura-lee “Aura Lee” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 《奧拉莉》是慢板抒情歌。每根手指保持按住直到下一音響起，讓音符平順連接。

items.source: The high part: open E, F at fret 1, then down to D, A, and D again.
items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-aura-lee “Aura Lee” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 高音段：E 空弦、第 1 品的 F，再下到 D、A，再回 D。

items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-aura-lee “Aura Lee” · step 6 (along) · title
Songs · Unit 2 · song song-bobby-shafto “Bobby Shafto” · title
Songs · Unit 2 · song song-bobby-shafto “Bobby Shafto” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: This song from the north of England is about Bobby Shafto, gone to sea. Its words were in print by 1805, and fiddlers played its tune for dances by 1770.
items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-bobby-shafto “Bobby Shafto” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 這首英格蘭北部歌曲講述出海的 Bobby Shafto。歌詞至遲在 1805 年已出版，旋律則至遲在 1770 年已由小提琴樂手用於舞會。

items.source: Open B, D at fret 3, back to B and open G, then B, D and B again.
items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-bobby-shafto “Bobby Shafto” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: B 空弦、第 3 品的 D，回 B 與 G 空弦，再 B、D、B。

items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-bobby-shafto “Bobby Shafto” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: The second line dips to F sharp: string 4, fret 4, with your little finger. Keep your hand over the first four frets so it's ready.
items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-bobby-shafto “Bobby Shafto” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 第二句下到升 F：第 4 弦第 4 品，用小指。手保持覆蓋前四品，隨時準備。

items.source: A at fret 2 on string 3, C at fret 1 on string 2, A, down to F sharp, and back up.
items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-bobby-shafto “Bobby Shafto” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第 3 弦第 2 品的 A、第 2 弦第 1 品的 C、A，下到升 F，再向上回來。

items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-bobby-shafto “Bobby Shafto” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: The first three lines end the same way: two notes of one beat, then one of two beats. Gone to sea, on his knee, marry me.
items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-bobby-shafto “Bobby Shafto” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 前三句結尾相同：兩個一拍的音，再接一個兩拍的音。Gone to sea、on his knee、marry me。

items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-bobby-shafto “Bobby Shafto” · step 9 (explain) · title
items.translation: 再次使用 G 與 D7

items.source: The verse needs only the two chords from Oh! Susanna: two bars of G, two of D7, two of G, then D7 and G.
items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-bobby-shafto “Bobby Shafto” · step 9 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 主歌只需《噢！蘇珊娜》的兩個和弦：兩小節 G、兩小節 D7、兩小節 G，再 D7 與 G。

items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · song song-bobby-shafto “Bobby Shafto” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
Songs · Unit 2 · challenge song-medley-folk “Folk medley” · title
Songs · Unit 2 · challenge song-medley-folk “Folk medley” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: No new notes or chords: all six songs from this unit, one after another, each a little faster than before.
items.context: Songs · Unit 2 · challenge song-medley-folk “Folk medley” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 沒有新音或新和弦：這單元六首歌依次演奏，每首比之前稍快。

items.context: Songs · Unit 3 “Classical themes I” · title

items.source: Famous themes by Pachelbel, Dvořák, Brahms, Petzold, Grieg and Beethoven, in first position.
items.context: Songs · Unit 3 “Classical themes I” · unit summary
items.translation: 帕海貝爾、德弗札克、布拉姆斯、佩措爾德、葛利格與貝多芬的著名主題，使用第一把位。

items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · title
Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Johann Pachelbel wrote this canon over 300 years ago. Its bass repeats the same eight notes the whole way through while violins weave melodies above.
items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Johann Pachelbel 在 300 多年前寫下這首卡農。低音從頭到尾重複相同八個音，小提琴在上方交織旋律。

items.source: The bass, moved up an octave: D, A, B, F sharp, G, D, G, A.
items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

items.source: What does the bass do all through the Canon?
items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 卡農的低音全程做什麼？

items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Plays a new tune each time
items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A repeating bass like this is called a ground. Everything else in the piece is built on top of it.
items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 這種反覆低音稱為固定低音。曲中的其他聲部都建立在它上方。

items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 4 (along) · title
Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: A sharp is one fret above its letter. The melody uses C sharp on string 2, fret 2, and F sharp on string 4, fret 4. Reach that one with your little finger.
items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 升音比原音名高一品。旋律使用第 2 弦第 2 品的升 C，以及第 4 弦第 4 品的升 F。後者用小指伸到。

items.source: The first violin line: down from F sharp on string 1, then back up to C sharp.
items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第一小提琴旋律：從第 1 弦升 F 向下，再上到升 C。

items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · step 7 (along) · title
Songs · Unit 3 · song song-canon-in-d “Canon in D” · arrangement · song section label (Intro, Verse 1 …) on a small chip
Songs · Unit 3 · song song-largo “Largo, New World Symphony” · title
Songs · Unit 3 · song song-largo “Largo, New World Symphony” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Antonín Dvořák wrote this theme for English horn in 1893, in his Symphony From the New World, while he was living in New York.
items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-largo “Largo, New World Symphony” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Antonín Dvořák 旅居紐約時，在 1893 年為《新世界交響曲》的英國管寫下這個主題。

items.source: Open E, G at fret 3 on string 1, back to E, then D and C on string 2.
items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-largo “Largo, New World Symphony” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: E 空弦、第 1 弦第 3 品的 G，回 E，再第 2 弦的 D、C。

items.source: Most bars open with a long note and a quick one. Count one, two-and, three: the quick note lands on the and of two.
items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-largo “Largo, New World Symphony” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 多數小節以一個長音和一個快音開始。數一、二又、三：快音落在二的「又」。

items.source: The ending: D, E, D, then settle on C and let it ring.
items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-largo “Largo, New World Symphony” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 結尾：D、E、D，再落到 C，讓它延續。

items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-largo “Largo, New World Symphony” · step 7 (along) · title
Songs · Unit 3 · song song-largo “Largo, New World Symphony” · arrangement · song section label (Intro, Verse 1 …) on a small chip
Songs · Unit 3 · song song-brahms-lullaby “Brahms' Lullaby” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Johannes Brahms wrote this lullaby in 1868 for a friend's newborn son. It sways in three, like a cradle: a long note, then two quick ones.
items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-brahms-lullaby “Brahms' Lullaby” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Johannes Brahms 在 1868 年為朋友剛出生的兒子寫下這首搖籃曲。它像搖籃般以三拍擺動：一個長音，再兩個快音。

items.source: The opening rocks between open B and D at fret 3 on string 2.
items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-brahms-lullaby “Brahms' Lullaby” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 開頭在 B 空弦與第 2 弦第 3 品的 D 之間擺動。

items.source: Open G on string 3, then the same note an octave higher: G at fret 3 on string 1.
items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-brahms-lullaby “Brahms' Lullaby” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第 3 弦 G 空弦，再彈高八度的同音：第 1 弦第 3 品的 G。

items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-minuet-in-g “Minuet in G” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: This minuet appears in a 1725 notebook Bach gave his wife, Anna Magdalena. Scholars now credit it to his fellow composer Christian Petzold.
items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-minuet-in-g “Minuet in G” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 這首小步舞曲出現在巴赫於 1725 年送給妻子 Anna Magdalena 的樂譜本。學者如今認為作者是同代作曲家 Christian Petzold。

items.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, then climb from open G: A, B, C, D. Then two open Gs.
items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-minuet-in-g “Minuet in G” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第 2 弦第 3 品的 D，再從 G 空弦上行：A、B、C、D，接兩次 G 空弦。

items.source: A minuet is a dance in three. Most bars start with a long beat, then quick pairs: one, two-and, three-and.
items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-minuet-in-g “Minuet in G” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 小步舞曲是三拍舞曲。多數小節先一個長拍，再快音成對：一、二又、三又。

items.source: Open E, back to C and D on string 2, then E, F sharp and G on string 1.
items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-minuet-in-g “Minuet in G” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: E 空弦，回第 2 弦的 C、D，再第 1 弦的 E、升 F、G。

items.source: The ending: A B A G, then F sharp at fret 4 on string 4, and home to G.
items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-minuet-in-g “Minuet in G” · step 7 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 結尾：A B A G，再第 4 弦第 4 品的升 F，回 G。

items.source: The second section starts low: open B, A, open D, then C sharp at fret 4 and B at fret 2 on string 5, and open A.
items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-minuet-in-g “Minuet in G” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第二段從低音開始：B 空弦、A、D 空弦，再第 5 弦第 4 品的升 C、第 2 品的 B，以及 A 空弦。

items.source: In the Hall of the Mountain King
items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-mountain-king “In the Hall of the Mountain King” · title
Songs · Unit 3 · song song-mountain-king “In the Hall of the Mountain King” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Grieg wrote this for the play Peer Gynt in 1875. It pictures trolls in their king's hall, and it starts quietly and keeps speeding up.
items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-mountain-king “In the Hall of the Mountain King” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 葛利格在 1875 年為戲劇《皮爾金》寫下這首曲子，描繪山怪在王的殿堂中。它輕聲開始，逐漸加速。

items.source: Climb from open string 6: F sharp at fret 2, G at fret 3, open A, B at fret 2.
items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-mountain-king “In the Hall of the Mountain King” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 從第 6 弦空弦上行：第 2 品升 F、第 3 品 G、A 空弦、第 2 品 B。

items.source: The creeping part: A sharp at fret 1 on string 5, then open A with F at fret 1 on string 6.
items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-mountain-king “In the Hall of the Mountain King” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 潛行段：第 5 弦第 1 品升 A，再彈 A 空弦與第 6 弦第 1 品 F。

items.source: Where is A sharp on string 5?
items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-mountain-king “In the Hall of the Mountain King” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 第 5 弦的升 A 在哪裡？

items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-mountain-king “In the Hall of the Mountain King” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A sharp is one fret above A, and A is open string 5. So A sharp is fret 1.
items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-mountain-king “In the Hall of the Mountain King” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 升 A 比 A 高一品，A 是第 5 弦空弦，所以升 A 在第 1 品。

items.context: Songs · Unit 3 · song song-mountain-king “In the Hall of the Mountain King” · step 5 (along) · title
Songs · Unit 3 · song song-mountain-king “In the Hall of the Mountain King” · step 6 (along) · title

Songs · Unit 3 · song song-mountain-king “In the Hall of the Mountain King” · step 8 (along) · title
