items.source: A power chord is a root and its fifth, with no third, so it is neither major nor minor.
items.context: Originals · Unit 7 · challenge orig-power-chord-set “Power-chord set” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 強力和弦只有根音與五音，沒有三音，因此既不是大和弦，也不是小和弦。

items.context: Originals · Unit 8 “Story songs and slow burners” · title

items.source: A ballad, a sea story in 6/8, a music-box waltz, a bright folk strummer and a dark song in A minor.
items.context: Originals · Unit 8 “Story songs and slow burners” · unit summary
items.translation: 抒情歌、6/8 海上故事、音樂盒圓舞曲、明亮民謠刷弦，以及 A 小調暗色歌曲。

items.context: Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-letters-in-a-shoebox “Letters in a Shoebox” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Letters in a Shoebox tells a story in C at 72 beats per minute. The verse walks C, G, A minor, E minor, F, C, F and G, a chain of chords that has carried ballads for centuries.
items.context: Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-letters-in-a-shoebox “Letters in a Shoebox” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 《鞋盒裡的信》以 C 調、每分鐘 72 拍說故事。主歌走 C、G、A 小和弦、E 小和弦、F、C、F、G，這串和弦支撐抒情歌已有數百年。

items.source: C at fret 1 on string 2, D at fret 3, open E, F at fret 1 on string 1, G at fret 3, then D again.
items.context: Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-letters-in-a-shoebox “Letters in a Shoebox” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第 2 弦第 1 品 C、第 3 品 D、E 空弦、第 1 弦第 1 品 F、第 3 品 G，再 D。

items.context: Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-keepers-daughter “Keeper's Daughter” · title
Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-keepers-daughter “Keeper's Daughter” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Keeper's Daughter is a story song in 6/8 at 120 counts a minute: E minor, D, C and B7. Three verses tell the story, and the chorus answers each one.
items.context: Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-keepers-daughter “Keeper's Daughter” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 《守塔人的女兒》是 6/8 故事歌，每分鐘 120 下：E 小和弦、D、C、B7。三段主歌敘述故事，副歌回應每段。

items.source: Open B, open E, G at fret 3 on string 1, open E, then C at fret 1 on string 2, E and C.
items.context: Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-keepers-daughter “Keeper's Daughter” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: B 空弦、E 空弦、第 1 弦第 3 品 G、E 空弦，再第 2 弦第 1 品 C、E、C。

items.context: Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-snow-globe-town “Snow Globe Town” · title
Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-snow-globe-town “Snow Globe Town” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Snow Globe Town is a quick waltz in G at 120 beats per minute, like a music box: one strong beat, two light ones. G, D, E minor and C, with B7 in the bridge.
items.context: Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-snow-globe-town “Snow Globe Town” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 《雪花球小鎮》是 G 調快圓舞曲，每分鐘 120 拍，像音樂盒：一強兩弱。使用 G、D、E 小和弦、C，橋段加入 B7。

items.source: Open E, D at fret 3 on string 2, C at fret 1, D, C, then open B: a slow fall, like snow.
items.context: Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-snow-globe-town “Snow Globe Town” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: E 空弦、第 2 弦第 3 品 D、第 1 品 C、D、C，再 B 空弦：像雪緩緩飄落。

items.context: Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-thistle-and-thread “Thistle and Thread” · title
Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-thistle-and-thread “Thistle and Thread” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Thistle and Thread is a bright folk strummer in A at 116 beats per minute. Asus4 and Asus2 decorate the A chord: change one finger and the chord sparkles.
items.context: Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-thistle-and-thread “Thistle and Thread” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 《薊花與線》是 A 調明亮民謠刷弦曲，每分鐘 116 拍。Asus4 與 Asus2 裝飾 A 和弦：改一根手指，和弦就閃亮。

items.context: Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-thistle-and-thread “Thistle and Thread” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: From A, put finger 4 on string 2, fret 3 for Asus4. Lift the finger off string 2 and let it ring open for Asus2. Both fall back to A.
items.context: Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-thistle-and-thread “Thistle and Thread” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 從 A 開始，第 4 指按第 2 弦第 3 品是 Asus4。抬起第 2 弦上的手指，讓它空弦鳴響，就是 Asus2。兩者都回到 A。

items.source: F sharp at fret 2 on string 1, open E, D at fret 3 on string 2, E twice, C sharp, open B, then A.
items.context: Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-thistle-and-thread “Thistle and Thread” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第 1 弦第 2 品升 F、E 空弦、第 2 弦第 3 品 D、E 兩次、升 C、B 空弦，再 A。

items.context: Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-ghost-light “Ghost Light” · title
Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-ghost-light “Ghost Light” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Ghost Light is a slow, dark ballad in A minor at 70 beats per minute. The verse sinks from A minor through F and C to E major, which pulls hard back to A minor.
items.context: Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-ghost-light “Ghost Light” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 《幽光》是 A 小調的慢速暗色抒情歌，每分鐘 70 拍。主歌從 A 小和弦經 F、C 沉到 E 大和弦，再強烈引回 A 小和弦。

items.source: E major in A minor brings one new note. Which?
items.context: Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-ghost-light “Ghost Light” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: A 小調中的 E 大和弦帶來哪個新音？

items.source: A minor's own notes have G. E major needs G sharp, a half step under A, so it leans hard toward home.
items.context: Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-ghost-light “Ghost Light” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: A 小調本來有 G。E 大和弦需要升 G，比 A 低半音，因此強烈引向歸宿。

items.source: F at fret 1 on string 1, open E, G at fret 3, then D at fret 3 on string 2. Hold each long.
items.context: Originals · Unit 8 · song orig-ghost-light “Ghost Light” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第 1 弦第 1 品 F、E 空弦、第 3 品 G，再第 2 弦第 3 品 D。每個音都延長。

items.context: Originals · Unit 8 · challenge orig-story-set “Story-song set” · title

items.source: How many beats fill a bar of 3/4?
items.context: Originals · Unit 8 · challenge orig-story-set “Story-song set” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: 3/4 counts one, two, three, with the weight on one: the waltz.
items.context: Originals · Unit 8 · challenge orig-story-set “Story-song set” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 3/4 數一、二、三，重心在一，就是圓舞曲。

items.context: Originals · Unit 9 “Barres and big finishes” · title

items.source: Indie pop, a power ballad, highlife, neo-soul and an anthem with a key change, with F and B minor barres.
items.context: Originals · Unit 9 “Barres and big finishes” · unit summary
items.translation: 獨立流行、搖滾抒情曲、Highlife、新靈魂樂與轉調頌歌，搭配 F 和 B 小和弦橫按。

items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-late-bus-home “Late Bus Home” · title

items.source: Late Bus Home is indie pop for the ride back through a sleeping city: D, B minor, G and A at 100 beats per minute. Each line starts just after the beat, so wait a breath.
items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-late-bus-home “Late Bus Home” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 《末班車回家》是穿越沉睡城市歸途的獨立流行曲：D、B 小和弦、G、A，每分鐘 100 拍。每句在拍點稍後開始，先稍等一下。

items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-late-bus-home “Late Bus Home” · step 2 (explain) · title
items.translation: B 小和弦，完整或簡易

items.source: Play the full B minor barre at fret 2 if you can. If not, use the top four strings: fret 4 on strings 4 and 3, fret 3 on string 2, fret 2 on string 1.
items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-late-bus-home “Late Bus Home” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 能做到就彈第 2 品完整 B 小和弦橫按。否則用最高四條弦：第 4、3 弦第 4 品，第 2 弦第 3 品，第 1 弦第 2 品。

items.source: A at fret 2 on string 3, D at fret 3 on string 2, then open E and F sharp at fret 2 on string 1.
items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-late-bus-home “Late Bus Home” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第 3 弦第 2 品 A、第 2 弦第 3 品 D，再 E 空弦與第 1 弦第 2 品升 F。

items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-glass-satellites “Glass Satellites” · title
Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-glass-satellites “Glass Satellites” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Glass Satellites is a slow, soaring ballad at 76 beats per minute: A minor, F, C and G. Strum big on one and let it ring, then build on three and four.
items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-glass-satellites “Glass Satellites” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 《玻璃衛星》是緩慢高揚的抒情歌，每分鐘 76 拍：A 小和弦、F、C、G。第一拍大刷延響，第三、四拍再堆疊。

items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-glass-satellites “Glass Satellites” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: Lay finger 1 flat across all six strings at fret 1 and build an E shape in front of it. Not there yet? Use the mini F on the top four strings for now.
items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-glass-satellites “Glass Satellites” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 第 1 指在第 1 品橫按六條弦，再在前方建立 E 指型。還做不到？先用最高四條弦的簡易 F。

items.source: C at fret 1 on string 2, open E twice, D at fret 3, C again, then A at fret 2 on string 3.
items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-glass-satellites “Glass Satellites” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第 2 弦第 1 品 C、E 空弦兩次、第 3 品 D、再 C，接第 3 弦第 2 品 A。

items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-market-day “Market Day” · title
Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-market-day “Market Day” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Market Day borrows from highlife, the bright guitar pop of Ghana and Nigeria: G, B minor, C and D at 104 beats per minute. The hook bounces off the beat, so keep your body moving.
items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-market-day “Market Day” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 《市集日》借用迦納與奈及利亞明亮吉他流行樂 Highlife：G、B 小和弦、C、D，每分鐘 104 拍。記憶點樂句在拍間彈跳，身體也保持律動。

items.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, open B, D again, open E, then back to D and B.
items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-market-day “Market Day” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第 2 弦第 3 品 D、B 空弦、再 D、E 空弦，再回 D、B。

items.source: Bar two keeps bar one's rhythm but swaps one note. Why?
items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-market-day “Market Day” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 第二小節保留第一小節節奏，卻換一個音，為什麼？

items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-market-day “Market Day” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-market-day “Market Day” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-market-day “Market Day” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Bar two moves E up to F sharp, a note of B minor. Same rhythm, new chord, new note.
items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-market-day “Market Day” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 第二小節把 E 升到升 F，這是 B 小和弦的音。相同節奏，新和弦、新音。

items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-velvet-hour “Velvet Hour” · title
Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-velvet-hour “Velvet Hour” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Velvet Hour is neo-soul at 74 beats per minute: four lush seventh chords stepping down, Fmaj7, Em7, Dm7 and Cmaj7. Strum once on one, then brush soft ups on the ands.
items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-velvet-hour “Velvet Hour” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 《絲絨時刻》是每分鐘 74 拍的新靈魂樂，四個豐潤七和弦逐步下降：Fmaj7、Em7、Dm7、Cmaj7。第一拍刷一次，再於「又」輕上刷。

items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-velvet-hour “Velvet Hour” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: Fmaj7 is the mini F with string 1 left open. Em7 takes one finger: finger 2 on string 5, fret 2, every other string open. Dm7 and Cmaj7 you know from Rain on the Skylight.
items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-velvet-hour “Velvet Hour” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Fmaj7 是簡易 F 讓第 1 弦空弦。Em7 只用第 2 指按第 5 弦第 2 品，其他空弦。Dm7 與 Cmaj7 已在《天窗上的雨》學過。

items.source: The chords walk down F, E, D. Where does the loop land?
items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-velvet-hour “Velvet Hour” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 和弦沿 F、E、D 下行，循環落在哪裡？

items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-velvet-hour “Velvet Hour” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-velvet-hour “Velvet Hour” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Each chord sits one step below the last, and the walk ends on C, the home chord.
items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-velvet-hour “Velvet Hour” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 每個和弦比前一個低一級，最後到主和弦 C。

items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-rooftop-choir “Rooftop Choir” · title

items.source: An anthem with a key change
items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-rooftop-choir “Rooftop Choir” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Rooftop Choir is a stadium-sized anthem at 92 beats per minute. You play the chorus in C, then one bar of A lifts everything a whole step, and the chorus returns in D.
items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-rooftop-choir “Rooftop Choir” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 《屋頂合唱團》是體育場規模的頌歌，每分鐘 92 拍。先在 C 調彈副歌，再用一小節 A 把整體提高全音，副歌於 D 調回歸。

items.source: A key change up a whole step moves every note up…
items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-rooftop-choir “Rooftop Choir” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 向上全音轉調，會把每個音提高……

items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-rooftop-choir “Rooftop Choir” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A whole step is two half steps, and each fret is a half step. C becomes D, and G becomes A.
items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-rooftop-choir “Rooftop Choir” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 全音是兩個半音，每品一個半音。C 變 D，G 變 A。

items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-rooftop-choir “Rooftop Choir” · step 4 (along) · title
Originals · Unit 9 · song orig-rooftop-choir “Rooftop Choir” · step 6 (along) · title
Originals · Unit 9 · challenge orig-encore-set “Encore set” · title

items.source: Which chord lifts Rooftop Choir from C into D?
items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · challenge orig-encore-set “Encore set” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 哪個和弦把《屋頂合唱團》從 C 帶到 D？

items.source: A leads home to D. Landing on it turns the whole song toward the new key.
items.context: Originals · Unit 9 · challenge orig-encore-set “Encore set” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: A 引向 D。落在它上面，會讓整首歌轉向新調。

items.context: Originals · Unit 10 “Barre chords and syncopation” · title

items.source: Synth-pop, gospel-pop, dark pop, indie pop and a 6/8 finale, with five new barre chords.
items.context: Originals · Unit 10 “Barre chords and syncopation” · unit summary
items.translation: 合成器流行、福音流行、暗色流行、獨立流行與 6/8 終曲，搭配五個新橫按和弦。

items.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-slow-motion-strobe “Slow Motion Strobe” · title
Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-slow-motion-strobe “Slow Motion Strobe” · step 1 (explain) · title
items.translation: 吉他上的合成器流行樂

items.source: Slow Motion Strobe is synth-pop at 118 beats per minute: F sharp minor, D, A and E. The strum is pushed: two of its hits land on the and, just before the beat.
items.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-slow-motion-strobe “Slow Motion Strobe” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 《慢動作頻閃》是每分鐘 118 拍的合成器流行樂：升 F 小和弦、D、A、E。刷弦帶推進感，兩下落在拍點前的「又」。

items.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-slow-motion-strobe “Slow Motion Strobe” · step 2 (explain) · title
items.translation: 升 F 小和弦橫按

items.source: Barre finger 1 across all six strings at fret 2, then put fingers 3 and 4 on strings 5 and 4 at fret 4: the E minor shape, moved up two frets.
items.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-slow-motion-strobe “Slow Motion Strobe” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 第 1 指在第 2 品橫按六條弦，第 3、4 指按第 5、4 弦第 4 品：E 小和弦指型上移兩品。

items.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-bright-side-of-the-block “Bright Side of the Block” · title
Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-bright-side-of-the-block “Bright Side of the Block” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Bright Side of the Block is a gospel-pop sing-along in D at 100 beats per minute: D, F sharp minor, G and A. Clap on two and four and sing the chorus like the whole street joins in.
items.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-bright-side-of-the-block “Bright Side of the Block” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 《街區的向陽面》是 D 調福音流行合唱曲，每分鐘 100 拍：D、升 F 小和弦、G、A。第二、四拍拍手，副歌像整條街一起唱。

items.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-bright-side-of-the-block “Bright Side of the Block” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: Barre finger 1 across strings 5 to 1 at fret 2, then build an A minor shape two frets up with fingers 2, 3 and 4. Leave string 6 silent.
items.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-bright-side-of-the-block “Bright Side of the Block” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 第 1 指在第 2 品橫按第 5 到 1 弦，再用第 2、3、4 指建立上移兩品的 A 小和弦指型。第 6 弦不發聲。

items.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, open E, G at fret 3 on string 1, F sharp at fret 2, E, G, then E.
items.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-bright-side-of-the-block “Bright Side of the Block” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第 2 弦第 3 品 D、E 空弦、第 1 弦第 3 品 G、第 2 品升 F、E、G，再 E。

items.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-over-you-soon “Over You Soon” · title
Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-over-you-soon “Over You Soon” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Over You Soon is dark pop in B minor at 84 beats per minute: B minor, G, D and A. Strum once on one, then soft ups on the ands, and keep it hushed.
items.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-over-you-soon “Over You Soon” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 《很快放下你》是 B 小調暗色流行曲，每分鐘 84 拍：B 小和弦、G、D、A。第一拍刷一次，再於「又」輕上刷，保持低聲。

items.source: G at fret 3 on string 1, F sharp at fret 2, D at fret 3 on string 2, then F sharp, open E and D.
items.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-over-you-soon “Over You Soon” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第 1 弦第 3 品 G、第 2 品升 F、第 2 弦第 3 品 D，再升 F、E 空弦、D。

items.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-spray-paint-sunrise “Spray Paint Sunrise” · title
Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-spray-paint-sunrise “Spray Paint Sunrise” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Spray Paint Sunrise is indie pop at 124 beats per minute: E, B, C sharp minor and A, the four-chord loop with two barres. Drive steady eighths and let it run.
items.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-spray-paint-sunrise “Spray Paint Sunrise” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 《噴漆日出》是每分鐘 124 拍的獨立流行曲：E、B、升 C 小和弦、A，四和弦循環包含兩個橫按。用穩定八分音符一路推進。

items.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-spray-paint-sunrise “Spray Paint Sunrise” · step 2 (explain) · title
items.translation: B 與升 C 小和弦

items.source: B is an A shape barred at fret 2: finger 1 across strings 5 to 1, three fingers at fret 4. C sharp minor is an A minor shape barred at fret 4.
items.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-spray-paint-sunrise “Spray Paint Sunrise” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: B 是第 2 品橫按的 A 指型：第 1 指橫按第 5 到 1 弦，三指在第 4 品。升 C 小和弦則是第 4 品橫按的 A 小和弦指型。

items.source: G sharp at fret 4 on string 1, F sharp, open E, open B, then D sharp at fret 4 on string 2, C sharp, D sharp.
items.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-spray-paint-sunrise “Spray Paint Sunrise” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第 1 弦第 4 品升 G、升 F、E 空弦、B 空弦，再第 2 弦第 4 品升 D、升 C、升 D。

items.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-constellation-prize “Constellation Prize” · title
Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-constellation-prize “Constellation Prize” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Constellation Prize closes the course: an anthem in 6/8 at 126 counts a minute, in F. F and B flat are both barres, with C and D minor between them.
items.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-constellation-prize “Constellation Prize” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 《星座獎賞》為課程收尾：F 調 6/8 頌歌，每分鐘 126 下。F 與降 B 都用橫按，中間搭配 C 與 D 小和弦。

items.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-constellation-prize “Constellation Prize” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: Barre finger 1 across strings 5 to 1 at fret 1, then put fingers 2, 3 and 4 on strings 4, 3 and 2 at fret 3. Leave string 6 silent.
items.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-constellation-prize “Constellation Prize” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 第 1 指在第 1 品橫按第 5 到 1 弦，第 2、3、4 指按第 4、3、2 弦第 3 品。第 6 弦不發聲。

items.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, F at fret 1 on string 1 twice, G at fret 3, F twice, open E, then F.
items.context: Originals · Unit 10 · song orig-constellation-prize “Constellation Prize” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第 2 弦第 3 品 D、第 1 弦第 1 品 F 兩次、第 3 品 G、F 兩次、E 空弦，再 F。

items.context: Originals · Unit 10 · challenge orig-barre-set “Barre-chord set” · title

items.source: F sharp minor is which shape, barred at fret 2?
items.context: Originals · Unit 10 · challenge orig-barre-set “Barre-chord set” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 升 F 小和弦是什麼指型在第 2 品橫按？

items.source: Barre at fret 2 and the E minor shape sits in front of your first finger: F sharp minor.
items.context: Originals · Unit 10 · challenge orig-barre-set “Barre-chord set” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 第 2 品橫按，第一指前方放 E 小和弦指型，就是升 F 小和弦。

items.source: Famous tunes everyone knows, start to finish

items.translation: 人人熟悉的名曲，從頭到尾演奏

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 “Campfire singalongs” · title

items.source: Folk songs and a spiritual everyone can sing, with simple chord charts to strum.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 “Campfire singalongs” · unit summary
items.translation: 人人能唱的民謠與靈歌，搭配簡單和弦譜刷弦。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-shell-be-coming “She'll Be Coming 'Round the Mountain” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-shell-be-coming “She'll Be Coming 'Round the Mountain” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: This tune began as a spiritual. In the 1890s railroad crews in the Midwest gave it new words, and Carl Sandburg printed it in 1927. It climbs from low B up to D on string 2.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-shell-be-coming “She'll Be Coming 'Round the Mountain” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 這段旋律原是靈歌。1890 年代，美國中西部鐵路工人填入新詞，Carl Sandburg 於 1927 年出版。旋律從低音 B 上到第 2 弦 D。

items.source: The first line: open D, E, four open Gs, a dip to B on string 5, then home to G.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-shell-be-coming “She'll Be Coming 'Round the Mountain” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第一句：D 空弦、E、四次 G 空弦，下降到第 5 弦 B，再回 G。

items.source: The words She'll be come before beat one. What are they?
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-shell-be-coming “She'll Be Coming 'Round the Mountain” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 歌詞 She'll be 在第一拍之前，是什麼？

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-shell-be-coming “She'll Be Coming 'Round the Mountain” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A pickup is a few notes that lead into the first strong beat. Here they run up to the word com-.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-shell-be-coming “She'll Be Coming 'Round the Mountain” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 弱起是引向第一個強拍的幾個音，這裡引到 com- 這個音節。

items.source: Three chords: G, C and D7
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-shell-be-coming “She'll Be Coming 'Round the Mountain” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: Most of the song sits on G. D7 comes at the end of the second line, and C colors the fourth. Change on the word that starts the bar.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-shell-be-coming “She'll Be Coming 'Round the Mountain” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 大部分歌曲停在 G。第二句末到 D7，第四句用 C 增色。在開始小節的字上換和弦。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-shell-be-coming “She'll Be Coming 'Round the Mountain” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-down-by-the-riverside “Down by the Riverside” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: This African American spiritual is older than the Civil War and was first printed in 1918. Its line ain't gonna study war no more became a song of the peace movement.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-down-by-the-riverside “Down by the Riverside” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 這首非裔美國人靈歌早於南北戰爭，於 1918 年首次出版。歌詞 ain't gonna study war no more 成為和平運動之歌。

items.source: Lay down my burden: open B, a drop to open D, then up through E, G and A to B.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-down-by-the-riverside “Down by the Riverside” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Lay down my burden：B 空弦，下降到 D 空弦，再經 E、G、A 上到 B。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-down-by-the-riverside “Down by the Riverside” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: A sharp sits between A and B, at fret 3 on string 3. It slides up into open B, the bluesy lift that gives gospel its sound.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-down-by-the-riverside “Down by the Riverside” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 升 A 在 A 與 B 之間，位於第 3 弦第 3 品。它向上滑入 B 空弦，形成福音音樂特有的藍調提亮感。

items.source: Down by the riverside: B, B, A sharp at fret 3, B, then A and G.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-down-by-the-riverside “Down by the Riverside” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Down by the riverside：B、B、第 3 品升 A、B，再 A、G。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-loch-lomond “Loch Lomond” · title

items.source: The high road and the low road
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-loch-lomond “Loch Lomond” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: This Scottish song was first printed in 1841. The low road is often heard as the road a soldier's spirit takes home, faster than the living on the high road.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-loch-lomond “Loch Lomond” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 這首蘇格蘭歌曲於 1841 年首次出版。「低路」常被理解為士兵靈魂返鄉的路，比活人走的「高路」更快。

items.source: By yon bonnie banks: open D, then G, G, A, B and back down to G.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-loch-lomond “Loch Lomond” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: By yon bonnie banks：D 空弦，再 G、G、A、B，往下回 G。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-loch-lomond “Loch Lomond” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: This tune moves in quarter notes and pairs of eighths. Count one, two-and, three, four-and, and the lilt comes by itself.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-loch-lomond “Loch Lomond” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 曲調使用四分音符與成對八分音符。數一、二又、三、四又，輕快感自然出現。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-loch-lomond “Loch Lomond” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-molly-malone “Molly Malone” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: This song was printed in 1876 and credited in 1884 to James Yorkston of Edinburgh. It is now Dublin's unofficial anthem, and Molly and her cart stand as a statue in the city.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-molly-malone “Molly Malone” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 這首歌於 1876 年出版，1884 年署名愛丁堡的 James Yorkston。如今是都柏林非正式代表歌曲，城裡有 Molly 與推車的雕像。

items.source: In Dublin's fair city: open D, four open Gs, up to open B and back to G.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-molly-malone “Molly Malone” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: In Dublin's fair city：D 空弦，四次 G 空弦，上到 B 空弦，再回 G。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-molly-malone “Molly Malone” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Count one, two, three and lean on one. In many bars the middle note is long: one, two, and a quick note just before the next one.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-molly-malone “Molly Malone” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 數一、二、三，強調一。許多小節中間的音較長：一、二，再在下一拍前進入一個快音。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-the-water-is-wide “The Water Is Wide” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Cecil Sharp collected and published this ballad in 1906, from verses that go back to the 1700s. Play it slowly and let every long note ring.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-the-water-is-wide “The Water Is Wide” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Cecil Sharp 在 1906 年採集並出版這首抒情歌，歌詞可追溯至 1700 年起的那個世紀。慢慢彈，讓每個長音延續。

items.source: The water is wide, I cannot get o'er: up from open D to B, then gently back down to D.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-the-water-is-wide “The Water Is Wide” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: The water is wide, I cannot get o'er：從 D 空弦上到 B，再輕輕下回 D。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-the-water-is-wide “The Water Is Wide” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Wide rings for two beats and two for two and a half. Keep counting while the string rings, so the next word lands on time.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-the-water-is-wide “The Water Is Wide” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Wide 延續兩拍，two 延續兩拍半。琴弦鳴響時持續數拍，讓下一個字準時進入。

items.source: Which word holds over two notes in the first verse?
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-the-water-is-wide “The Water Is Wide” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 第一段主歌哪個字跨兩個音？

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-the-water-is-wide “The Water Is Wide” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-the-water-is-wide “The Water Is Wide” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-the-water-is-wide “The Water Is Wide” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Fly starts on C and slides down to a long A. Singers call one syllable over several notes a melisma.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · song std-the-water-is-wide “The Water Is Wide” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Fly 從 C 開始，向下滑到長 A。歌唱中，一個音節跨多個音，稱為一字多音。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · challenge std-medley-campfire “Campfire medley” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · challenge std-medley-campfire “Campfire medley” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: No new notes: the five songs from this unit, one after another, a little faster than before. Name each one from its first notes.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 1 · challenge std-medley-campfire “Campfire medley” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 沒有新音：這單元五首歌接著彈，比之前稍快。從最初幾個音辨認每首歌。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 “Ballads and carols” · title

items.source: A Welsh lullaby, a Highland boat song and three carols, in German, Latin and English.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 “Ballads and carols” · unit summary
items.translation: 威爾斯搖籃曲、高地船歌，以及德語、拉丁語和英語的三首頌歌。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-all-through-the-night “All Through the Night” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-all-through-the-night “All Through the Night” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: The tune Ar Hyd y Nos was printed in Wales in 1784, and Harold Boulton wrote these English words in 1884. One phrase comes three times, with a higher one in the middle.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-all-through-the-night “All Through the Night” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 曲調《Ar Hyd y Nos》於 1784 年在威爾斯出版，Harold Boulton 在 1884 年寫了這版英文詞。一個樂句出現三次，中間穿插較高的一句。

items.source: Sleep, my child, and peace attend thee: open G, down to F sharp and E, then G, A, G, F sharp and D.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-all-through-the-night “All Through the Night” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Sleep, my child, and peace attend thee：G 空弦，下到升 F、E，再 G、A、G、升 F、D。

items.source: Which phrase of the verse climbs highest?
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-all-through-the-night “All Through the Night” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-all-through-the-night “All Through the Night” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-all-through-the-night “All Through the Night” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: The third phrase, soft the drowsy hours, rises to C, D and E. The other three phrases share one tune.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-all-through-the-night “All Through the Night” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 第三句 soft the drowsy hours 上到 C、D、E，其他三句共用同一旋律。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-all-through-the-night “All Through the Night” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-skye-boat-song “The Skye Boat Song” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Harold Boulton set these words in 1884 to a Highland rowing tune collected by Anne MacLeod. They tell of Bonnie Prince Charlie escaping to the Isle of Skye in 1746.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-skye-boat-song “The Skye Boat Song” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Harold Boulton 在 1884 年為 Anne MacLeod 採集的高地划船曲填詞，講述 Bonnie Prince Charlie 在 1746 年逃往斯凱島。

items.source: This song rocks in six-eight: two big beats a bar, each split in three. Count one-two-three, four-five-six, like oars pulling and coming back.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-skye-boat-song “The Skye Boat Song” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 這首歌以八六拍搖曳：每小節兩個大拍，各分三份。數一二三、四五六，像划槳出去再回來。

items.source: Speed, bonnie boat, like a bird on the wing: open D, E, D, three open Gs, then A, B, A and up to D.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-skye-boat-song “The Skye Boat Song” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: Speed, bonnie boat, like a bird on the wing：D 空弦、E、D，三次 G 空弦，再 A、B、A，上到 D。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-o-christmas-tree “O Christmas Tree” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-o-christmas-tree “O Christmas Tree” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Ernst Anschütz wrote these words in Leipzig in 1824, to a much older folk tune. You'll sing them in German, the language they were written in.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-o-christmas-tree “O Christmas Tree” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Ernst Anschütz 在 1824 年於萊比錫，為更古老的民謠曲調填上這些詞。你將用原作語言德語演唱。

items.source: O Tannenbaum, o Tannenbaum: open D, three open Gs, then A at fret 2 and three open Bs.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-o-christmas-tree “O Christmas Tree” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: O Tannenbaum, o Tannenbaum：D 空弦、三次 G 空弦，再第 2 品 A 與三次 B 空弦。

items.source: Tan-nen is a dotted note and a very short one, then baum rings on. Say the words as you tap, and the rhythm follows.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-o-christmas-tree “O Christmas Tree” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Tan-nen 是附點音加很短的音，接著 baum 延續。邊敲邊說歌詞，節奏就會跟上。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-o-christmas-tree “O Christmas Tree” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-o-come-all-ye-faithful “O Come, All Ye Faithful” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-o-come-all-ye-faithful “O Come, All Ye Faithful” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: The Latin hymn Adeste Fideles was printed with this tune in 1751, and Frederick Oakeley's English words followed in 1841. You'll sing a verse in each language.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-o-come-all-ye-faithful “O Come, All Ye Faithful” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 拉丁聖詩《Adeste Fideles》在 1751 年與這段曲調一起出版，Frederick Oakeley 的英文詞在 1841 年出現。你會各唱一段拉丁語與英語。

items.source: O come, all ye faithful: open G twice, down to open D, back to G, A, and D again.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-o-come-all-ye-faithful “O Come, All Ye Faithful” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: O come, all ye faithful：G 空弦兩次，下到 D 空弦，回 G、A，再 D。

items.source: How many times does the refrain sing O come, let us adore him?
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-o-come-all-ye-faithful “O Come, All Ye Faithful” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 副歌唱幾次 O come, let us adore him？

items.source: Three times, each a little higher, before Christ the Lord brings the tune home.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-o-come-all-ye-faithful “O Come, All Ye Faithful” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 三次，每次稍高，再由 Christ the Lord 帶旋律回家。

items.source: Latin hymn (1751); English words Frederick Oakeley (1841)
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-o-come-all-ye-faithful “O Come, All Ye Faithful” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
items.translation: 拉丁聖詩（1751）；英文詞 Frederick Oakeley（1841）

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-the-first-noel “The First Noel” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-the-first-noel “The First Noel” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: This carol was first printed in 1823, in a collection of old Christmas carols. Its tune walks up the scale and back, which is why it is so easy to remember.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-the-first-noel “The First Noel” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 這首頌歌於 1823 年首次刊在古老聖誕頌歌集。旋律沿音階上行再下行，因此很容易記。

items.source: Up the D scale: F sharp and E, open D, then E, F sharp, open G, A, open B, C sharp at fret 2 and D.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-the-first-noel “The First Noel” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 沿 D 音階上行：升 F、E、D 空弦，再 E、升 F、G 空弦、A、B 空弦、第 2 品升 C、D。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-the-first-noel “The First Noel” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: The tune starts with two quick notes, F sharp and E, before beat one. Then a long D and a run of eighths climb to A.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-the-first-noel “The First Noel” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 旋律在第一拍前以升 F、E 兩個快音開始，再長 D，接八分音符音串上到 A。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-the-first-noel “The First Noel” · step 6 (along) · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · song std-the-first-noel “The First Noel” · arrangement · song section label (Intro, Verse 1 …) on a small chip
Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · challenge std-medley-ballads “Ballads and carols medley” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · challenge std-medley-ballads “Ballads and carols medley” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Five songs from this unit: two ballads and three carols. No new notes, just one after another, each a little faster than before.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · challenge std-medley-ballads “Ballads and carols medley” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 這單元五首歌：兩首抒情歌、三首頌歌。沒有新音，依次演奏，每首比之前稍快。

items.source: Which of these counts in six?
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · challenge std-medley-ballads “Ballads and carols medley” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: The Skye Boat Song rocks in six-eight. O Christmas Tree is in three, and All Through the Night in four.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 2 · challenge std-medley-ballads “Ballads and carols medley” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 《斯凱島船歌》以八六拍搖曳，《聖誕樹》是三拍，《漫漫長夜》是四拍。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 “Pipes, waltzes and dances” · title

items.source: A pipe march, a Russian folk dance, the Blue Danube and the can-can.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 “Pipes, waltzes and dances” · unit summary
items.translation: 風笛進行曲、俄羅斯民間舞曲、藍色多瑙河與康康舞。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-scotland-the-brave “Scotland the Brave” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-scotland-the-brave “Scotland the Brave” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: This Scottish march was in print by 1878, and pipe bands play it all over the world. Pipers play it without words, and so will you.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-scotland-the-brave “Scotland the Brave” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 這首蘇格蘭進行曲至遲在 1878 年已出版，世界各地風笛隊都演奏。風笛手不唱詞，你也只演奏旋律。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-scotland-the-brave “Scotland the Brave” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: A dotted note and a quick one give a march its snap: long, then short. In the first bar, the second D is long and E slips in just before beat two.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-scotland-the-brave “Scotland the Brave” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 附點音接快音，讓進行曲俐落：先長後短。第一小節第二個 D 較長，E 在第二拍前一瞬進入。

items.source: Up the D chord: open D twice, E, F sharp at fret 4, D, F sharp, A, then D on string 2.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-scotland-the-brave “Scotland the Brave” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 沿 D 和弦上行：D 空弦兩次、E、第 4 品升 F、D、升 F、A，再第 2 弦 D。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-scotland-the-brave “Scotland the Brave” · step 5 (along) · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-scotland-the-brave “Scotland the Brave” · step 6 (along) · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-korobeiniki “Korobeiniki” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-korobeiniki “Korobeiniki” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Nikolay Nekrasov's poem about traveling peddlers was printed in 1861, and this folk tune was published with it in 1898. A video game made it famous worldwide almost a century later.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-korobeiniki “Korobeiniki” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Nikolay Nekrasov 關於行商的詩於 1861 年出版，這首民謠曲調於 1898 年與它結合出版。近一世紀後，一款電玩讓它聞名全球。

items.source: The opening: open B, down to F sharp at fret 4 on string 4, up G and A, then G, F sharp, E.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-korobeiniki “Korobeiniki” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 開頭：B 空弦，下到第 4 弦第 4 品升 F，上行 G、A，再 G、升 F、E。

items.source: The second half reaches higher: A, C at fret 1 on string 2, open E, then down D, C, B and G.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-korobeiniki “Korobeiniki” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 後半段更高：A、第 2 弦第 1 品 C、E 空弦，再下行 D、C、B、G。

items.source: This tune is in E minor. Which note sounds like home?
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-korobeiniki “Korobeiniki” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 曲子是 E 小調，哪個音像家？

items.source: Both halves end on E, the home note of E minor. You hear it as the place the tune settles.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-korobeiniki “Korobeiniki” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 兩半都在 E 結束，這是 E 小調主音，也是旋律安定的地方。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-korobeiniki “Korobeiniki” · arrangement · song section label (Intro, Verse 1 …) on a small chip

Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-blue-danube “The Blue Danube” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-blue-danube “The Blue Danube” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Johann Strauss II first performed this waltz in Vienna in 1867, and Vienna still plays it every New Year's Day. Its tune climbs a chord, then answers with two high notes.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-blue-danube “The Blue Danube” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Johann Strauss II 於 1867 年在維也納首演這首圓舞曲，維也納至今每逢元旦仍演奏。旋律沿和弦上行，再以兩個高音回答。

items.source: G at fret 3 on string 6 twice, B on string 5, open D, then leap up to D at fret 3 on string 2 and down to open B.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-blue-danube “The Blue Danube” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第 6 弦第 3 品 G 兩次、第 5 弦 B、D 空弦，再上跳第 2 弦第 3 品 D，下到 B 空弦。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-blue-danube “The Blue Danube” · step 3 (explain) · title
items.translation: 從第 6 弦到第 2 弦

items.source: Each phrase starts low on the bass strings and leaps up an octave. Look at the high note before you play the low ones, so your hand knows where it's going.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-blue-danube “The Blue Danube” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 每句從低音弦開始，再上跳八度。彈低音前先看高音位置，讓手知道要去哪裡。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-blue-danube “The Blue Danube” · step 5 (along) · title

Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-blue-danube “The Blue Danube” · arrangement · song section label (Intro, Verse 1 …) on a small chip
Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-can-can “Can-can” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-can-can “Can-can” · step 1 (explain) · title
items.translation: 來自地獄的加洛普舞曲

items.source: Jacques Offenbach wrote this galop for his 1858 operetta Orpheus in the Underworld. Paris dance halls later made it the music of the can-can.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-can-can “Can-can” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Jacques Offenbach 為 1858 年輕歌劇《地獄中的奧菲歐》寫下這首加洛普舞曲。巴黎舞廳後來讓它成為康康舞音樂。

items.source: A long open G, then A, C, B, A, and two Ds at fret 3 on string 2.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-can-can “Can-can” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 長 G 空弦，再 A、C、B、A，接第 2 弦第 3 品 D 兩次。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-can-can “Can-can” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Most of the tune runs in eighth notes. Keep the pick small and alternate down and up, so you never fall behind.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-can-can “Can-can” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 大部分旋律使用八分音符。撥片動作小，下上交替，才不會落後。

items.source: The big run: open G, leap to G at fret 3 on string 1, then step all the way down to A.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-can-can “Can-can” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 長音串：G 空弦，上跳第 1 弦第 3 品 G，再一路級進下到 A。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-can-can “Can-can” · arrangement · song section label (Intro, Verse 1 …) on a small chip
Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · song std-can-can “Can-can” · arrangement · song section label (Intro, Verse 1 …) on a small chip
Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · challenge std-medley-dances “Dance hall medley” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · challenge std-medley-dances “Dance hall medley” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Four tunes from this unit: a pipe march, a Russian folk song, a Viennese waltz and a French galop. Each one a little faster than before.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · challenge std-medley-dances “Dance hall medley” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 這單元四首曲子：風笛進行曲、俄羅斯民謠、維也納圓舞曲與法國加洛普舞曲。每首比之前稍快。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · challenge std-medley-dances “Dance hall medley” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction
items.translation: 哪首曲子是這樣開始的？

items.source: Which of these is a waltz, in three?
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · challenge std-medley-dances “Dance hall medley” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 以下哪首是三拍圓舞曲？

items.source: A waltz counts one, two, three. The can-can and the pipe march both count in four.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 3 · challenge std-medley-dances “Dance hall medley” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 圓舞曲數一、二、三。康康舞與風笛進行曲都數四拍。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 “Ragtime, marches and the stage” · title
items.translation: 雷格泰姆、進行曲與舞台

items.source: Joplin, Sousa, Bizet and Grieg: syncopation, six-eight and key changes.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 “Ragtime, marches and the stage” · unit summary
items.translation: 喬普林、蘇沙、比才與葛利格：切分音、八六拍與轉調。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-the-entertainer “The Entertainer” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-the-entertainer “The Entertainer” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Scott Joplin published The Entertainer in 1902, and a 1973 film made it famous again. In ragtime the tune leans off the beat while the bass keeps steady time.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-the-entertainer “The Entertainer” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Scott Joplin 於 1902 年出版《藝人》，1973 年一部電影讓它再次走紅。雷格泰姆的旋律重音偏離拍點，低音則維持穩定。

items.source: Open D, D sharp at fret 1, E at fret 2 on string 4, then leap to C at fret 1 on string 2 and back, three times.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-the-entertainer “The Entertainer” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: D 空弦、第 1 品升 D、第 4 弦第 2 品 E，再跳到第 2 弦第 1 品 C 並回來，三次。

items.source: Syncopation puts the accent between the beats. In the opening, each C lands on an and. Count one-and-two-and and feel the C pull ahead.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-the-entertainer “The Entertainer” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 切分音把重音放拍間。開頭每個 C 都落在「又」。數一又二又，感受 C 向前牽引。

items.source: The ending run circles C, D and E on strings 2 and 1, then lands through B and D on C.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-the-entertainer “The Entertainer” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 結尾音串在第 2、1 弦的 C、D、E 間繞行，再經 B、D 落到 C。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-the-liberty-bell “The Liberty Bell” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-the-liberty-bell “The Liberty Bell” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: John Philip Sousa published The Liberty Bell in 1893, and a British TV comedy later made it its theme. It's in six-eight: two big beats a bar, like left, right.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-the-liberty-bell “The Liberty Bell” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: John Philip Sousa 在 1893 年出版《自由鐘》，後來英國電視喜劇用它作主題曲。八六拍，每小節兩個大拍，像左、右。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-the-liberty-bell “The Liberty Bell” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: Many beats start with a short silence. Stop the string with your fretting hand, then come back in on the next eighth.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-the-liberty-bell “The Liberty Bell” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 許多拍以短暫安靜開始。用按弦手止音，再於下一個八分音符進入。

items.source: Open B three times, A sharp at fret 3 on string 3, B again, then up to G on string 1 and down D, D, B.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-the-liberty-bell “The Liberty Bell” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: B 空弦三次、第 3 弦第 3 品升 A、再 B，上到第 1 弦 G，再下行 D、D、B。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-the-liberty-bell “The Liberty Bell” · step 5 (along) · title

Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-carmen-prelude “Carmen: Prelude” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-carmen-prelude “Carmen: Prelude” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Georges Bizet's opera Carmen opened in Paris in 1875. Its prelude starts with this festive march, then plays the tune of the famous Toreador Song.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-carmen-prelude “Carmen: Prelude” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Georges Bizet 的歌劇《卡門》於 1875 年在巴黎首演。前奏曲先是這段歡慶進行曲，再演奏著名《鬥牛士之歌》的旋律。

items.source: Four As at fret 2 on string 3, then down to E at fret 2 on string 4, open D and E.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-carmen-prelude “Carmen: Prelude” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第 3 弦第 2 品 A 四次，再下到第 4 弦第 2 品 E、D 空弦、E。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-carmen-prelude “Carmen: Prelude” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: The march is in A major, with C sharp and G sharp. The Toreador tune moves to F major, with B flat at fret 3 on string 3. Watch for the change.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-carmen-prelude “Carmen: Prelude” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 進行曲是 A 大調，含升 C、升 G。《鬥牛士》旋律轉 F 大調，降 B 在第 3 弦第 3 品。留意轉變。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-carmen-prelude “Carmen: Prelude” · step 5 (along) · title

items.source: What happens at the end of the Toreador tune?
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-carmen-prelude “Carmen: Prelude” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 鬥牛士旋律結尾發生什麼？

items.source: It climbs to a long E
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-carmen-prelude “Carmen: Prelude” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-carmen-prelude “Carmen: Prelude” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-carmen-prelude “Carmen: Prelude” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: It climbs to a long high E, the note that leads back home to A major for the march.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-carmen-prelude “Carmen: Prelude” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 它上行到長高音 E，引回 A 大調的進行曲。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-carmen-prelude “Carmen: Prelude” · arrangement · song section label (Intro, Verse 1 …) on a small chip
Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-morning-mood “Morning Mood” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-morning-mood “Morning Mood” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Edvard Grieg wrote Morning Mood in 1875 for the play Peer Gynt. The flute plays the theme, the oboe answers, and the music climbs like the rising sun.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-morning-mood “Morning Mood” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Edvard Grieg 在 1875 年為戲劇《皮爾金》寫下《晨景》。長笛奏主題，雙簧管回應，音樂如旭日般升起。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-morning-mood “Morning Mood” · step 2 (explain) · title

items.source: The theme uses just G, A, B, D and E. A five-note scale like this is called pentatonic, and it sounds calm and open.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-morning-mood “Morning Mood” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 主題只用 G、A、B、D、E。這種五音音階稱為五聲音階，聽起來平靜開闊。

items.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, open B, A at fret 2 on string 3, open G, then back up A and B.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-morning-mood “Morning Mood” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第 2 弦第 3 品 D、B 空弦、第 3 弦第 2 品 A、G 空弦，再上行 A、B。

items.source: How many different notes does the theme use?
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-morning-mood “Morning Mood” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: G, A, B, D and E: a pentatonic scale. There is no C and no F sharp in the whole theme.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-morning-mood “Morning Mood” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: G、A、B、D、E：五聲音階。整個主題沒有 C，也沒有升 F。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · song std-morning-mood “Morning Mood” · step 6 (along) · title

Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · challenge std-medley-stage “Showstoppers medley” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · challenge std-medley-stage “Showstoppers medley” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: The four pieces from this unit, back to back: ragtime, a march, an opera prelude and a sunrise. Each a little faster than before.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · challenge std-medley-stage “Showstoppers medley” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 這單元四首作品接著彈：雷格泰姆、進行曲、歌劇前奏曲與日出。每首比之前稍快。

items.source: Which of these pieces uses only five notes in its theme?
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · challenge std-medley-stage “Showstoppers medley” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 哪首作品的主題只用五個音？

items.source: Morning Mood's theme is pentatonic: G, A, B, D and E. The others use many more.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 4 · challenge std-medley-stage “Showstoppers medley” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 《晨景》的主題是五聲音階：G、A、B、D、E。其他作品用更多音。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 “Carols by candlelight” · title

items.source: Four Christmas carols to sing by candlelight: Wesley and Mendelssohn, a lullaby, and two tunes from America.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 “Carols by candlelight” · unit summary
items.translation: 四首適合燭光中歌唱的聖誕頌歌：衛斯理與孟德爾頌、一首搖籃曲，以及兩首美國曲調。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-hark-the-herald “Hark! The Herald Angels Sing” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-hark-the-herald “Hark! The Herald Angels Sing” · step 1 (explain) · title
items.translation: 衛斯理的詞，孟德爾頌的曲

items.source: Charles Wesley wrote the words in 1739. In 1856 an English organist set them to a tune from a choral piece by Felix Mendelssohn, and the carol has been sung that way since.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-hark-the-herald “Hark! The Herald Angels Sing” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Charles Wesley 在 1739 年寫詞。1856 年，一位英國管風琴師把詞配上 Felix Mendelssohn 合唱作品中的旋律，此後一直如此傳唱。

items.source: Open D, open G twice, F sharp at fret 4 on string 4, G, then open B twice and A at fret 2 on string 3.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-hark-the-herald “Hark! The Herald Angels Sing” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: D 空弦、G 空弦兩次、第 4 弦第 4 品升 F、G，再 B 空弦兩次與第 3 弦第 2 品 A。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-hark-the-herald “Hark! The Herald Angels Sing” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Her-ald is long-short: her- lands on three and holds, and -ald slips in on the and of four. Count one, two, three, four-and.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-hark-the-herald “Hark! The Herald Angels Sing” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Her-ald 是長短：her- 在第三拍落下並延續，-ald 在第四拍的「又」進入。數一、二、三、四又。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-hark-the-herald “Hark! The Herald Angels Sing” · step 7 (explain) · title

items.source: The chorus moves C, A minor, D7 and G. Change on the word that starts each half bar, and keep the strum light under the high E.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-hark-the-herald “Hark! The Herald Angels Sing” · step 7 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 副歌走 C、A 小和弦、D7、G。每半小節開頭的字換和弦，高音 E 下方保持輕刷。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-hark-the-herald “Hark! The Herald Angels Sing” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-away-in-a-manger “Away in a Manger” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-away-in-a-manger “Away in a Manger” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: These words first appeared in an American children's book in 1885, and James R. Murray gave them this gentle tune in 1887. It rocks in three, like a cradle.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-away-in-a-manger “Away in a Manger” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 歌詞於 1885 年首次出現在美國童書，James R. Murray 在 1887 年配上這段柔和旋律。它像搖籃般以三拍擺動。

items.source: It starts high: D at fret 3 on string 2, then steps down C, B, A, G and F sharp all the way to open D.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-away-in-a-manger “Away in a Manger” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 從高音開始：第 2 弦第 3 品 D，再經 C、B、A、G、升 F 一路下到 D 空弦。

items.source: The first line walks down from high D to low D. How far is that?
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-away-in-a-manger “Away in a Manger” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 第一句從高音 D 下到低音 D，相隔多遠？

items.source: D down to D is an octave: eight steps of the scale, the same note name, one register lower.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-away-in-a-manger “Away in a Manger” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: D 下到 D 是八度：音階八個音，同音名，低一個音域。

items.source: Hold G for most of a line, C for crib for a bed, and D7 to lead home. In three, strum down on one and lightly on two and three.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-away-in-a-manger “Away in a Manger” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 大部分樂句保持 G，crib for a bed 用 C，再用 D7 引回。三拍中第一拍下刷，第二、三拍輕刷。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-away-in-a-manger “Away in a Manger” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
items.translation: 佚名（1885）；第 3 段 John T. McFarland（1892）

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-o-little-town “O Little Town of Bethlehem” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-o-little-town “O Little Town of Bethlehem” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Phillips Brooks wrote these words in 1868 for the children of his Philadelphia church, and its organist, Lewis Redner, wrote the tune for their Christmas service.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-o-little-town “O Little Town of Bethlehem” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Phillips Brooks 在 1868 年為費城教會的孩子寫詞，管風琴師 Lewis Redner 為聖誕禮拜譜曲。

items.source: Open B three times, A sharp at fret 3 on string 3, B again, then D, C and a drop to E on string 4.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-o-little-town “O Little Town of Bethlehem” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: B 空弦三次、第 3 弦第 3 品升 A、再 B，接 D、C，下降到第 4 弦 E。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-o-little-town “O Little Town of Bethlehem” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: A sharp at fret 3 on string 3 leans into open B, a half step up. It gives O little town its gentle sway.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-o-little-town “O Little Town of Bethlehem” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 第 3 弦第 3 品升 A 向上半音引入 B 空弦，讓 O little town 有柔和搖曳感。

items.source: Which word dips down to the low D in the first verse?
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-o-little-town “O Little Town of Bethlehem” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 第一段主歌哪個字下降到低音 D？

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-o-little-town “O Little Town of Bethlehem” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-o-little-town “O Little Town of Bethlehem” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Thee, in how still we see thee lie
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-o-little-town “O Little Town of Bethlehem” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: Thee，出自 how still we see thee lie

items.source: How still we see thee lie: the tune falls to open D on thee, then lifts to B on lie.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-o-little-town “O Little Town of Bethlehem” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: How still we see thee lie：旋律在 thee 下到 D 空弦，在 lie 升到 B。

items.source: It Came Upon the Midnight Clear
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-it-came-upon “It Came Upon the Midnight Clear” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-it-came-upon “It Came Upon the Midnight Clear” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Edmund Sears wrote these words in Massachusetts in 1849, and Richard Storrs Willis wrote the tune a year later. It swings in two big beats a bar, each split in three.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-it-came-upon “It Came Upon the Midnight Clear” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Edmund Sears 在 1849 年於麻薩諸塞州寫詞，Richard Storrs Willis 一年後譜曲。每小節兩個大拍，各分三份，輕輕搖擺。

items.source: In six-eight a quarter and an eighth make one big beat: long, short. Count one-two-three, four-five-six, and play on one, three, four and six.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-it-came-upon “It Came Upon the Midnight Clear” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 八六拍中，四分音符加八分音符組成一個大拍：長、短。數一二三、四五六，在一、三、四、六演奏。

items.source: Open G, a leap to open E on string 1, then B, D, C, A, and back to G with a turn through A.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-it-came-upon “It Came Upon the Midnight Clear” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: G 空弦，跳到第 1 弦 E 空弦，再 B、D、C、A，經 A 轉折回 G。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-it-came-upon “It Came Upon the Midnight Clear” · step 6 (explain) · title

items.source: The middle of the verse drops to low E and climbs through G sharp, at fret 1 on string 3, to A. Under it the chord moves from E7 to A minor.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-it-came-upon “It Came Upon the Midnight Clear” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 主歌中段下到低音 E，再經第 3 弦第 1 品升 G 上到 A。下方和弦從 E7 移到 A 小和弦。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · song std-it-came-upon “It Came Upon the Midnight Clear” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)

Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · challenge std-medley-carols “Carol medley” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: The four carols from this unit, one after another, each a little faster. Keep the chords soft and let the tune sing.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · challenge std-medley-carols “Carol medley” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 這單元四首頌歌依次演奏，每首稍快。和弦保持輕柔，讓旋律歌唱。

items.source: Which of these carols counts in three?
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · challenge std-medley-carols “Carol medley” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: Away in a Manger is a waltz: one, two, three. The other two count in four.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 5 · challenge std-medley-carols “Carol medley” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 《遠在馬槽裡》是圓舞曲：一、二、三。另兩首數四拍。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 “Winter carols” · title

items.source: King's College's opening carol, Holst's midwinter carol, a folk carol and a grand processional.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 “Winter carols” · unit summary
items.translation: 國王學院開場頌歌、霍爾斯特的寒冬頌歌、一首民謠頌歌與盛大進堂曲。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-royal-davids-city “Once in Royal David's City” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-royal-davids-city “Once in Royal David's City” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Cecil Frances Alexander wrote these words for children in 1848. Since 1919 a single young voice has sung the first verse to open the Christmas Eve carols at King's College, Cambridge.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-royal-davids-city “Once in Royal David's City” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Cecil Frances Alexander 在 1848 年為兒童寫詞。自 1919 年起，劍橋國王學院平安夜頌歌禮拜，以一位年輕歌者獨唱第一段開場。

items.source: Open D, F sharp at fret 4 on string 4, open G, then a turn: G, F sharp, G, A, A, G.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-royal-davids-city “Once in Royal David's City” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: D 空弦、第 4 弦第 4 品升 F、G 空弦，再轉折：G、升 F、G、A、A、G。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-royal-davids-city “Once in Royal David's City” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Da-vid's spreads each syllable over two eighth notes. Play both, but sing them as one smooth sound.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-royal-davids-city “Once in Royal David's City” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Da-vid's 的每個音節跨兩個八分音符。兩音都演奏，歌唱時則連成一個平順聲音。

items.source: Where is the highest note of the carol?
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-royal-davids-city “Once in Royal David's City” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 這首頌歌最高的音在哪裡？

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-royal-davids-city “Once in Royal David's City” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: 第 2 弦第 3 品 D

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-royal-davids-city “Once in Royal David's City” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-royal-davids-city “Once in Royal David's City” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Mary was that mother mild starts on open E, the top of the tune.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-royal-davids-city “Once in Royal David's City” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Mary was that mother mild 從 E 空弦開始，這是旋律最高音。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-royal-davids-city “Once in Royal David's City” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-bleak-midwinter “In the Bleak Midwinter” · title

items.source: A poem and a quiet tune
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-bleak-midwinter “In the Bleak Midwinter” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Christina Rossetti wrote this poem in 1872, and Gustav Holst set it to music for a hymn book in 1906. Its lines are short and calm, like snow falling.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-bleak-midwinter “In the Bleak Midwinter” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Christina Rossetti 在 1872 年寫這首詩，Gustav Holst 在 1906 年為聖詩集譜曲。樂句短而平靜，像雪飄落。

items.source: Open B twice, C at fret 1 and D at fret 3 on string 2, then back down B, A and G.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-bleak-midwinter “In the Bleak Midwinter” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: B 空弦兩次，第 2 弦第 1 品 C、第 3 品 D，再下行 B、A、G。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-bleak-midwinter “In the Bleak Midwinter” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Many words land on half notes: -ter in mid-winter, i-ron. Let each ring for two full beats before you move on.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-bleak-midwinter “In the Bleak Midwinter” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 許多字落在二分音符上：mid-winter 的 -ter、i-ron。每個都響足兩拍，再繼續。

items.source: Long ago stretches three syllables over how many notes?
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-bleak-midwinter “In the Bleak Midwinter” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Long ago 的三個音節跨幾個音？

items.source: Long takes two notes, a- takes two, and go takes one: five notes for three syllables.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-bleak-midwinter “In the Bleak Midwinter” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Long 兩個音，a- 兩個，go 一個：三個音節共五個音。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-bleak-midwinter “In the Bleak Midwinter” · step 6 (explain) · title

items.source: Under frost-y wind made moan the chords move A minor to D7, a lean that pulls the line back to G.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-bleak-midwinter “In the Bleak Midwinter” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Frost-y wind made moan 下方，和弦從 A 小和弦到 D7，引樂句回 G。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-bleak-midwinter “In the Bleak Midwinter” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-holly-and-ivy “The Holly and the Ivy” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-holly-and-ivy “The Holly and the Ivy” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: This carol is centuries old. The song collector Cecil Sharp heard it sung in a Cotswold town and printed this tune in 1911. It dances in three.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-holly-and-ivy “The Holly and the Ivy” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 這首頌歌已有數百年歷史。採歌者 Cecil Sharp 在科茨沃爾德小鎮聽人唱，於 1911 年出版這個曲調。它以三拍起舞。

items.source: Four open Gs, then a leap to open E on string 1, down to D at fret 3 on string 2 and open B.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-holly-and-ivy “The Holly and the Ivy” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 四次 G 空弦，再跳第 1 弦 E 空弦，下到第 2 弦第 3 品 D、B 空弦。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-holly-and-ivy “The Holly and the Ivy” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: From open G to open E is a sixth. Keep your pick close to the strings and cross from string 3 to string 1 in one move.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-holly-and-ivy “The Holly and the Ivy” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: G 空弦到 E 空弦是六度。撥片靠近琴弦，一個動作從第 3 弦跨到第 1 弦。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-holly-and-ivy “The Holly and the Ivy” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)

items.source: Angels from the Realms of Glory
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-angels-from-the-realms “Angels from the Realms of Glory” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-angels-from-the-realms “Angels from the Realms of Glory” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: James Montgomery printed these words in his Sheffield newspaper on Christmas Eve, 1816. Henry Smart's tune, from 1867, gives it a grand, marching sound.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-angels-from-the-realms “Angels from the Realms of Glory” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: James Montgomery 在 1816 年平安夜，於自己在雪菲爾的報紙刊出歌詞。Henry Smart 於 1867 年譜的曲，賦予宏大進行曲聲響。

items.source: A on string 3, F sharp at fret 4 on string 4, D at fret 3 on string 2, A, then F sharp at fret 2 on string 1, E and D.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-angels-from-the-realms “Angels from the Realms of Glory” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第 3 弦 A、第 4 弦第 4 品升 F、第 2 弦第 3 品 D、A，再第 1 弦第 2 品升 F、E、D。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-angels-from-the-realms “Angels from the Realms of Glory” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: This key has two sharps, F sharp and C sharp. C sharp sits at fret 2 on string 2.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-angels-from-the-realms “Angels from the Realms of Glory” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 這個調有升 F、升 C 兩個升音。升 C 在第 2 弦第 2 品。

items.source: Where is the highest note of the chorus?
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-angels-from-the-realms “Angels from the Realms of Glory” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-angels-from-the-realms “Angels from the Realms of Glory” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-angels-from-the-realms “Angels from the Realms of Glory” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: 第 1 弦第 3 品 G

items.source: Worship Christ starts on G at fret 3 on string 1, the top of the whole carol.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-angels-from-the-realms “Angels from the Realms of Glory” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Worship Christ 從第 1 弦第 3 品 G 開始，是整首頌歌最高音。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · song std-angels-from-the-realms “Angels from the Realms of Glory” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
