Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · challenge std-medley-winter “Winter medley” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: The carols from this unit, back to back. Most move in long notes: let each one ring full length before the next.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · challenge std-medley-winter “Winter medley” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 這單元頌歌接著彈，多以長音移動。每個音都響足時值，再到下一個。

items.source: Which of these counts in three?
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · challenge std-medley-winter “Winter medley” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: The Holly and the Ivy is in three. The other two count in four.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 6 · challenge std-medley-winter “Winter medley” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 《冬青與常春藤》是三拍，另兩首數四拍。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 “Hymns everyone knows” · title

items.source: Five great hymns in long, singing notes, from 1708 to 1861.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 “Hymns everyone knows” · unit summary
items.translation: 五首以悠長歌唱音符演奏的聖詩，從 1708 到 1861 年。

items.source: O God, Our Help in Ages Past
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-o-god-our-help “O God, Our Help in Ages Past” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-o-god-our-help “O God, Our Help in Ages Past” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: William Croft wrote this tune, St Anne, in 1708, and Isaac Watts's words were first printed in 1719. Each verse is four short lines, the plainest hymn shape there is.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-o-god-our-help “O God, Our Help in Ages Past” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: William Croft 在 1708 年寫下曲調《St Anne》，Isaac Watts 的詞於 1719 年首次出版。每段四個短句，是最簡潔的聖詩結構。

items.source: Open G, E at fret 2 on string 4, A at fret 2 on string 3, G, then C at fret 1 on string 2, C, open B and C.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-o-god-our-help “O God, Our Help in Ages Past” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: G 空弦、第 4 弦第 2 品 E、第 3 弦第 2 品 A、G，再第 2 弦第 1 品 C、C、B 空弦、C。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-o-god-our-help “O God, Our Help in Ages Past” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Every line starts on the beat before the bar: O, our, our, and. Count four, then sing the first word on it.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-o-god-our-help “O God, Our Help in Ages Past” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 每句都在完整小節前一拍開始：O、our、our、and。數第四拍，在那裡唱第一個字。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-o-god-our-help “O God, Our Help in Ages Past” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: The chart leans on A minor, F and G7. God, our sits on A minor, and a-ges past moves from G7 to C.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-o-god-our-help “O God, Our Help in Ages Past” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 和弦譜著重 A 小和弦、F、G7。God, our 配 A 小和弦，a-ges past 從 G7 到 C。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-o-god-our-help “O God, Our Help in Ages Past” · arrangement · song section label (Intro, Verse 1 …) on a small chip
Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-holy-holy-holy “Holy, Holy, Holy” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-holy-holy-holy “Holy, Holy, Holy” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Reginald Heber wrote these words, printed in 1826, and John Bacchus Dykes wrote the tune in 1861. Its first line climbs the notes of a G major chord.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-holy-holy-holy “Holy, Holy, Holy” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Reginald Heber 的歌詞於 1826 年出版，John Bacchus Dykes 在 1861 年譜曲。第一句沿 G 大和弦音上行。

items.source: Up the G chord: open G twice, open B twice, then D at fret 3 on string 2, held long.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-holy-holy-holy “Holy, Holy, Holy” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 沿 G 和弦上行：G 空弦兩次、B 空弦兩次，再第 2 弦第 3 品 D，長長延續。

items.source: Holy, holy, holy climbs which notes?
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-holy-holy-holy “Holy, Holy, Holy” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: Holy, holy, holy 沿哪些音上行？

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-holy-holy-holy “Holy, Holy, Holy” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-holy-holy-holy “Holy, Holy, Holy” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: G, B and D are the notes of a G major chord, so the tune climbs the chord itself.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-holy-holy-holy “Holy, Holy, Holy” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: G、B、D 是 G 大和弦的音，所以旋律沿著和弦本身上行。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-holy-holy-holy “Holy, Holy, Holy” · step 5 (explain) · title

items.source: This hymn moves in long notes: halves of two beats and a whole note of four at the end. Count every beat, even while a note rings.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-holy-holy-holy “Holy, Holy, Holy” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 這首聖詩用長音移動：兩拍的二分音符，結尾四拍的全音符。即使音在延續，也數每一拍。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-holy-holy-holy “Holy, Holy, Holy” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-abide-with-me “Abide with Me” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-abide-with-me “Abide with Me” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Henry Francis Lyte wrote these words in 1847, and William Henry Monk wrote the tune Eventide for them in 1861. Football crowds in England have sung it before the cup final since 1927.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-abide-with-me “Abide with Me” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Henry Francis Lyte 在 1847 年寫詞，William Henry Monk 在 1861 年配上《Eventide》曲調。英格蘭足球觀眾自 1927 年起，在盃賽決賽前唱它。

items.source: Open B twice, A at fret 2 on string 3, open G, then D at fret 3 and E on string 1, back through D and C to B.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-abide-with-me “Abide with Me” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: B 空弦兩次、第 3 弦第 2 品 A、G 空弦，再第 3 品 D 與第 1 弦 E，經 D、C 回 B。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-abide-with-me “Abide with Me” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Every note here is a quarter, a half or a whole. Count four steady beats a bar and let the long notes ring.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-abide-with-me “Abide with Me” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 每個音都是四分、二分或全音符。每小節穩定數四拍，讓長音延續。

items.source: Which note leads into the D at the end of the second line?
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-abide-with-me “Abide with Me” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 第二句結尾，哪個音引到 D？

items.source: C sharp, at fret 2 on string 2, rises a half step into D, the way a leading note does.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-abide-with-me “Abide with Me” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 第 2 弦第 2 品的升 C 向上半音到 D，就像導音的作用。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-abide-with-me “Abide with Me” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-nearer-my-god “Nearer, My God, to Thee” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-nearer-my-god “Nearer, My God, to Thee” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Sarah Flower Adams wrote these words in London in 1841, and Lowell Mason, an American music teacher, gave them this tune in 1856.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-nearer-my-god “Nearer, My God, to Thee” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Sarah Flower Adams 在 1841 年於倫敦寫詞，美國音樂教師 Lowell Mason 在 1856 年配上這段旋律。

items.source: Open B, A at fret 2 on string 3, open G twice, then E at fret 2 on string 4 twice.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-nearer-my-god “Nearer, My God, to Thee” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: B 空弦、第 3 弦第 2 品 A、G 空弦兩次，再第 4 弦第 2 品 E 兩次。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-nearer-my-god “Nearer, My God, to Thee” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Each line has a long-short pair: a dotted quarter, then a quick eighth, as in -er, my and God, to. Let the long note lean into the short one.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-nearer-my-god “Nearer, My God, to Thee” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 每句都有長短音組：附點四分音符，再快速八分音符，例如 -er, my 和 God, to。讓長音引向短音。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-nearer-my-god “Nearer, My God, to Thee” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)

items.source: For the Beauty of the Earth

Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-for-the-beauty “For the Beauty of the Earth” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Folliott Pierpoint wrote these words in 1864, on a spring day in the English countryside. They are sung to Dix, a German tune from 1838.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-for-the-beauty “For the Beauty of the Earth” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Folliott Pierpoint 在 1864 年英國鄉間的春日寫詞，搭配 1838 年的德國曲調《Dix》歌唱。

items.source: Open G, F sharp at fret 4 on string 4, G, A at fret 2 on string 3, G, then C at fret 1 on string 2 twice and open B.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-for-the-beauty “For the Beauty of the Earth” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: G 空弦、第 4 弦第 4 品升 F、G、第 3 弦第 2 品 A、G，再第 2 弦第 1 品 C 兩次與 B 空弦。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-for-the-beauty “For the Beauty of the Earth” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: For the starts with two eighth notes on the: F sharp and G, one syllable sung over both. Play them evenly inside one beat.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-for-the-beauty “For the Beauty of the Earth” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: For the 開頭的 the 跨升 F、G 兩個八分音符，一個音節唱兩音。在一拍內均勻演奏。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · song std-for-the-beauty “For the Beauty of the Earth” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)

Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · challenge std-medley-hymns “Hymn medley” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: The hymns from this unit, back to back, from the oldest tune to the newest. Let the long notes ring and the chords change on the word.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · challenge std-medley-hymns “Hymn medley” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 這單元聖詩從最古老到最新依次演奏。讓長音延續，和弦隨歌詞準時轉換。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · challenge std-medley-hymns “Hymn medley” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction
items.translation: 哪首聖詩是這樣開始的？

items.source: Which of these tunes is the oldest?
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · challenge std-medley-hymns “Hymn medley” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.translation: St Anne（上主是我千古保障），1708

items.source: William Croft wrote St Anne in 1708, almost 150 years before the other two.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 7 · challenge std-medley-hymns “Hymn medley” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: William Croft 在 1708 年寫下《St Anne》，比另兩首早近 150 年。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 “Parlor songs and a planet” · title

items.source: Three songs families sang around the piano, then Holst's Jupiter.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 “Parlor songs and a planet” · unit summary
items.translation: 三首家庭圍著鋼琴唱的歌，再接霍爾斯特《木星》。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-home-sweet-home “Home! Sweet Home!” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-home-sweet-home “Home! Sweet Home!” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Henry Bishop wrote this tune for a London opera in 1823, to words by the American actor John Howard Payne. Within a few years it was one of the best-loved songs in the world.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-home-sweet-home “Home! Sweet Home!” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Henry Bishop 在 1823 年為倫敦歌劇譜寫此曲，歌詞來自美國演員 John Howard Payne。幾年內，它成為世界最受喜愛的歌曲之一。

items.source: Open G, A at fret 2 on string 3, open B, C at fret 1 and D at fret 3 on string 2, then back to B.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-home-sweet-home “Home! Sweet Home!” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: G 空弦、第 3 弦第 2 品 A、B 空弦、第 2 弦第 1 品 C、第 3 品 D，再回 B。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-home-sweet-home “Home! Sweet Home!” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: The verse starts just before beat one, on a dotted eighth and a sixteenth. Count four-e-and-a: 'Mid lands on four, and its short turn on a.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-home-sweet-home “Home! Sweet Home!” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 主歌在第一拍前，以附點八分音符加十六分音符開始。數四-e-and-a：'Mid 落在四，短轉折落在 a。

items.source: The chorus begins on one long note. How long is it?
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-home-sweet-home “Home! Sweet Home!” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 副歌以一個長音開始，有多長？

items.source: Home! is a whole note: hold D at fret 3 on string 2 for the whole bar.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-home-sweet-home “Home! Sweet Home!” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: Home! 是全音符：第 2 弦第 3 品 D 延續整小節。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-home-sweet-home “Home! Sweet Home!” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)

items.source: Hard Times Come Again No More
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-hard-times “Hard Times Come Again No More” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-hard-times “Hard Times Come Again No More” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Stephen Foster published this song in 1854. It asks the listener to stop and think of people who have less, and singers still return to it today.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-hard-times “Hard Times Come Again No More” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Stephen Foster 在 1854 年出版這首歌，請聽眾停下，想想生活更困苦的人，至今仍被歌者傳唱。

items.source: Open D, E and F sharp on string 4, three more F sharps, then A at fret 2 on string 3 and back to F sharp.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-hard-times “Hard Times Come Again No More” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第 4 弦 D 空弦、E、升 F，再三次升 F，接第 3 弦第 2 品 A，回升 F。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-hard-times “Hard Times Come Again No More” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: The verse sings several words on one note. Keep each F sharp short and even, and let the words carry the line.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-hard-times “Hard Times Come Again No More” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 主歌在同一音上唱幾個字。每個升 F 保持短而均勻，讓歌詞帶動樂句。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-hard-times “Hard Times Come Again No More” · step 6 (explain) · title

items.source: The chorus lifts to G under the long note on wear-y, then rests on D for hard times. A7 brings each line home.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-hard-times “Hard Times Come Again No More” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 副歌 wear-y 的長音下升到 G 和弦，hard times 停在 D。A7 帶每句回家。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-hard-times “Hard Times Come Again No More” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-last-rose “The Last Rose of Summer” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-last-rose “The Last Rose of Summer” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Thomas Moore set these words to an old Irish air and printed them in 1813. Later, Mendelssohn wrote a fantasia on the tune, and Flotow put it in his opera Martha.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-last-rose “The Last Rose of Summer” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Thomas Moore 為古老愛爾蘭曲調填詞，於 1813 年出版。後來孟德爾頌以此寫幻想曲，Flotow 把它放進歌劇《瑪爾塔》。

items.source: Open D, E and F sharp on string 4, then a leap to D at fret 3 on string 2, and down C sharp, B and A.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-last-rose “The Last Rose of Summer” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第 4 弦 D 空弦、E、升 F，再跳第 2 弦第 3 品 D，下行升 C、B、A。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-last-rose “The Last Rose of Summer” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: Most beats split long-short: a dotted eighth and a sixteenth. Play the long note full and let the short one lead into the next beat.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-last-rose “The Last Rose of Summer” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 多數拍分長短：附點八分音符加十六分音符。長音奏足，短音引向下一拍。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-last-rose “The Last Rose of Summer” · step 6 (explain) · title

items.source: In the middle, no rosebud is nigh climbs through A sharp to B. The chord turns to B minor there, the saddest moment of the song.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-last-rose “The Last Rose of Summer” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 中段 no rosebud is nigh 經升 A 上到 B，和弦在此轉 B 小和弦，是歌曲最悲傷的時刻。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-last-rose “The Last Rose of Summer” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)
Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-jupiter “Jupiter” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-jupiter “Jupiter” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Gustav Holst wrote The Planets between 1914 and 1916. This broad tune is the heart of Jupiter. In 1921 he made it a hymn tune and named it Thaxted, after the town where he lived.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-jupiter “Jupiter” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Gustav Holst 在 1914 到 1916 年間創作《行星》。這段寬廣旋律是《木星》的核心。1921 年他改成聖詩曲調，依居住城鎮命名為《Thaxted》。

items.source: E at fret 2 on string 4, open G, A at fret 2, then C at fret 1 on string 2, open B, G, and up C, D, C, B.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-jupiter “Jupiter” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第 4 弦第 2 品 E、G 空弦、第 2 品 A，再第 2 弦第 1 品 C、B 空弦、G，上行 C、D、C、B。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-jupiter “Jupiter” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: The middle of the tune dips to C at fret 3 on string 5. Reach for it with your third finger, then come straight back up to string 4.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-jupiter “Jupiter” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 旋律中段下到第 5 弦第 3 品 C。用第三指伸到，再直接回第 4 弦。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-jupiter “Jupiter” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-jupiter “Jupiter” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-jupiter “Jupiter” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-jupiter “Jupiter” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Like a slow waltz: one, two, three. Each phrase starts with two eighth notes before beat one.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · song std-jupiter “Jupiter” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 像慢圓舞曲：一、二、三。每句在第一拍前以兩個八分音符開始。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · challenge std-medley-parlor “Parlor medley” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · challenge std-medley-parlor “Parlor medley” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Before records, families sang these songs around the piano at home. Here they are back to back, with Holst's big tune to finish.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · challenge std-medley-parlor “Parlor medley” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 唱片出現前，家庭在家中圍著鋼琴唱這些歌。這裡依次演奏，再以霍爾斯特的宏大旋律收尾。

items.source: Which two of these count in three?
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · challenge std-medley-parlor “Parlor medley” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

items.source: The Last Rose of Summer and Jupiter
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · challenge std-medley-parlor “Parlor medley” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: 夏日最後的玫瑰與木星

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · challenge std-medley-parlor “Parlor medley” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: Hard Times and The Last Rose of Summer
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · challenge std-medley-parlor “Parlor medley” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
items.translation: 苦難的日子別再來與夏日最後的玫瑰

items.source: The Last Rose of Summer and Jupiter are both in three. Home! Sweet Home! and Hard Times count in four.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 8 · challenge std-medley-parlor “Parlor medley” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 《夏日最後的玫瑰》與《木星》都是三拍。《甜蜜的家庭》與《苦難的日子別再來》數四拍。

items.source: Vivaldi's Spring, Mozart's Turkish rondo and Sousa's best-known march.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 9 “Concert favorites” · unit summary
items.translation: 韋瓦第《春》、莫札特土耳其輪旋曲與蘇沙最著名的進行曲。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 9 · song std-spring “Spring” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 9 · song std-spring “Spring” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Antonio Vivaldi published four violin concertos called The Four Seasons in 1725. Spring opens with this bright tune, then the solo violin plays birdsong and running brooks.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 9 · song std-spring “Spring” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: Antonio Vivaldi 在 1725 年出版四首小提琴協奏曲《四季》。《春》以這段明亮旋律開始，再由獨奏小提琴模仿鳥鳴與流溪。

items.source: E at fret 2 on string 4, G sharp at fret 1 on string 3 three times, F sharp at fret 4 on string 4, E, then open B.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 9 · song std-spring “Spring” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第 4 弦第 2 品 E、第 3 弦第 1 品升 G 三次、第 4 弦第 4 品升 F、E，再 B 空弦。

items.source: The key of E has four sharps. In first position G sharp is at fret 1 on string 3, D sharp at fret 1 on string 4, and C sharp at fret 2 on string 2.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 9 · song std-spring “Spring” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: E 調有四個升音。第一把位中，升 G 在第 3 弦第 1 品，升 D 在第 4 弦第 1 品，升 C 在第 2 弦第 2 品。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 9 · song std-spring “Spring” · step 4 (explain) · title

items.source: Each beat can split into four sixteenths. In the theme, the quick F sharp, E pair falls in the second half of beat two.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 9 · song std-spring “Spring” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 每拍可分四個十六分音符。主題裡快速的升 F、E 音組落在第二拍後半。

items.source: Mozart published this rondo in 1784 as the last movement of a piano sonata. Its march copies the sound of Turkish military bands, which Vienna loved at the time.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 9 · song std-rondo-alla-turca “Rondo alla Turca” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 莫札特於 1784 年出版這首輪旋曲，作為鋼琴奏鳴曲最後樂章。它模仿土耳其軍樂隊聲響，當時維也納很喜愛這種風格。

items.source: B at fret 2 on string 5, open A, G sharp at fret 4 on string 6, A, then C at fret 3 on string 5, open D, C, B and C.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 9 · song std-rondo-alla-turca “Rondo alla Turca” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第 5 弦第 2 品 B、A 空弦、第 6 弦第 4 品升 G、A，再第 5 弦第 3 品 C、D 空弦、C、B、C。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 9 · song std-rondo-alla-turca “Rondo alla Turca” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: The theme circles A: B, A, G sharp, A. Each circle is four sixteenths. Then it climbs a step and circles again.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 9 · song std-rondo-alla-turca “Rondo alla Turca” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 主題圍繞 A：B、A、升 G、A。每圈四個十六分音符，再提高一級，重新繞行。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 9 · song std-rondo-alla-turca “Rondo alla Turca” · step 6 (explain) · title

items.source: The march moves from A minor to A major: C becomes C sharp, at fret 2 on string 2. The tune sounds suddenly bright.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 9 · song std-rondo-alla-turca “Rondo alla Turca” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 進行曲從 A 小調轉 A 大調：C 變第 2 弦第 2 品升 C，旋律突然明亮起來。

Standards & Classics · Unit 9 · song std-stars-and-stripes “The Stars and Stripes Forever” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: John Philip Sousa wrote this march at the end of 1896, and it was published in 1897. It is the official national march of the United States. This is its big trio tune.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 9 · song std-stars-and-stripes “The Stars and Stripes Forever” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: John Philip Sousa 於 1896 年底寫下這首進行曲，並於 1897 年出版。它是美國的官方國家進行曲。這裡演奏的是其中宏亮的中段旋律。

items.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, C at fret 1, open B, then a dip to A sharp at fret 3 on string 3 and back to B.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 9 · song std-stars-and-stripes “The Stars and Stripes Forever” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
items.translation: 第 2 弦第 3 品 D、第 1 品 C、B 空弦，再降到第 3 弦第 3 品升 A，回到 B。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 9 · song std-stars-and-stripes “The Stars and Stripes Forever” · step 3 (explain) · title

items.source: The trio holds notes across the bar line. Keep counting through them: one, two, three, four, then on into the next bar.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 9 · song std-stars-and-stripes “The Stars and Stripes Forever” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 中段有些音延續過小節線。持續數拍：一、二、三、四，接著數進下一小節。

items.source: The tune keeps dipping a half step below B. Which note is that?
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 9 · song std-stars-and-stripes “The Stars and Stripes Forever” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
items.translation: 旋律不斷下行到 B 下方的半音。那是什麼音？

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 9 · song std-stars-and-stripes “The Stars and Stripes Forever” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

items.source: A sharp, at fret 3 on string 3, sits a half step below open B and leans right back into it.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 9 · song std-stars-and-stripes “The Stars and Stripes Forever” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
items.translation: 第 3 弦第 3 品的升 A，比 B 空弦低半音，隨即傾向回到 B。

items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 9 · challenge std-medley-concert “Concert medley” · title
Standards & Classics · Unit 9 · challenge std-medley-concert “Concert medley” · step 1 (explain) · title

items.source: Vivaldi, Mozart and Sousa, back to back: a violin concerto, a piano rondo and a band march, each arranged for your guitar.
items.context: Standards & Classics · Unit 9 · challenge std-medley-concert “Concert medley” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
items.translation: 韋瓦第、莫札特與蘇沙接連登場：小提琴協奏曲、鋼琴輪旋曲與管樂進行曲，都改編成吉他版本。

items.translation: 像貝斯手初次為樂團伴奏一樣，演奏根音與五度音：和弦開始時彈根音，中間穿插五度音，都在第一把位的低音域。歌曲維持樂團演奏的 E 調。
